jobs.description:
**Embedded Software Developer / Engineer I**

**Competitive Salary (Based on Experience and Market Conditions)**

**Signing Bonus • Equity**

**Hybrid \| Huntsville, AL \| Full\-Time \| 9/80 Schedule**




**This isn't another defense contractor job**


Join a mission\-focused engineering team developing embedded software and firmware for advanced defense and national security applications. This early\-career engineering role is designed for a capable software engineer with a strong foundation in C/C\+\+ who can contribute to embedded systems, work close to the hardware, and continue building technical depth alongside experienced engineers on mission\-critical programs.




**Why embedded software engineers choose Secmation**

* Build embedded software and firmware that support real\-world defense and national security missions.
* Work directly with hardware, processors, interfaces, sensors, communications systems, and other embedded technologies in technically challenging environments.
* Collaborate with experienced embedded software, FPGA, RF, cyber, systems, and hardware engineers in a small\-team environment.
* Gain exposure to the complete embedded development lifecycle, from requirements and low\-level implementation through integration, hardware/software debugging, test, and deployment.
* Take ownership of meaningful engineering tasks while receiving technical guidance and mentorship.
* Work within a small, highly technical company where individual engineers have visible impact.




**What you'll do**


Develop, integrate, test, and maintain embedded software and firmware supporting defense and national security programs. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone with strong foundational C/C\+\+ skills who is comfortable working close to the hardware, debugging software/hardware interactions, learning within an existing codebase, and solving well\-defined technical problems with support from more experienced engineers.


You'll work across:

* Development and debugging of embedded software and firmware using C/C\+\+ for processors, controllers, and embedded computing platforms.
* Low\-level hardware interfaces, peripheral interaction, device drivers, and software components that connect embedded hardware with higher\-level applications and system functionality.
* Embedded Linux development and troubleshooting, including command\-line tools, build environments, system configuration, and application\-to\-hardware interaction where applicable.
* Hardware/software integration and debugging using laboratory tools, logs, test equipment, and systematic root\-cause analysis.
* Unit, integration, and system\-level testing to verify software behavior, interface performance, reliability, and correct operation on target hardware.
* Source control, code reviews, issue tracking, documentation, and other established team development practices.
* Collaboration with embedded software, FPGA, hardware, RF, cyber, and systems engineers to understand requirements, interfaces, constraints, and implementation approaches.




**What we're looking for**

* U.S. citizenship and a current, active DoD Secret security clearance are required.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Equivalent relevant technical experience may be considered.
* Foundational embedded software or firmware development experience gained through professional work, internships, academic projects, research, or other hands\-on technical experience.
* Working knowledge of C and/or C\+\+ and fundamental software development concepts applicable to embedded systems.
* Familiarity with low\-level hardware interfaces, device drivers, memory mapped I/O, peripheral interfaces, or interaction between firmware and higher\-level software.
* Ability to implement, test, and debug well\-defined embedded software or firmware features with technical guidance.
* Familiarity with embedded Linux environments and hardware/software debugging is preferred.
* Experience with AMD/Xilinx SoCs, FPGA\-based platforms, or similar programmable embedded hardware is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with Git or another modern source\-control system and the ability to follow established coding, documentation, and configuration\-management practices.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn new technologies, hardware platforms, and technical domains.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a collaborative engineering team.
* Experience with defense, aerospace, communications, cybersecurity, RF, FPGA, or other mission\-critical embedded systems is a plus but not required.




**Work Environment**

* Hybrid role with on\-site work required in Huntsville, Alabama.
* Flexible 9/80 work schedule supporting every other Friday off.
* Work may include collaboration in secure or controlled environments based on program and customer requirements.




**CompensationBenefits**

* Competitive salary (based on experience and market conditions)
* Signing bonus
* Company equity
* 9/80 work schedule (every other Friday off)

* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and disability insurance (shortlong\-term)

Secmation develops AI\-enabled software, embedded cybersecurity, secure RF systems, and advanced communications technologies for the U.S. defense community. jobs.title: Systems Engineer (MBSE/CAMEO)
jobs.description:
Synovix is seeking a Systems Engineer for a defense development program we are supporting in Huntsville, AL. This program offers the opportunity to support the clean sheet design of a new defense product from its earliest development stages through integration, testing, and eventual production. The program has the potential to transition into production much faster than traditional government acquisition timelines. For engineers who want to expand their “Systems Engineering” capabilities, this is a rare opportunity to participate in the complete development lifecycle.

**What You Will Do**

* Develop and manage system architectures, requirements, interfaces, and verification strategies using MBSE methodologies.
* Create and maintain SysML models using Cameo Systems Modeler (or equivalent MBSE tools).
* Collaborate with embedded software developers to ensure system architectures are effectively implemented.
* Define software and hardware interface requirements for embedded computing environments.
* Support digital engineering initiatives through model\-based analysis, architecture development, and requirements traceability.
* Develop system verification and validation plans while ensuring complete requirements coverage.
* Partner with software, hardware, cybersecurity, reliability, system safety, and integration teams to resolve technical issues.
* Support Agile development using JIRA, Confluence, and configuration management tools.
* Participate in technical reviews including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and SVR.
* Evaluate technical risk and recommend mitigation strategies.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 8\-14 years of experience and a Bachelors in Science
* Experience developing systems engineering products across the full system lifecycle.
* Experience supporting embedded software or embedded computing platforms.
* Experience with Model\-Base Systems Engineering (MBSE).
* Experience using SysML and Cameo System Modeler (or similar modeling tools).
* Experience with white\-box and black\-box analysis and logical and physical architecture development.
* Understanding software architecture, software integration, and interface development.
* Familiarity with requirements management tools.
* Experience working within Agile software development teams.
* U.S. Citizenship and an Active DoD Secret Security Clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Digital Engineering experience.
* Embedded Linux or Real\-Time Operating System (RTOS) knowledge.
* Software development experience using C\+\+, Python, or Java.
* Experience with Git, GitLab, Jenkins, or CI/CD pipelines.

jobs.description:

----------------------------



Lockheed Martin "Ahead of Ready"  

  

At Lockheed Martin Space, we aim to harness the full potential of space to cultivate innovation, reduce costs, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve. We are at the forefront of hypersonic missile development, and we want you to be a part of this exciting journey.
  

  

Learn more about our Hypersonic Solutions

  

The Theater Strike Weapon Systems (TSWS) mission area is looking for our next enthusiastic and motivated Systems Engineer Sr Staff to lead Long Range Hypersonic Weapon (LRHW) Hardware Engineering Integrated Product Team (IPT) Program Integration \& Control activities.

  

As the **Program Integration \& Control Lead**, you will:

* Lead Program Integration \& Control (PIC) activities for the LRHW Hardware Engineering IPT responsible for all hardware engineering efforts associated with the design, development, test and delivery of LRHW Battery Operations Center (BOC), Transporter Erector Launcher (TEL), All Up Round (AUR) Emulator (AE) and related assets.
* Support a diverse team of design engineers while coordinating across various program IPTs to ensure Hardware Engineering IPT plans and resources appropriately integrate to support program\-level priorities.
* Coordinate daily with product managers, HW design engineering, quality assurance engineers, material resource planners and program planners as required
* Work closely with all control account managers (CAM) for the IPT to ensure thoughtful, effective, disciplined, and coordinated cost and schedule integration.
* Provide guidance to Hardware Engineering team throughout the full Systems Engineering lifecycle, to include weapons system operations
* Establish, manage, and communicate Hardware Engineering IPT programmatic expectations, goals, roles, responsibilities, and objectives
* Lead and perform program baseline planning, integrated master schedule integration, schedule/cost validation, and awareness of risk and opportunities

  

You can learn more about Huntsville, AL by visiting this link.

  

Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package.

* Knowledge and/or experience with hardware product lifecycle processes from systems requirements decomposition to design requirements through final acceptance and delivery of hardware products

* Demonstrated experience with Program/Project Management

jobs.description:
**Worker Type**


Regular **Job Description**

 **Summary**  

  

The **Principal** **Systems Engineer** works with our Design team to develop a variety of innovative Unmanned Systems for defense and commercial applications. This position will interact with Controls Engineers to allocate requirements and develop architectures to drive simulation models. These development efforts will generally be small focused design teams, which will require engineers to use a range of skills and tools across traditional engineering, computer science, and mathematical disciplines. Because of the nature of the development efforts, the engineer will need to work on a variety of stages of development including requirements definition, concept design, prototyping, detailed design, validation and verification testing.

**Position Responsibilities**

* Oversee requirements traceability and evolution through the system development cycle
* Provide weekly status of system development progress with requirements burn down
* Allocate requirements to subsystem \& engineering coordination
* Evaluate system performance thresholds and providing direction
* Develops instrumented flight test vectors and data acquisition
* Provide input for model development and simulation analysis
* Develop systems test plans, procedures and reports
* Review and interpret customer specification effectively
* Identifies, analyzes and resolves system design weaknesses. Influences the shaping of future products by contributing to the framework (architecture) used across multiple products or systems
* Work on significant issues where analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of intangibles
* Acts independently to determine methods and procedures on new or special assignments
* Provide guidance and mentorship to others in both their discipline and on company values
* Other duties as assigned

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills \& Experience)**

* Bachelors in Mathematics, Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, or Mechanical Engineering is required or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience
* 12 \- 15 years of experience in a systems engineering role (Aerospace systems engineering preferred)
* Proficiency with C/C\+\+ and Matlab required
* Has managed requirements traceability and evolution through the system development cycle
* Demonstrated prior experience in providing effective weekly status of system development progress with requirements burn down
* Has developed systems test plans, procedures and reports and reviewed and interpreted specifications
* Experienced in writing Systems Safety protocols and ensuring personnel safety during field testing
* Strong Matlab skills and is proficient with office software and computer based productivity tools
* Familiarity with electronics and systems related to image collection and analysis
* Ability and interest in creating Architectures using Model Based Engineering tools

**Other Qualifications \& Desired Competencies**

* Advanced degree is preferred
* Experienced in taking a product from concept to production with contract manufacturers is preferred
* Knowledge of Simulink, Ansys and Solidworks preferred
* Exposure to Guidance Navigation and Control Systems along with Modeling Simulation and Control is preferred. Exposure to Model Based Systems Engineering is helpful but not required
* Understanding of Aircraft Terminology is a plus as is familiarity with Python or ROS (Robot Operating System) a plus
* Able to excel in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment, where small teams share a broad variety of duties
* Displays strong initiative and drive to accomplish goals and meet company objectives
* Takes ownership and responsibility for current and past work products
* Is committed to learning from mistakes and driven to improve and enhance performance of oneself, others, and the company
* Has effective problem\-solving, analytical, interpersonal and communication skills.
* Focuses on teamwork, collaboration and puts the success of the team above one's own interests

**Physical Demands**

* Ability to work in an office and manufacturing environment (Constant)
* Required to sit and stand for long periods; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard (Frequent)

 **Clearance Level**

  

No Clearance

$133,500 \- $203,750

**REAL TIME CONSULTING (An RTCo Company)—POSITION DESCRIPTION**  

**JOB TITLE:** **Software Engineer \-DO\-178/DO\-330 Tool Qualification**  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB:** The DO\-330 Tool Qualification Engineer is responsible for planning, developing, verifying, and documenting the qualification of software development and verification tools used on safety\-critical airborne software programs. Working closely with software development, verification, quality assurance, and certification teams, this role ensures software tools satisfy the qualification objectives defined in DO\-330 and support certification of airborne systems developed in accordance with DO\-178C.  

  

The ideal candidate possesses strong software verification and certification experience, understands the avionics software development lifecycle, and is familiar with FAA/EASA certification processes.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Develop Tool Qualification Plans (TQP), Tool Operational Requirements (TOR), Tool Verification Plans (TVP), Tool Accomplishment Summaries (TAS), and other certification artifacts.
* Determine software tool qualification requirements and Tool Qualification Levels (TQL) in accordance with DO\-330\.
* Develop and execute tool qualification test procedures and document verification results.
* Coordinate with software developers, verification engineers, and certification specialists to support tool qualification activities.
* Maintain bidirectional traceability between tool requirements, verification procedures, test results, and certification evidence.
* Support FAA, EASA, and customer certification audits and technical reviews.
* Develop qualification data packages for certification authorities.
* Participate in peer reviews, design reviews, and certification readiness reviews.


  

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 5\+ years of experience developing or verifying safety\-critical embedded software.
* Experience supporting DO\-178B or DO\-178C airborne software certification.
* Working knowledge of DO\-330 Software Tool Qualification Considerations.
* Experience developing software verification procedures and executing verification testing.
* Familiarity with software requirements management and traceability processes.
* Experience in preparing certification documentation and technical reports.
* Experience with configuration management practices and software baselines.
* Understanding of software lifecycle processes defined by DO\-178C.
* Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to interpret certification requirements and translate them into practical engineering activities.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
* Collaborative team player capable of working across engineering disciplines.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently.
* Strong planning and time management skills.
* Comfortable presenting technical information to certification authorities, and engineering leadership.


  

**PREFERRED SKILLS:**
* Direct experience qualifying software tools in accordance with DO\-330\.
* Experience determining Tool Qualification Levels (TQL\-1 through TQL\-5\).
* Experience qualifying code generators, structural coverage tools, static analysis tools, test automation tools, or requirements management tools.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  


### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large\-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety\-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands\-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands\-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low\- and high\-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety\-critical hardware design, incorporating multi\-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed\-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high\-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak\-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer\-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
* Familiar with real\-time computer architectures and their OS's

  

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. ### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


Were a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


The Future Forward organization is Intuitive’s advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next\-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic\-assisted surgery.


If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


As a Vision Software Staff Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the software and embedded architecture definition of the real\-time, high\-definition video processing, imaging, and intra\-body illumination systems at the heart of a new generation surgical robotic platform.


You will drive the deep integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi\-processor embedded architectures, bringing sound engineering judgment to the trade\-offs between hardware, software, and algorithms, and procedure\-specific product requirements.


Critical to the success of this role is experience diagnosing and debugging complex vision systems end\-to\-end – from sensor and optics through the video pipeline to software – driving root cause investigations and collaborating with hardware and algorithms teams to resolve difficult, multi\-disciplinary issues. Familiarity with working in a regulated industry and with design controls for medical devices is a plus.


The successful candidate must excel at evaluating design trade\-offs through detailed technical deep dives, proof\-of\-concept development, and rapid iteration, translating rough requirements into robust, well\-reasoned embedded software architectures.


A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the ability to make the work fun and interesting. Supporting you will be a development and management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and wants you to succeed.


**Essential Job Duties**


* Lead the definition of hardware, software, and algorithms architecture for the real\-time video processing engine, image sensors, and intra\-body illumination systems of a new generation surgical robotic platform, from concept through implementation.
* Drive the integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi\-processor embedded architectures, ensuring robust interfaces between hardware, FPGA/ISP, and software components.
* Evaluate multiple design trade\-offs for the embedded vision software architecture through detailed technical deep dives, proof\-of\-concept development, and rapid iteration.
* Lead bring\-up and integration of new, high\-performance cameras and image sensors, and the integration and evaluation of advanced camera pipeline video processing algorithms.
* Diagnose and debug vision system issues end\-to\-end – sensor, optics, video pipeline, and software – leading root cause investigations in close collaboration with hardware, algorithms, and systems engineering teams.
* Drive development and enhancement of the color and power control functions for intra\-operative illumination.
* Lead formal risk analyses for vision and illumination subsystems; identify additional hardware requirements and develop software mitigations to minimize potential failures.
* Design and develop offline simulation environments and hardware/software diagnostic tools that accelerate development, debug, and test.
* Perform and guide detailed design, development, documentation, and verification of embedded vision software and supervisory state machines, in compliance with regulatory requirements and Intuitive's internal guidelines.
* Contribute broadly across the video and vision software stack, including extension of current processing frameworks to new hardware platforms.
* Apply high\-level and specialized imaging/vision expertise to deliver innovations and problem\-solving approaches that can be leveraged across multiple products.
* Mentor and guide engineers across the vision team.

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
* A minimum of 12 years of experience developing and supporting embedded systems, with significant focus on video, imaging, or vision systems (or 8 years with a Master's degree, or 5 years with a PhD).

**Required Skills and Experience**


* Fluent in designing and developing mission\-critical, cross\-platform code in C/C\+\+ for embedded, real\-time, Linux\-based systems, including application\-level and driver\-level development for multi\-core and multi\-processor architectures.
* Deep familiarity with integrating cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex embedded architectures, including hardware, software, and algorithm interfaces.
* Demonstrated ability to debug and diagnose complex vision system issues through root cause investigation and close cross\-functional collaboration with hardware

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**



Nuro believes self\-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that's why we're building a universal autonomy platform: self\-driving for all roads and all rides.  

  

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.  

  

With years of real\-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner\-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.  

  

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.


**About the Role**

  


Nuro operates real self\-driving vehicles on public roads today — not a research platform, not ADAS. The Embedded Software Engineering team builds the software for the safety\-critical embedded controllers that connect the Nuro Driver™ to the vehicle: the devices that command steering, braking, and propulsion, alongside other vehicle actuators, distribute and monitor power, monitor vehicle motion, and bring the vehicle to a safe state when something goes wrong.



As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will work across the full stack of multicore automotive microcontrollers from RTOS, drivers, and scheduler up through middleware and application components that talk to the vehicle, and help extend that stack as our hardware evolves. You will bring the Nuro Driver™ up on new vehicle platforms alongside OEM and supplier engineers, and see your code drive real vehicles on public roads. We're hiring across levels, from engineers with a couple years of embedded experience to those who've shipped a production automotive launch.


**About the Work**

  

* Design, implement and test embedded C software for safety\-critical multicore automotive microcontrollers, spanning base software such as RTOS, device drivers, scheduling and bootloader, middleware such as inter\-component messaging and end\-to\-end protection, and application components such as actuator interface, body controls, power management and fault management.
* Integrate the Nuro Driver™ with new vehicle platforms: define and implement CAN and Ethernet interfaces with OEM ECUs, adapt actuator and body\-control interfaces, and validate them on bench and in vehicle.
* Take part in hands\-on device and vehicle bring\-up, prototyping and debugging on multiple vehicle platforms, from first power\-on to autonomous driving.
* Build and maintain the team's verification infrastructure: unit tests, hardware\-in\-the\-loop benches and vehicle test procedures.
* Work within an ISO 26262 development process: define software requirements from system safety requirements, then implement and verify them with full traceability.
* Collaborate daily with systems, safety, hardware, controls and autonomy engineers, and with OEM and supplier partners, from definition through verification.


**About You**

  

* B.S. or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.
* 2\+ years of industry experience developing embedded software in C, including work on a real\-time operating system.
* Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, concurrency and algorithm design.
* Working knowledge of microcontroller internals and peripherals, with depth in at least one of device driver development, CAN or automotive Ethernet, bootloaders and software update, embedded security, or vehicle\-level integration and test.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills, clear written and spoken communication, and a track record of working well with engineers from other disciplines.
* Comfortable at the bench with debug probes, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and CAN tools. You enjoy finding out why hardware and software disagree.


**Bonus Points**

  

* 3\+ years of embedded development in the automotive or autonomous vehicle industry, including a production launch.
* Hands\-on functional safety experience with ISO 26262, or safety\-critical development in another regulated industry such as DO\-178C or IEC 62304\.
* Experience with Infineon AURIX TC3xx, SafeRTOS or FreeRTOS, or AUTOSAR Classic base software such as MCAL and communication stacks.
* Vehicle network integration experience: DBC and ARXML, UDS diagnostics, E2E protection, time synchronization.
* Knowledge of vehicle functions, vehicle dynamics or control theory.

  



At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $145,830 and $219,000 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.


*At Nuro, we celebrate differences and are committed to a diverse workplace that fosters inclusion and psychological safety for all employees. Nuro is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and expressly prohibits any form of workplace discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. \#LI\-DNP*

Headquartered in Southern California, our customers are society’s heroes – intelligence professionals, warfighters, first responders, and scientific researchers. As a trusted mission partner, the United States and its allies depend on us for critical information when it matters most.

**Role Description**


ICEYE US is developing next\-generation spaceborne Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) payloads and full space vehicles, and is seeking an RF Hardware Manager to lead the engineering team responsible for payload RF hardware, radar systems, and communications hardware design. Sitting within the Space Systems engineering team, this role owns the RF hardware architecture across SAR payload, radar subsystems, and vehicle\-level communications — ensuring that antenna arrays, high\-speed digitizers, RF front ends, and data links meet mission performance requirements across the full program lifecycle.


The manager will absorb and institutionalize relevant historical knowledge of ICEYE's SAR payload designs and RF architecture, guiding the translation of that knowledge into ICEYE US products, while simultaneously building the RF hardware foundation to support full space vehicle development. They will own the concept of operations (CONOPS) to inform RF design decisions across all engineering domains, serve as the primary RF technical authority at all program lifecycle reviews, and drive the team toward a verified, integrated flight article ready for environmental test and launch.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of RF hardware, radar, and communications hardware engineers; own hiring, onboarding, performance development, and technical career growth for direct reports.\\
* Own RF subsystem program execution: work breakdown, scheduling, resource loading, risk tracking, and status reporting against program milestones (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, FRR).
* Set and enforce RF hardware engineering standards, processes, and operating framework governing how RF systems, radar hardware, and communications hardware are designed, analyzed, tested, and verified across the program lifecycle — including RF analysis standards, test automation frameworks, documentation formats, and RF verification readiness criteria.
* Serve as the RF hardware technical authority and primary cross\-functional counterpart to systems engineering, mechanical, thermal, avionics, embedded software, firmware, and program management stakeholders.
* Own the RF hardware architecture for SAR payloads and space vehicles, including transmit/receive chains, high\-speed digitizers, low\-noise RF circuits, power amplifiers, and RF front\-end subsystems.
* Direct detailed RF hardware analysis for antennas and phased antenna arrays, including gain, beam pattern, polarization, scan performance, and mutual coupling.
* Guide the team in hardware/software and hardware/firmware co\-design with embedded software and FPGA firmware engineers on high\-speed digital interfaces, timing architectures, and data acquisition chains.
* Own vehicle\-level and payload\-level communications hardware architecture — RF uplink/downlink, inter\-subsystem RF links, and ground interface RF definitions — ensuring end\-to\-end link performance meets mission ConOps and data rate requirements.
* Oversee RF subsystem requirements development and engineering requirements derivation to meet system\-level mission performance goals.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of experience in RF hardware engineering, including spacecraft or payload RF system design through the full design lifecycle.
* 2\+ years of direct engineering management or technical lead experience, including tasking, mentorship, and performance ownership for a multi\-discipline RF or hardware engineering team.
* Deep background in RF hardware design including high\-speed digitizers, low\-noise RF circuits, antenna and phased array systems, and RF front\-end integration.
* Demonstrated experience in RF test and validation, including anechoic testing, phased array characterization, RF test automation, and data analysis.
* Experience developing RF subsystem requirements and deriving engineering requirements from mission\-level performance goals.
* Proficiency in microwave and RF analysis using Python or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with SAR imaging concepts and system design.
* Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAR payload design, integration, and test.
* Direct experience with communications hardware design for space vehicles, including uplink/downlink RF systems and link margin analysis.
* Experience with assembly, integration, and testing (AIT) for spacecraft and payloads, including environmental test (vibration, TVAC, EMI/EMC).
* Experience with formal verification and validation of space\-rated RF systems.
* Background in radar hardware architecture, waveform design, or pulse compression chain design.
* Experience leading RF capture contributions — RFIs, RFPs, and technical proposals.
* Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, RF/Microwave Engineering, or a related field.

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**About The Team**
------------------



The Sentry Tower Software team is responsible for developing robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture.


**About the Job**
-----------------



We are looking for a Software Engineer with a focus in Firmware to join our rapidly growing team in Irvine. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining software for current and next\-generation Sentry Tower systems. This will include interacting with stakeholders like Anduril's business lines of Air Defense and Counter Intrusion all the way from internal engineering customers to the people in the field, prioritizing what matters to them in the long run.



Firmware is the layer with the least margin for error in the product. It runs on the sensor boards and motor controllers that make a tower move and sense, on hardware that sits outdoors for months without a service visit, and it is the part hardest to fix once a unit is fielded. A bug in a service can be patched in an update; a bug in firmware can mean a tower that has to be reached in person.



The honest version: you are joining an existing firmware platform, not starting one. There is a working baselayer that our towers already run on, and the work is the specialized projects that sit on top of it or replace parts of it, which means reading and understanding code you did not write before you are allowed to be confident about changing it. That is slower and less glamorous than a clean sheet, and it is the actual job. The feedback loop is also slower than in application software, and the discipline the role rewards is caution: getting it right before it ships, because the cost of being wrong is measured in trips to a site rather than in a redeploy.



Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/hardware/sentry/


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------


* Develop and extend the firmware running on the sensor boards, motor controllers, and power and monitoring hardware inside our Sentry Tower products.
* Take on the projects that build on top of our existing firmware baselayer, and the ones that replace parts of it, without regressing the towers already depending on it.
* Drive our ongoing effort to harden firmware security: authenticated and verified firmware updates, protecting the interfaces a physical attacker could reach, and closing the gaps in what shipped before that was a requirement.
* Own the firmware update path, including updates that have to be safe to apply to a unit already in the field.
* Work with our tower software team on the boundary between firmware and the services above it, so a failure can be diagnosed from either side.
* Collaborate with hardware engineers on board bring\-up and debugging, from first power\-on to a validated, production\-ready board.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------


* 4\+ years experience in firmware development using C.
* Strong understanding of microcontroller architectures (ARM, RISC\-V).
* Proficiency in low\-level networking protocols (TCP/IP, CAN, SPI, I2C).
* Experience with RTOS and bare\-metal programming.
* Familiarity with debugging tools like JTAG, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Solid understanding of computer architecture and memory management.
* US person status required, with eligibility to obtain and maintain a US security clearance.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------


* Experience with kernel development or device driver implementation.
* Knowledge of cryptography and secure boot processes.
* Familiarity with DMA, interrupt handling, and power management.
* Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Background in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

Cowboy Space Corporation is solving the global energy crisis by building the infrastructure for abundant, resilient space\-based solar energy. Cowboy Space Corporation is transforming how civilization powers, computes and connects \- from orbit to Earth.

**Background**


Cowboy Space Corporation is building the infrastructure to power and connect the orbital economy. Our modular, scalable satellites collect sunlight in Low Earth Orbit to enable multiple integrated applications: transmitting energy via infrared lasers (space\-to\-earth and space\-to\-space), powering on\-orbit high\-performance computing clusters (GPU/TPU), and providing secure, high bandwidth optical data transport.


Current energy and data systems rely on complex logistics and outdated infrastructure. Cowboy Space Corporation overcomes these challenges by enabling direct, on\-demand, secure, and scalable energy distribution and data processing from space. * Leverage understanding of RAS (reliability, availability, serviceability) to improve error reporting and error handling mechanisms for better operation quality and cost/efficiency

* Experience with Python, C/C\+\+ and/or similar languages, within a Linux environment, for server system management, automation, version control, CI/CD, or similar

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**A New Paradigm For Space Operations.**

**Who We Are:**

Space Kinetic is a dual use space technology startup building a completely new architecture for space operations – one that brings the advantages of proliferated drone technology (low\-cost, operationally flexible, attainable, distributed) to space missions while reducing the ecosystem's reliance on consumable fuel. In a world where many companies are focused on incrementally improving the status quo, we are focused on creating something entirely different – an architecture underpinned by new first principles to meet the opportunities and challenges of the third space age head\-on. Our goal is to move away from one\-to\-one space architectures – where each satellite in a constellation has one (or a small \# of) primary payloads attached to the bus \-\- and unlock a ‘one\-to\-many’ system, where each satellite has a large number of payloads which can be deployed from their host spacecraft at high velocities without firing a thruster.

This is not a role for someone looking for a traditional 40\-hour work week. Space Kinetic is building ambitious, first\-of\-its\-kind technology, and that requires urgency, ownership, and a high level of commitment to changing the foundational assumptions for everything we do in space.

**What You’ll Do:**

The **Flight Software Engineer** will design, develop, test, and maintain the software that controls Space Kinetic’s spacecraft. You will work across the full software lifecycle and collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to deliver reliable, mission\-critical software for operation in space.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded flight software for spacecraft control and operations.
* Integrate and validate software in simulation, flight\-replica, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and flight environments.
* Partner with systems, electrical, GNC, test, and mission engineering teams to define software requirements, interfaces, and designs.
* Support spacecraft commissioning, flight operations, anomaly resolution, and software updates following launch.

**What It Takes:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 2 to 3 years of experience developing embedded or real\-time software for space, aerospace, robotics, or other mission\-critical systems.
* Understanding of the software\-development lifecycle, from requirements and design through integration, testing, and operations.
* Working proficiency in C/C\+\+, with knowledge of Python or similar scripting languages for automation and testing.
* Familiarity with RTOS, bare\-metal programming, or Linux\-based embedded systems.
* Understanding of software reliability, deterministic timing, concurrency, and resource management in constrained environments.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

**What We’d Love:**

* Experience with flight software frameworks such as NASA cFS, F´, or custom architectures.
* Familiarity with model\-based systems engineering and interface\-control documentation.
* Knowledge of spacecraft communication protocols such as CCSDS, SpaceWire, or MIL\-STD\-1553\.

**Where You’ll Be:**

* The position is onsite at our headquarters in El Segundo, CA. Domestic travel may be required (up to \~20% of the year).

**What We Offer:** 

* Equity\-Based Compensation
* 401(k) retirement plan with a 3\.5% company match
* Highly Competitive PTO
* Paid company holidays \+ winter break
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Unique Performance\-based bonus opportunities

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. ### **About Lexar**


A leader in memory solutions we deliver best\-in\-class products. For consumers and businesses alike, we have committed ourselves to quality, performance, and customer service. It is our mission to design a broad range of memory solutions focused on high performance, exceptional reliability, and outstanding customer service. Our cutting\-edge products drive higher performance, increase efficiency, and deliver unwavering reliability. ### **About the Role**


We are hiring a senior Linux kernel engineer to work on the core memory\-management pieces of a tiered memory system for Android and embedded Linux devices.
  

  

This role is focused on kernel implementation. You will work in areas such as zram, zswap, swap, cgroups, page fault behavior, block I/O, and storage\-backed memory. The ideal candidate is a strong C developer who enjoys debugging hard kernel problems and validating changes on actual hardware.


### **Primary responsibilities**


* Implement kernel features related to compressed memory, swap, and storage\-backed memory tiers.
* Work with zram and/or zswap paths.
* Add cgroup or memcg\-based memory policy.
* Build low\-overhead kernel counters and instrumentation.
* Debug race conditions, stale data issues, page lifecycle bugs, locking problems, and bio completion behavior.
* Work with Android platform and validation engineers to test changes on real devices.
* Help improve system responsiveness and app retention under memory pressure.

### **Minimum qualifications**


* 6–10 years of Linux kernel, Android kernel, embedded Linux, or low\-level systems experience.
* BS/MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Strong C programming skills.
* Experience debugging kernel code on real hardware.
* Familiarity with Linux memory management, block I/O, device drivers, or kernel concurrency.
* Comfortable with dmesg, sysfs, procfs, ftrace, debug counters, and kernel logs.
* Ability to work carefully in performance\-sensitive and correctness\-sensitive code paths.

### **Preferred qualifications**


* Experience with zram, zswap, swap, reclaim, or memcg.
* Android kernel or GKI module experience.
* UFS, eMMC, NAND, or storage performance experience.
* Experience with per\-CPU counters, workqueues, kthreads, bio/request handling, or blk\-mq.
* Interest in Android memory pressure and app retention behavior.

Building upon the foundation and the credibility of the well\-established Lexar brand, Lexar Enterprise designs and manufactures memory and storage solutions that include embedded storage, mobile memory, solid\-state drives, and memory modules in commercial, industrial, and automotive grades. jobs.title: Autonomy Embedded Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Joby Advanced Development designs, develops, and flight\-tests novel aircraft using a software\-first autonomy approach. We build and deploy autonomy, perception, planning, and radar systems across conventional, electric, and hydrogen\-electric aircraft in both CTOL and VTOL configurations.
Overview:

Joby's Advanced Development group is looking for an engineer to own and grow our hardware\-in\-the\-loop and test\-automation capability for novel aircraft and flight automation systems.  

This role is responsible for the fidelity, coverage, and reliability of the pipeline that allows us to test all new changes to our redundant compute system ahead of deployment.  

You will work closely with the core software team, flight controls, avionics, and flight test engineers who depend on this infrastructure.  

We're looking for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, takes full ownership of infrastructure the whole flight software org relies on, and consistently delivers high\-impact results.
Responsibilities:
* Develop and maintain the test infrastructure, fault injection frameworks and annunciation mechanisms required for in\-the\-loop testing
* Develop software in the loop, hardware in the loop and aircraft in the loop simulation infrastructure: in\-the\-loop scenario runner, simulated peripherals, and per mode configuration
* Bring up, debug, and maintain the physical HITL rigs, and keep rig hardware and configuration matched to the real aircraft they stand in for
* Build and extend hardware\-CI pipelines that deploy flight software to rig hardware and run pass/fail, timing, and platform\-log checks automatically, with results stored for trend tracking
* Write and maintain Bazel\-based C\+\+ and Python scenario and unit tests, including property\-based tests, that exercise the flight software against realistic sensor, actuator, timing, and network\-transport conditions
* Integrate new sensors and actuators into both the simulated and hardware\-in\-the\-loop environments over their native buses (CAN, UART/RS\-485, I2C, SPI, ARINC 429, Ethernet)
* Triage rig and CI failures: separate simulation\-fidelity gaps from rig hardware faults from real flight\-software bugs, and drive each to the right owner with a reproducible case
* Work with flight test and controls engineers to convert observed flight behavior into repeatable in\-the\-loop scenarios, closing the loop between flight data and pre\-flight validation


Required:
* University degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a similar field; or a strong portfolio of embedded / test\-automation software and 5\+ years relevant industry experience
* Strong C\+\+ and Python, and fluency with Git
* Experience building or maintaining hardware in the loop or comparable automated test infrastructure that runs real embedded hardware in CI
* Working knowledge of embedded communication buses (CAN, UART/RS\-485, I2C, SPI, or similar) at the level needed to debug them with a scope or logic analyzer
* Understanding of real\-time and safety\-critical software concepts: deterministic fixed\-rate execution, timing budgets, redundancy, and what makes a test of such a system trustworthy
* Experience with a hermetic build system (Bazel or equivalent) and a CI system (Buildkite, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent)
* Experience with Linux, including remote deployment and debugging on embedded Linux targets
* A passion for clean, long\-lived, and readable object\-oriented software architecture. Not just working code, but code built to survive years of extension by other engineers

 **This position must meet US export control compliance requirements, therefore a candidate must qualify as a “US Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120\.15\. “US Person” includes US Citizens, lawful permanent residents, refugees, or asylees.**
Desired:
* Property\-based testing experience
* Experience with pub/sub or message\-bus middleware for distributed embedded software (DDS, ROS 2, or a custom transport)
* Hands\-on experience with servos, motor controllers, or other actuators on serial or CAN buses
* Experience designing or reviewing simple electrical hardware (PCBs, harnesses, breakout boards) to support test rigs
* Experience analyzing flight or test log data at scale (SQL, Databricks, or similar) to find regressions or derive new test cases
* Rust experience
* Aerospace, automotive, or robotics safety\-critical industry experience

**Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $136,100 \- $202,600/yr****. The compensation package will be determined by job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.** **Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.**
Additional Information:

Joby Aviation is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Continuous Integration
jobs.description:
Zoox is developing state\-of\-the\-art autonomous vehicle software for our purpose\-built robotaxi. We believe that developing this end\-to\-end product will not only help us scale our services but will also result in a superior customer experience.

In this role, you will own the continuous integration systems that every software engineer at Zoox depends on. More than a thousand engineers depend on it every day, running thousands of CI builds every weekday against one of the largest monorepos in the industry. Our goal is to run them fast, reliably, and cost\-efficiently as both the codebase and the organization grow. You will work cross\-functionally with various software teams as a force multiplier, finding where the build is slow or wasteful and fixing it at the platform level. This is a critical role to squash inefficiencies in our development process, improve the development experience for everyone in the software organization, and ultimately help us scale our autonomous vehicle fleet to more riders and more cities.
### **In this role, you will:**

* Own CI performance, cost efficiency, and reliability end\-to\-end, at thousands of builds a day and growing
* Rethink CI failure analysis, triage, developer support, and incident response with modern AI tools, shifting first\-line work off human on\-call
* Work cross\-functionally to find where integration slows down and fix it at the platform level, and enable teams to make their CI efficient and reliable
* Set the technical bar for how CI is built and operated, and mentor the engineers around you

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of software engineering and programming experience, including significant experience in platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling
* Hands\-on experience operating a distributed CI system at scale, Buildkite preferred; Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar
* Working familiarity with a modern build system such as Bazel, and with how caching and remote execution interact with CI
* Solid knowledge of version control systems such as Git
* Self\-driven and motivated with a strong work ethic and passion for problem solving

### **Bonus Qualifications**

* Cloud compute cost analysis and fleet economics (AWS EC2 instance families, spot, right\-sizing)
* Experience dealing with the operational challenges of large monorepos and merge queues
* Experience in "infrastructure as code" tools like Terraform, Helm, and Ansible, and good knowledge of Kubernetes and containers

There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position.

Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.
About Zoox

Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

A Final Note: You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**JOB** **TITLE****:** **Automation Engineer**  

**FLSA:** Exempt position  

**LOCATION:** Fremont, CA (Onsite)  

**SALARY:** $89,000 \- $122,000

  




**Job Summary:**



The Automation Engineer supports the automated production systems on the Quanta Manufacturing Fremont floor including automated assembly lines, robot\-arm cells (such as automated DIMM insertion), and precision equipment. The automation equipment is designed and built by Quanta's headquarters (HQ) automation team and delivered to Fremont, California. This role supports HQ during local setup and site acceptance testing, then manages ongoing system operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvement to keep systems running reliably and meeting cycle\-time and yield targets.



The Engineering Operations team sets up new production capacity and keeps the factory's automated systems running. Its Industrial Engineers handle production and facility planning — defining the space, equipment, and resources each line needs to meet demand — while its Automation Engineers install, operate, maintain, and improve the factory's automated production systems. The team focuses on execution rather than design or development, working closely with cross\-functional partners to keep production running efficiently and meet performance targets.  


**Duties/Responsibilities**  


Support the day\-to\-day operation and performance of automated assembly lines, robot\-arm cells, and precision equipment.

* Monitor system performance (e.g., cycle time) and respond rapidly to equipment downtime or system anomalies to minimize disruption.


* Troubleshoot complex issues at the intersection of hardware, software, and network connectivity, working with cross\-functional teams to resolve them.


* Perform routine preventive maintenance, system backups, and health checks to keep equipment stable.


* Support the installation, setup, and site acceptance testing (SAT) of automation systems delivered from headquarters.
* + Execute light modifications and parameter tuning, for example, calibrating sensors and modifying configurations files to support new product introduction (NPI) and process changes.

	+ Read Ladder Logic to assist in diagnosting PLC\-driven faults and validate changes against process and quality requirements before release.

	+ Coordinate with HQ Engineering and local IT/IT Engineering teams to ensure seamless system communication, software updates, and network integration.

	+ Collaborate with Industrial Engineering and production teams to translate process requirements into system configurations, so automated lines meet cycle\-time and yield targets.

	+ Identify bottlenecks and implement optimization actions to improve system reliability, throughput, and efficiency.

	+ Maintain accurate logs of system issues, root\-cause analysis (RCA), configuration changes, and improvement outcomes.

	+ Train and mentor technicians and operators on basic system operations and first\-line troubleshooting procedures.  


**Competencies**

  





	+ Solid understanding of automated production systems, including precision actuators, servo/stepper motors, pneumatic systems, and industrial sensors.

	+ Proficient with mechanical hand tools (screwdrivers, hex/Allen keys, torque tools) for equipment disassembly, component replacement, and mechanical calibration.

	+ Strong, root\-cause\-oriented problem solving with a practical, hands\-on approach.

	+ Excellent cross\-functional communication to bridge local production, IT, and remote HQ engineering teams.

	+ Ability to read electrical schematics, pneumatic diagrams, and mechanical drawings.

	+ Ability to maintain composure and perform in a fast\-paced, high\-volume manufacturing environment.

	+ Familiarity with PLC concepts and the ability to read Ladder Logic to assist troubleshooting (deep programming not required) is a strong plus.

	+ Experience with vision systems (e.g., Keyence) or robotic\-arm operations is a plus.  


**Education and Experience**




	+ Must have a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related engineering field.

	+ 1\-3 years of experience in manufacturing, automation, or production environments.

	+ Experience working with automated equipment, assembly lines, robotic cells, or precision machinery.

	+ Experience supporting installation, site acceptance testing (SAT), maintenance, or troubleshooting is preferred.

	+ Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-volume manufacturing environments.

	+ Exposure to new product introduction (NPI) processes is a plus.
	+ **Physical Requirements**
	
	  
	
	
	
	
	
		- Regularly required to walk, talk, and hear while performing daily job duties
	
		- Occasionally required to stand, sit, use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, and move within the facility
	
		- May occasionally be required to climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl when accessing equipment or facility areas
	
		- Must be able to lift and/or move up to 30 pounds as needed
	
		- Specific vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer (Perception)
jobs.description:
**About Treeswift:**


In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.


We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.


Since our first pilot with a utility in June 2024, we've grown fast, now working with three of the five largest utilities in the US. To date, our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.


To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission\-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.


We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.


Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

**About the role**


As a senior robotics engineer you will drive outcomes across perception, mapping, sensor fusion and calibration that directly contribute to the expansion of our business. As our business grows these needs will change; first priorities for this role will include:

* **Improving the quality and consistency of our product in an increasing breadth of operating conditions.** For example, you will lead SLAM development including incorporating new sensor evolutions and exploring innovative approaches to improving performance in GPS degraded environments.
* **Accelerating our time to delivery by leveling up our sensor fusion and calibration.** This includes fusing multi\-user, multi\-session point cloud maps and automating alignment of LiDAR and imagery data to produce consistent large\-scale scenes.
* **Power scalability and reliability** by eliminating the need for extrinsic measurements on our vehicle sensors in the field and improving our ability to catch and correct potential data quality issues at their source.
* **This role will be hybrid, with 2\-3 days in office,** based out of our New York, Philadelphia, or San Francisco offices.

**Experience / Skills**

* 5\-10 years of experience in perception for robotics
* Comfortable in a fast\-pace and high\-ownership environment. You’re excited to collaborate, but also comfortable developing your own opinions.
* Proficient in C\+\+ and Python
* Extensive experience developing SLAM solutions, ideally involving ground\-based LiDAR
* Experience with extrinsic and intrinsic sensor calibration, including automated data\-driven calibration
* Prior experience with ultra\-wide angle cameras is a nice\-to\-have

**What We Value**

* **Mission first.** We value team members who are focused on working towards the best outcomes for the customer and the business.
* **Curiosity.** We are constantly learning – from each other and from our customers.. We aren’t afraid to learn we were wrong in the process and adapt our approach accordingly.
* **Owners mindset.** If you see an opportunity for improvement, run with it. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere, no matter your role.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity package
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents
* Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents
* Flexible, unlimited paid time off
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Free OneMedical membership
* Commuter benefits
* Snacks, goodies, and team lunches provided twice a week to keep you fueled and connected with your colleagues.

**Salary**


The estimated salary range for this position is $160,000 \- $210,000 USD. Total compensation for this position is determined by skills, qualifications, relevant work experience, location, and other factors. This salary estimate excludes the value of any potential bonuses; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.


Treeswift is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.


If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Sr Platform Engineer, ML Infrastructure
jobs.description:
We're Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers – farmers, construction crews, and foresters \- to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff – pixel\-by\-pixel and task\-by\-task \- leads to big gains.



Blue River Technology aligns with John Deere's vision to "innovate on behalf of humanity" by quickly identifying and solving high\-value, high\-uncertainty challenges in AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but also new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT and Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs in industries like agriculture and construction.



Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross\-disciplinary collaboration, this mission\-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out. We won't give up until we've made a tangible and positive impact on the planet!



Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA.

  


**Summary**



We are looking for a senior software engineer with a strong background in ML infrastructure and platform engineering who is passionate about building the foundational systems that enable machine learning teams to move faster. Rather than developing ML models, this role focuses on designing scalable platforms, developer tooling, and infrastructure that support the full ML lifecycle across cloud and on\-premises environments.


* **Employment Type**: Full\-Time
* **Work Location**: Remote in the United States.
* **Visa sponsorship** is possible for this position.


**Job Responsibilities**



A combination, not necessarily all\-inclusive, of the following:


* Design, build, and operate scalable ML infrastructure and platform capabilities that support the full machine learning lifecycle across cloud and on\-premises environments.
* Develop developer tooling, services, and infrastructure that enable ML and engineering teams to build, deploy, and operate production systems more efficiently.
* Independently lead complex technical initiatives from problem definition and architecture through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operational ownership.
* Make sound architectural and engineering decisions that balance near\-term delivery with the platform's long\-term scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Build reliable, scalable, easy\-to\-use platform capabilities that improve developer productivity, simplify operations, and help engineering teams move faster.
* Partner closely with ML engineers, infrastructure engineers, and other stakeholders to understand customer needs and translate them into effective platform solutions.
* Identify and solve challenging infrastructure and platform problems, including opportunities to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
* Drive adoption and continuous improvement of platform capabilities by incorporating feedback from the engineering teams that use them.
* Establish a high bar for software quality, operational excellence, and production readiness across the systems and capabilities you own.
* Deliver platform solutions with measurable engineering and business impact across multiple teams and use cases.


**Required Experience and Skills**


* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Strong Python engineering skills, including building production services, SDKs, automation, or platform tooling.
* Experience designing, building, and operating production platform capabilities used by multiple engineering teams.
* Understanding of ML platform architecture and the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle, including experimentation, distributed training, model deployment, and production operations.
* Experience building and operating applications on Kubernetes and cloud platforms (AWS preferred), with an understanding of production reliability, observability, and operational best practices.
* Strong technical judgment with the ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives from discovery through production, collaborating effectively with ML engineers, infrastructure teams, and product stakeholders.


**Preferred Experience and Skills**


* Experiencebuilding developer platforms, tooling, or internal services that improve engineering productivity and reduce operational complexity.
* Experience with workflow orchestration or distributed compute technologies such as Airflow, Kubeflow, Ray, Spark, or similar systems.
* Experience designing and optimizing distributed, GPU\-intensive compute platforms for ML training, inference, or large\-scale image processing.
* Experience supporting production machine learning platforms in computer vision, robotics, or similar domains.
* Demonstrated technical leadership through architecture, mentorship, or influencing technical direction across teams.

  



At Blue River, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected pay range is between $160,000 \- $287,000/year for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and a competitive benefit package. During the recruitment process, we may identify an alternative role or level to which you are more suited.
