Welcome to Lincoln Avenue Communities (LAC)—a leading, mission\-driven real estate private equity firm dedicated to strengthening communities through the development and preservation of affordable housing.


 As a vertically integrated developer, investor, and long\-term operator, we deliver sustainable, high\-quality homes to lower\- and moderate\-income individuals, seniors, and families across 33 states. Our growing portfolio—more than 180 properties and 35,000\+ homes—reflects our commitment to long\-term impact, operational excellence, and resident well\-being.


LAC is proud to be recognized as an industry leader, recently ranked No. 1 on Affordable Housing Finance’s 2025 AHF 50 list of top developers. Our approach combines strategic investment, thoughtful design, and community partnerships to deliver housing solutions that foster stability, opportunity, and resilience.

**About This Role**


As an IT Systems Engineer at LAC, you will be the technical lead of the systems that power our employee experience and secure our corporate environment. You will design, implement, and manage the core infrastructure that our team relies on every day, including our endpoint management platforms, SaaS applications, and identity provider.


This is a technical role for a proactive engineer who is passionate about automation, security, and building scalable, resilient systems. You will be responsible for the IT asset lifecycle, ensuring our hardware and software are managed efficiently, our access controls are robust, and our technology stack is optimized for a modern, fast\-growing company.


This roles reports to a Senior Manager and is a hybrid opportunity (3 days on\-site).

jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


The Controls Engineer independently owns controls workstreams end\-to\-end with general direction. This role designs, validates, and delivers PLC, HMI/SCADA, instrumentation, and controls hardware solutions that meet performance, safety, reliability, and integration requirements. The Controls Engineer makes independent design decisions within assigned scope, contributes to controls standards, and supports deployment and commissioning of linear accelerator and related industrial control systems. This is a full\-time, onsite position at Nusano's facility in Valencia, CA.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the design, specification, schematic capture, programming, installation, qualification, and commissioning of assigned controls workstreams for linear accelerator and supporting industrial systems.
* Design and support electrical control cabinets, instrumentation, power supplies, network devices, and related controls hardware in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Lead troubleshooting of PLCs, network devices, instrumentation, controls hardware, and hardware/software interfaces during build, test, integration, and operations.
* Analyze electrical, data communication, and dynamic systems; conduct trade studies and recommend solutions based on performance, safety, reliability, schedule, and cost.
* Develop prototypes and proof\-of\-concept solutions for new controls hardware or system requirements.
* Participate in hazard analyses and design reviews and apply controls safety best practices.
* Develop test plans, commissioning procedures, operating procedures, system architecture documentation, and maintainable engineering records.
* Coordinate with mechanical engineering, physics, operations, safety, software, and vendors to deliver integrated controls solutions.
* Mentor Associate engineers on tools, standards, and design practices and raise risks or blockers early with clear technical context.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a related technical field.

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. **Group/Division**

The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e\-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high\-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. This is a highly visible technical leadership role with significant influence on product strategy, architecture, and execution. You will help define the future of advanced eBeam inspection systems while partnering with global engineering teams and leading semiconductor customers.

jobs.title: Hardware Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


Great Sky is a technology startup based with a mission to rebuild AI from first principles. We are pursuing neuroscience\-inspired hardware and algorithms that overcome the greatest challenges in scaling AI systems.


**The Role**
------------


We are looking for a Hardware Platform Software Engineer to extend the software platform through which our hardware is operated. Two needs converge here: a hardware abstraction layer (HAL) that translates abstract, model\-level behaviors into concrete operations on real analog hardware, and an experiment framework that lets our scientists and engineers define and execute measurements on our chips with minimal overhead. If you have owned substantial parts of the hardware\-facing software stack for quantum computers, analog accelerators, photonic processors, or large scientific systems, you are likely a good fit for the expectations of this role.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Build an enhanced hardware abstraction layer (HAL): the software layer which translates calls from the AI framework to driver level calls to our physical hardware. This layer enables execution of models, capability discovery, versioning across hardware generations, and parameter translation to a physical mapping on hardware.
* Build a robust experiment framework, so measurement routines are both easy to use and elegantly declared.
* Provide the analysis pipelines, capturing maximum value from every inference and measurement.
* Present a unified API for both simulated and physical backends. Interfacing this API to our existing simulation framework for verification and parity testing.
* Define and maintain the middleware between the driver layer and the AI frameworks. Introducing telemetry, diagnostics, and regression testing that keep the platform trustworthy across hardware revisions.

**What Success Looks Like in the First Year**
---------------------------------------------

* A v1 HAL is in production use: our AI frameworks execute models on real hardware exclusively through your interface
* Clear, documented contracts exist at both boundaries of the layer, validated by automated tests.
* Our engineers leverage your framework for efficient design and execution of key measurement routines.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field (or equivalent experience),
* 5\+ years of professional software engineering for control of real physical hardware (e.g., quantum control stacks, novel accelerators, photonic systems, scientific instrumentation, embedded systems, or comparable platforms).
* Demonstrated ownership of an API or abstraction layer that other engineers used: you have designed interfaces, defended their boundaries, and evolved them
* Superior proficiency in Python and working proficiency in at least one systems language (e.g., C, C\+\+, or Rust).
* Hands\-on experience orchestrating lab instrumentation in software (e.g., SCPI instruments, DAQs, AWGs, cameras, motion stages, or cryogenic systems)
* Strong testing instincts: unit, integration, and regression testing, hardware\-in\-the\-loop test design, and simulation/hardware parity testing.
* Excellent technical writing and communication: high\-quality architecture and interface documentation, and the ability to negotiate contracts across disciplines.

**Preferred**:

* Experience with runtime or compiler\-adjacent layers for novel accelerators.
* Familiarity with superconducting electronics, photonics, or cryogenic systems.
* Experience with streaming or high\-throughput data systems (video, RF, DAQ)
* Familiarity with neural networks and ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX

**Growth Opportunities**
------------------------


You will begin as the sole owner of this software layer: a rare degree of technical ownership over critical infrastructure. As our hardware scales to large multi\-chip systems and our platform matures toward production workloads, the scope and sophistication of this layer will grow substantially. The ideal candidate will grow with it: defining the platform software roadmap, setting engineering standards, mentoring other engineers, and building and leading a dedicated platform software team.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

* Meaningful equity ownership in an early\-stage deep tech company
* Employer\-matched 401(k)
* Health, dental, vision, and life insurance
* Flexible PTO
* Support for ongoing learning, conference attendance, and skill development


Our culture is onsite by default (we're founded by scientists who are used to working in the lab), with flexibility for hybrid arrangements. For the right person and role, we're open to filling roles remotely


Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.description:

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on\-orbit software that powers our core products. This is responsible for monitoring and control of major space program elements, including:
* Flight Products computational environments (including physical and virtual processors);
* Interfaces with external equipment (imagers, RF, ISL); and
* Interfaces with the spacecraft bus.

The Core Services team is responsible for high\-level vehicle services and functions, including file transfer, time synchronization, automation, scheduling, attitude control, and navigation. Many of these services are reused across all satellite programs and form the foundation of our onboard architecture.

* Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving impactful features from concept through delivery while ensuring robustness and reliability.
* Review code, provide clear feedback, and enforce adherence to established development processes, style guides, and design standards to maintain consistency and quality across the codebase.
* Design and implement unit tests for both self\-authored and peer\-authored code.
* Utilize version control systems to create feature branches, push code, and merge approved code into production branches.
* Contribute to the onboard software architecture through design proposals and collaborative review
* Participate in the review and enhancement of software development processes and design standards.
* Coordinate with downstream teams on the release, distribution and adoption of latest releases.
* In addition to responsibilities within onboard software, you’ll have the opportunity to directly be involved in operating our on\-orbit fleet of satellites.

* Experience with version control systems such as Git

* Experience with build systems (e.g., Make, CMake).
* Understanding of distributed architecture.
* Familiarity with networking protocols (e.g., UDP, TCP, IP) and POSIX standards.
* Experience in developing multi\-threaded applications.

* Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family\-forming benefits with financial support

### **Job Summary**

Design, analyze, build, and test the electronics behind space science missions.


At the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics (LASP), electrical engineers develop custom flight and ground electronics for scientific instruments and spacecraft exploring Earth, the Sun, the Moon, planets, and the wider universe. We are seeking a senior electrical hardware engineer who enjoys hands\-on circuit design and can carry high\-reliability electronics from requirements and schematic capture through PCB implementation, board bring\-up, environmental qualification, and system integration.


This position requires you to be a motivated, largely self\-directed individual contributor with capabilities to also lead a small electrical design team. You will work within a multidisciplinary mission team, make and document consequential hardware decisions, and provide technical direction to keep the electrical design effort moving forward. You will often be the responsible engineer for a circuit\-card assembly or instrument electrical subsystem, but people management is not the focus of the position.



CU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.
### **Who We Are**

LASP combines the agility of a university laboratory with the technical capability of a premier space mission organization. Engineers work directly alongside scientists, students, and mission operators, allowing technical decisions to move quickly while maintaining scientific excellence.

  

As part of the University of Colorado Boulder (CU), LASP began in 1948 and is a world\-recognized space science research institute that implements the full life cycle of science missions from the definition of the science questions through the development of space flight hardware and the subsequent mission operations. We are the only research institute in the world to have sent science instruments to all eight planets, Pluto, and beyond the solar system.  

  

LASP combines all aspects of space exploration through our expertise in science, engineering, mission operations, and scientific data analysis. As part of CU, LASP also works to educate and train the next generation of space scientists, engineers and mission operators by integrating undergraduate and graduate students into working teams. Our students take their unique experiences with them into government or industry or remain in academia to continue the cycle of exploration.


### **What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be**

* Focused design in at least one area of discipline including analog, mixed\-signal, power, motor\-control, embedded, and high\-speed digital electronics for spaceflight instruments and small spacecraft. You should have deep experience in at least one of these areas.
* Develop electrical requirements, interfaces, architecture, grounding, power and performance budgets, fault\-management concepts, and verification plans with systems, FPGA, software, mechanical, thermal, science, manufacturing, quality, parts, and radiation engineers.
* Capture schematics in Altium Designer, guide and review PCB layout, and release circuit\-card assembly (PCBA) design data for fabrication and assembly.
* Select EEE parts; complete derating, worst\-case, reliability, and circuit\-performance analyses; and model designs using LTspice, PSpice, Ansys, or comparable simulation tools.
* Bring up and debug new hardware in the laboratory, support EMI and EMC, thermal\-vacuum, vibration, and other environmental tests, investigate anomalies, and integrate electronics with instruments or spacecraft.
* Prepare and present design decisions, technical risks, verification results, and readiness evidence at internal design reviews and mission milestone reviews. Provide technical leadership and mentoring within small project teams.
* Other Duties Assigned


The engineer who will thrive here


You can move between schematic design, PCB review, circuit analysis, laboratory troubleshooting, supplier conversations, and project decisions without losing the technical thread. You communicate assumptions and residual risk plainly, work well across disciplines, and build the documentation and configuration discipline required for reproducible, reviewable flight hardware. Your experience allows you to work day\-to\-day with minimal direction and you are excited to mentor early career engineers and student engineering assistants.

* Because this position requires access to export\-controlled information, applicants must be U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or other protected individuals as defined by applicable U.S. export\-control laws.
* The work requires regular onsite presence in Boulder for flight hardware, laboratory work, and integration. Casual remote work 1 or 2 days per week is possible with project approval.

jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**


Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.


##### **About The Role**


Peraton is seeking incumbent and external qualified candidates to support North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD) Cheyene Mountain Complex (NCMC) – Integrated Tactical Warning/Attack Assessment (NCMC\-ITW/AA) and Space Support Contract III (NISSC III).

  

***Please note that this is contingent upon contract award***

  

Qualified candidates will help operate, maintain, and sustain critical national mission systems to deliver resilient strategic threat warning and space capabilities as part of a world\-wide architecture, providing strategic warning that our nation depends on during a conflict. This program will provide an opportunity to exploit the capabilities inherent in our diverse national systems to better meet the needs of the national command authority and warfighters to detect, track, and respond to strategic threats through 2030 and beyond

This is an hourly position where you will be used to augment LASP's full time professional staff's capacity by supporting a variety of our technology development programs including rocket missions, technology demonstrators, and small satellites.



CU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.
### **Who We Are**

Founded a decade before NASA, the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics (LASP) at the University of Colorado Boulder is revolutionizing human understanding of the cosmos. LASP is deeply committed to inspiring and educating the next generation of space explorers. From enabling the first exploratory rocket measurements of Earth’s upper atmosphere to trailblazing observations of every planet in the solar system, LASP is at the forefront of solar, planetary and space physics research, space\-weather monitoring, and the search for evidence of habitable worlds.


LASP advances scientific discovery and inspires the next generation through research, innovation, and education in space sciences. We employ over 700 scientists, engineers, support personnel, and students that work closely to cultivate creative ideas and explore novel solutions to make the impossible possible.


LASP is dedicated to building and maintaining a unique synergism of expertise in space science, engineering, and spacecraft operations. Through research projects, LASP participates actively in the training of the future leaders of space research and helps the University of Colorado to educate students with valued technical and scientific skills. Development and use of innovative technologies and continuing participation in new research initiatives ensures a strong leadership role for LASP into the future. LASP is proud of our work environment that supports employee creativity and productivity and offers opportunities for a broad range of experiences. Further information about LASP can be found here: https://lasp.colorado.edu/home/.

* Support scientists and full\-time engineering team through the development of next generation space instrument electronics
* Consult with instrument scientists and engineers to convert measurement objectives into hardware design requirements
* Develop electronic subsystems for detector readout, power distribution, data processing, and instrument control
* Perform EEE part selection and derating to meet project environmental requirements
* Develop and build test GSE
* Design and develop documentation for the assembly and test of printed wire board assemblies (PWBA)
* Other duties as assigned.


### **What You Should Know**

* This position will regularly handle export controlled and other CUI level information.
* Due to the nature of spaceflight hardware development, presence on\-site is regularly required during system test and debugging phases


### **What We Can Offer**

Hourly Rate: $70 \- $91


### **Benefits**

At the University of Colorado Boulder, we are committed to supporting the holistic health and well\-being of our employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and retirement plans; generous paid time off; tuition assistance for you and your dependents; and an ECO Pass for local transit. As one of Boulder County’s largest employers, CU Boulder offers an inspiring academic community and access to world\-class outdoor recreation. In fact, CU Boulder has been named one of Forbes' America's Best Large Employers, ranking \#4 among large employers in Colorado and \#28 among universities nationwide. Explore additional perks and programs through the CU Advantage program.


### **Be Statements**

Be ambitious. Be groundbreaking. Be Boulder.

The D440 SSN Payload Launch Control department is responsible for systems, hardware, test, and project engineering for the design, development, and qualification of payload launch control and handling systems and components supporting VIRGINIA, SSNX, and AUKUS class submarines and other payload platforms. ---------------------------

As an Electrical Engineer within the Test Measurement \& Facilities (TMF) organization, you will specify, design, develop, integrate, and validate electrical systems, test infrastructure, and measurement solutions that enable product development, qualification, reliability testing, and troubleshooting across ASML programs. Working in a multi\-disciplinary environment, you will collaborate closely with system architects, software and mechanical engineers, suppliers, and customers to deliver innovative test and measurement capabilities that support both current and next\-generation technologies.


You will be responsible for delivering robust electrical designs and test solutions within system specifications, cost targets, and project schedules. This includes development of instrumentation, controls, automation, data acquisition systems, and laboratory infrastructure required to support engineering development, product validation, and operational excellence. The Electrical Engineer provides discipline\-specific expertise throughout the entire product lifecycle, including concept feasibility, new product introduction, product sustainment, reliability investigations, and customer\-facing problem resolution.


Engineers at this level are expected to lead complex technical design work within their discipline or own module\-level areas requiring contributions from multiple engineers. They work autonomously on complex tasks with limited guidance, balancing technical quality with timely delivery while interfacing effectively with suppliers, customers, and cross\-functional stakeholders. The role requires highly motivated, organized, and self\-driven individuals with strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for delivering reliable, accurate, and efficient test solutions.

***Design:***

* Analog and Digital Circuit Design
* Printed Circuit Board Design
* AC and DC Power Distribution Design
* Interlock \& Safety Circuit Design and Programable Logic Controller (PLC) Design
* Interconnect Cables and Harness Design
* Electronic Racks, Cabinets, Boxes and Control Console Design
* Perform Root Cause Analysis: Troubleshooting from System to Component Level

Technical Writing: Define and Document Specifications and Design Decisions  

*

* Identify, analyze, document, and manage requirements with traceability, and coordinate verification criteria to confirm deliverables meet intent.

Maintain accurate technical documentation, share knowledge through coaching and mentoring as applicable, and follow EHS policies while identifying and mitigating safety risks.  

*

----------------------------

* Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering.

jobs.title: SATCOM Systems Engineer (Hybrid- Aberdeen, Maryland)
jobs.description:
**SATCOM Systems Engineer**

**Location:** Aberdeen Proving Ground (APG), MD  

**Type:** Hybrid3x a week in office. Business necessity may require to 4\-5 days in offce as needed.

 **About Fairwinds Technologies**


Fairwinds Technologies is a U.S.\-based engineering firm specializing in Satellite Communications (SATCOM), RF Transmission Systems, Network Design, Systems Integration, and Digital Signal Processing (DSP). We support Command, Control, Communications, and Computer (C4\) systems in austere military environments, delivering advanced communications, networking, and IT solutions to defense and civilian agencies worldwide.

**Position Overview**


We are seeking an experienced SATCOM Systems Engineer to serve as the technical lead on development programs focused on RF and SATCOM systems integration. Fairwinds develops components and subsystems that integrate with or enhance existing RF architecture such as SATCOM terminals, modems, and associated ground equipment and this engineer will be at the center of that integration effort. The ideal candidate has a strong background in DoD SATCOM systems, a solid grasp of the military standards governing satellite terminals and modems, and hands\-on experience with commercial SATCOM modem platforms across C, X, Ku, and Ka frequency bands.


This role requires a technically confident leader who can bridge systems\-level architecture with day\-to\-day engineering execution—generating systems engineering artifacts, coordinating with the Program Manager on work breakdown structures, and directing the work of a cross\-functional development team. The engineer will collaborate closely with test, embedded software, DSP, and FPGA engineers to ensure SATCOM systems and Fairwinds\-developed components are properly designed, characterized, verified, and delivered.


This position reports to the Chief Technology \& Strategy Office and involves close collaboration with customers and engineering teams to deliver innovative solutions for RF Tactical \& Naval Military Solutions, as well as strategic border protection applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the technical lead for a cross\-functional development team, providing day\-to\-day technical direction and assigning daily and weekly engineering tasks.
* Collaborate with the Program Manager on Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) definition, task scheduling, and resource allocation to support program milestones.
* Author and maintain systems engineering documents throughout the program lifecycle, including but not limited to: system requirements documents, design documents, block diagrams, RF link cascades, and hardware and software Interface Control Documents (ICDs).
* Lead systems\-level architecture and integration efforts for Fairwinds\-developed components that integrate with or enhance existing SATCOM terminals, modems, and RF ground architectures.
* Support design, integration, and testing of Fairwinds solutions into DoD SATCOM C, X, Ku, and Ka terminals.
* Apply MIL\-STD\-188\-164B (SATCOM terminals) and MIL\-STD\-188\-165B (SATCOM modems) to system design, compliance verification, and configuration activities.
* Assist test engineers with the development of Test Plans and Test Procedures for SATCOM systems.
* Assist test engineers with the development of automated test scripts using Python.
* Collaborate with DSP and FPGA engineers on signal processing aspects of SATCOM
* Basic understanding of FPGAs and signal processing concepts as they relate to SATCOM waveform processing.
* Perform system\-level analysis and produce technical documentation of SATCOM architectures and configurations.
* Support system integration activities in both lab and field environments.
* Lead and participate in design reviews, technical exchanges, system demos, and customer meetings.
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of experience working with DoD SATCOM systems in a design, integration, or systems engineering capacity.
* Demonstrated experience as a technical lead or systems lead on a multi\-disciplinary engineering team, including task assignment and cross\-functional coordination.
* Experience working with a Program Manager on WBS development, scheduling, and milestone tracking.
* Proficiency producing systems engineering documentation: requirements documents, design documents, block diagrams, RF cascade analyses, and hardware/software ICDs.
* Working knowledge of MIL\-STD\-188\-164B (SATCOM Terminals) and MIL\-STD\-188\-165B (SATCOM Modems).
* Hands\-on experience with SATCOM modems: iDirect, Comtech, and/or ViaSat.
* Strong understanding of C, X, Ku, and Ka band satellite systems, including link characteristics and operational differences across frequency bands.
* Basic understanding of FPGAs and signal processing concepts as they apply to SATCOM waveform processing.
* Experience supporting test engineers with the development of Test Plans and Test Procedures.
* Basic understanding of Python for test automation, scripting, and data analysis.
* Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, interface specifications, and system diagrams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear technical documentation and effectively communicate with both technical teams and program stakeholders.
* U.S. Citizenship and active DoD Secret clearance.
**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating internally developed RF or signal processing components into SATCOM terminal or modem architectures.
* Familiarity with SATCOM link budget analysis and RF system performance calculations.
* Experience with Line\-of\-Sight (LOS) radio systems and waveforms from Silvus Technologies or L3 Harris.
* Basic understanding of networking fundamentals: IP configuration, routers, and switches in SATCOM modem network environments.
* Experience with automated test framewo

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**Embedded Firmware Engineer**

ARCO is seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our engineering team and help develop intelligent power\-management products for the marine, RV, and mobile\-power industries.

This is a hands\-on embedded development role focused primarily on C/C\+\+ firmware development. You will help maintain and improve the firmware behind our Zeus Alternator Control System, develop new features for existing products, and contribute to R\&D and firmware architecture for future products.

We are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to the hardware and enjoys solving real\-world embedded systems problems involving firmware, electronics, communications, sensors, and control systems.

**What You’ll Do**

· Develop, maintain, and improve embedded firmware in C and C\+\+.

· Design and implement new features for existing and future products.

· Troubleshoot firmware and hardware using debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, CAN tools, and other test equipment.

· Develop firmware involving CAN Bus, BLE, SPI, I²C, UART, ADCs, PWM, sensors, and nonvolatile memory.

· Develop and improve control algorithms for power\-management and electrical systems.

· Participate in new\-product R\&D, prototyping, hardware bring\-up, and design validation.

· Diagnose and resolve field and production issues involving embedded electronics.

· Improve code quality, architecture, reliability, performance, and maintainability.

· Support firmware release, testing, manufacturing, and production\-test processes.

· Participate in code reviews and maintain clear technical documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

· 3–7 years of embedded firmware development experience.

· Strong proficiency in embedded C/C\+\+.

· Experience with ARM\-based microcontrollers or similar embedded platforms.

· Experience with embedded peripherals and interfaces such as CAN, SPI, I²C, UART, PWM, ADCs, timers, interrupts, and GPIO.

· Ability to read electrical schematics and understand hardware/firmware interactions.

· Experience debugging embedded systems with laboratory and development tools.

· Working knowledge of Git or similar version\-control systems.

· Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

· CAN Bus, SAE J1939, or NMEA 2000

· Nordic nRF52 / nRF52840

· Bluetooth Low Energy

· ESP32 or Microchip/Atmel SAMD devices

· PID or closed\-loop control systems

· Power electronics, battery charging, alternators, motor control, or energy\-management systems

· Bootloaders and firmware\-update systems

· Python for engineering or test automation

· Hardware\-in\-the\-loop or manufacturing test systems

· Marine, RV, automotive, or industrial electronics

**Who We’re Looking For**

The ideal candidate is a firmware engineer who enjoys working on the entire embedded system—not just writing code.

You should be comfortable connecting a debugger or oscilloscope, reading a schematic, analyzing CAN traffic, troubleshooting a prototype, and digging into firmware until you understand why the system is behaving the way it is.

This position offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of production firmware while also contributing directly to the development of new products and technologies.

jobs.description:

---------------


At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.**Please note that this opportunity is contingent on program funding. Start dates are determined after funding confirmation**.  



  

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems is currently seeking a **Cyber Systems Engineer** or **Principal Cyber Systems Engineer** to join our team of qualified, diverse individuals in our Systems Engineering organization. This role is located in **Melbourne, FL.**

  

In this role, you will be responsible for System Security Engineering across all phases of a system’s acquisition / development lifecycle. The successful candidate will use good systems engineering practices to develop and deliver secure system architecture implementations based on DoD, National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Committee on National Security Systems Instruction (CNSSI), and Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes, policies and guidelines. Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic work environment. Essential functions include:

 **Essential Functions:**

* Verify and validate system level cybersecurity requirements to support successful system sell\-off
* Maintain awareness of and provide SSE input to subsystem\-level cybersecurity architectures to ensure seamless integration into system level architectures
* Support ongoing authorization efforts including briefing authorization status and development of supporting documentation in coordination with internal and external stakeholders
* Develop cybersecurity architecture and associated documentation in support of required system capability
* Serve as a technical liaison to internal and external teams in support of program activities requiring SSE subject matter expertise
* Prepare technical documents, provide briefings, attend security\-related working groups, support ongoing authorization efforts including development of supporting documentation, develop procedures, and work in a fast\-changing dynamic environment with minimal direction
* Perform other System Security Engineering (SSE) duties as assigned

  

This role can be filled at either the Engineer or Principal Engineer Level based on the qualifications below.

 **Basic Qualifications:**

  

At an Engineer Level:

* Must have a Bachelors of Science degree in a STEM field and at least 2 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a Master's Degree in a STEM field and at least some of relevant military / professional / academic experience

  

At a Principal Engineer Level:

* Must have a Bachelors of Science degree in a STEM field and at least 5 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a Master's Degree in a STEM field and at least 3 years of relevant military / professional experience, OR a PhD and at least 1 year of relevant military / professional / academic experience

  

At Both Levels:

* Must have familiarity with DoD System Security Engineering activities (security requirements engineering, risk assessment and management, secure architecture design, implementation and verification activities)
* Must have an active US Government Secret or higher clearance (with a background investigation completed within the last 6 years or currently enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).
* Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs.
* Must have a DODD 8140\.01 qualifying certification, such as CompTIA Security\+, CISSP, or similar network/security certifications

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with, and providing oversight and guidance to, different IPTs and Suppliers/Subcontractors in support of design development, implementation, and test/verification activities
* Experience with developing, executing, and managing Program Protection, Supply Chain Risk, and Counterfeit Parts Prevention plans as well as performing Criticality Analysis of system components
* Risk Management Framework (RMF), development of System Security Plans, Assessment Reports, attack path modeling, and mitigation strategies
* Experience with embedded computing environments and technologies
* Experience with cloud computing environments and technologies
* Experience with Model Based Systems Engineering tools such as Cameo or other similar system modeling tools
* Experience applying agile methodologies to the development of cybersecurity capabilities for embedded systems.
* Experience working on a multidisciplinary team and writing technical proposals
* Excellent communication, interpersonal skills, and the ability to interface with all levels of employees and management
* Familiarity with U.S Government Anti\-Tamper (AT) processes and implementations
* Ability to obtain a US Government Top Secret security clearance to include a Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI)

jobs.title: Aircraft Survivability Equipment Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Aircraft Survivability Equipment Software Engineer**The Opportunity:**


Aircraft survivability equipment and countermeasures systems are critical technologies that provide the last line of defense for U.S. and allied pilots flying missions in harm’s way. Booz Allen needs your skills and dedication to protecting our military aviators through the research and development of next generation aircraft countermeasures systems and capabilities. You will play an integral role in designing, developing, testing, and fielding the complex hardware and software involved to deliver exceptional battlefield overmatch.

  

In this role, you will apply your skills in software development, software\-hardware interactions, test equipment programming, and hardware emulation and develop expertise in how these technologies interact to deliver critical defense system capabilities.

  

You will work on currently fielded aircraft survivability equipment, including the air countermeasures dispensing system and its associated software, hardware, and test fixtures. You will also develop software, configure hardware, and perform testing to confirm system performance.

  

If you want to solve real\-world challenges and lead mission\-critical engineering for key aviation clients, there’s a place for you here. At Booz Allen, you’ll make a difference with us, and, in return, we’ll invest in your future.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

 **You Have:**

* 1\+ years of experience performing research, engineering, or technical support to U.S military systems such as aircraft systems, avionics systems, or countermeasures dispensing systems
* Experience in software and firmware programming languages such as C, C\+\+, 8051 Assembly, Python, or ADA
* Experience working as part of an engineering team, communicating and thinking critically about mission objectives, and identifying potential development pathways that could meet program needs
* Knowledge of hardware emulation systems, test equipment, and development of test plans, scripts, software, or hardware
* Ability to apply modern software development best practices and techniques to develop and configure software, analyze and resolve bugs and defects, and develop associated technical manuals and codebase documentation
* Ability to be motivated to learn and develop expertise in avionics and aircraft survivability equipment and demonstrate commitment to the mission
* Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Science

 **Nice If You Have:**

* Experience performing software, hardware, or test development on the ALE\-47 countermeasure dispensing system
* Experience providing technical support to Foreign Military Sales ALE\-47 operators
* Ability to demonstrate a high degree of professionalism
* Secret clearance

 **Clearance:**  

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

jobs.title: Industrial Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking an **Industrial Robotics Software Engineer** to develop advanced automation solutions that integrate software, industrial robotics, machine vision, and sensor technologies. This role combines C\# software development, robotic path planning, computer vision, and automation system integration.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop rapid prototypes and perform feasibility studies for robotic automation applications.
* Design, develop, test, and support software applications using **C\#, .NET, WPF, and MVVM**.
* Develop software and communication interfaces for **Fanuc and other 6\-axis industrial robots**.
* Create libraries and APIs for interfacing with external devices and sensors, including cameras, laser profilometers, ultrasonic probes, PLCs, motor controllers, and digital I/O systems.
* Develop and optimize robotic path planning, motion control, collision avoidance, and offline programming tools.
* Implement computer vision solutions using stereo vision, image processing, and 3D object localization technologies.
* Develop calibration processes for robotic cells, tooling, and workpiece positioning.
* Evaluate and validate the performance, accuracy, and feasibility of sensors, vision systems, and motion planning algorithms.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to commission, troubleshoot, and continuously improve automated systems.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in **C\#** and object\-oriented software development.
* Experience with **.NET, Dependency Injection, WPF, and MVVM** architecture.
* Experience with development tools such as **Visual Studio** and **Git**.
* Knowledge of **linear algebra, trigonometry**, and applied mathematics for robotics applications.
* Experience with or strong familiarity with **6\-axis industrial robots** (Fanuc, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, or similar).
* Experience with robotic motion control, path planning, and collision avoidance concepts.
* Knowledge of machine vision and image processing tools such as **OpenCV, Cognex, or Keyence**.
* Experience integrating sensors, PLCs, motor control systems, and industrial communication devices.
* Familiarity with CAD/CAM, robotic simulation, or offline programming software is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.


This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining software development, robotics, computer vision, and automation technologies to solve complex manufacturing and industrial challenges.

**The Company:**


Viable Engineering Solutions is a world\-class concept\-to\-completion center for the industrial market. We take Research and Development to the next level providing rapid prototyping, robotics, automation, and non\-destructive testing solutions in our state\-of\-the\-art concept\-to\-completion facility. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Senior -Security Clearance Eligibility Required
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------


AVT Simulation is a leading provider of advanced virtual training solutions for the defense and aerospace industries. We specialize in developing cutting\-edge simulators and training systems that enhance operational readiness and improve training outcomes. As we continue to expand our operations, we are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to join our team in Orlando, Florida.  

  

As a Senior Electrical Engineer at AVT Simulation, you will be responsible for the design, development, and integration of electrical systems and components for our advanced training simulators. You will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of engineers and subject matter experts to create innovative solutions that meet customer requirements and drive the success of our training systems.**Responsibilities/Duties/Functions/Tasks**
-------------------------------------------

* Electrical System Design: Utilize your expertise in electrical engineering principles to design, analyze, and optimize electrical systems and components for AVT simulators. This includes developing electrical schematics, conducting circuit analysis, selecting appropriate components, and ensuring compliance with relevant industry standards.
* System Integration: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of electrical systems with other subsystems, such as mechanical, software, and simulation hardware. Conduct thorough testing and validation of integrated systems to ensure functionality and performance.
* Requirements Analysis: Work closely with customers, project managers, and subject matter experts to understand and translate user requirements into technical specifications for electrical systems. Conduct feasibility studies and trade\-off analyses to determine the most effective and efficient design approach.
* Hardware Development: Design and oversee the development of custom circuit boards, wiring harnesses, power systems, and other electrical components. Coordinate with external suppliers and manufacturers to ensure timely and accurate production of electrical hardware.
* Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and maintain detailed engineering documentation, including electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, specifications, test plans, and technical reports. Communicate project status, risks, and make recommendations to stakeholders.
* Quality Assurance: Adhere to industry standards, best practices, and regulatory requirements throughout the design and development process. Implement robust quality control measures to ensure the reliability, safety, and performance of electrical systems.
* Troubleshooting and Maintenance: Identify and resolve electrical issues during system development, integration, and testing. Provide technical support for ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting of deployed simulators.
* Leadership and Mentorship: Provide leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering their professional development, and promoting a collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Installation and Instruction: Travel required to customer locations to construct, test, deliver simulators, and train customers on their operation, system maintenance, and trouble shooting.

### **Other Duties**


Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for the job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelors in electrical engineering or a related field.
* Proven experience (typically 8\+ years) in electrical engineering, with a focus on designing and developing electrical systems and components. Experience in the defense or aerospace industry is highly desirable.Priorexperience with simulation systems or similar complex systems is a significant advantage.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in electrical design software, such as Altium Designer and AutoCAD Electrical. Strong knowledge of electrical engineering principles, digital and analog circuit design, and power distribution systems. Familiarity with simulation software and virtual reality technologies is beneficial.
* Analytical and Problem\-Solving Abilities: Ability to analyze complex problems, evaluate alternatives, and develop practical solutions. Strong attention to detail and a systematic approach to troubleshooting electrical issues.
* Communication and Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment, collaborating with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Adaptability and Flexibility: Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. Willingness to adapt to changing priorities and take on new challenges.

### **Essential Mental Requirements**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent decision\-making skills.
* Must be able to work effectively on a team.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Location:** Pearl Harbor, HI (PRLH)  

**Alternate Locations:** Whidbey Island (WHDB) or Norfolk, VA (NRFK)  

  

**Position Summary**  

  

Ulu HI\-Tech seeking a highly skilled **System****s** **Engineer****Mi****d** to support a large\-scale, globally distributed enterprise network environment supporting mission\-critical Department of Defense operations. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise across LAN/WAN/WLAN, network boundary engineering, routing, switching, network security, and Tier III troubleshooting.  

  

In this role, you will provide advance engineering, integration, troubleshooting, and operational support for enterprise network infrastructure, serving as a technical lead and Tier III escalation resource for complex network challenges. You will work alongside senior engineers, cybersecurity professionals, and program stakeholders to maintain, enhance, and secure one of the world's largest intranet environments.

**What You'll Do:**

**Enterprise Network Engineering**

* Lead efforts to identify, troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve complex network issues in a dynamic enterprise environment.
* Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network infrastructure, including switches, routers, VLANs, wireless access points (APs), firewalls, and network sensors.
* Provide engineering expertise and operational support for one of the world's largest intranet environments.
* Act as a Tier III escalation resource for complex incidents, including coordinating with vendors as necessary for incident resolution.
* Act as an SME and technical backstop for troubleshooting efforts involving multiple network disciplines and teams of CCNP/CCIE\-level engineers.
* Apply extensive knowledge of defense\-in\-depth principles to secure enterprise network infrastructure.

* Troubleshoot technologies and protocols including routing, switching, SD\-WAN, WLAN, MPLS, VPNs, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, switching protocols, and multicast.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering and operations teams to enhance network availability, performance, reliability, and security.
* Develop and maintain Engineering Implementation Plans (EIPs) supporting network changes and deployments.
* Create and manage change management tickets for deployments, maintenance activities, upgrades, and other network changes.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) in support of problem management activities and recurring incident resolution.
* Participate in engineering, architecture, and project meetings to design and develop future enterprise network solutions.
* Track engineering and operational work within an Agile/SAFe framework using JIRA.
* Participate in Daily Stand\-Ups (DSUs), retrospectives, Program Increment (PI) activities, and other Agile ceremonies.

* Ensure configuration changes are properly documented, peer\-reviewed, approved, and backed up to a centralized repository.
* Maintain change\-tracking and rollback capabilities to support operational resilience and configuration recovery.
* Ensure network configurations remain compliant with applicable DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and organizational cybersecurity policies.
**Lab Testing \& Pre\-Production Validation**

* Conduct pre\-production validation testing for firmware upgrades, configuration changes, and security patches before deployment to production networks.
* Perform testing within an isolated lab environment designed to mirror applicable production network topology and configurations.
* Validate network functionality, security policies and controls, device interoperability, performance against established baselines, and deployment/rollback procedures.
* Document testing results, identified risks, remediation requirements, and deployment recommendations prior to production implementation.

* Bachelor's degree with 8–12 years of relevant professional experience; or
* Master's degree with 6–10 years of relevant professional experience.

**Security Clearance**

* **Must be Top Secret eligible.**

* Equivalent qualifying certification
* Current networking certification such as:
	+ CCNA

We are seeking a Control Systems Engineer to join our federal team in Oahu, HI. As part of a Fortune 500 company and one of the global leaders in sustainability and energy efficiency, the Johnson Controls Federal Systems (JCFS) team is a specialized team serving as a trusted partner to the federal government. We help modernize U.S. military installations, Department of Defense and other federal agency facilities to be smarter, more resilient, efficient, sustainable, and secure with our building technologies and solutions.
  
  

**Location:** Oahu, HI.
  
**Benefits:** Eligible for benefits on first day of employment
  
**Vacation:** 3 weeks of paid vacation, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays, and 10 standard holidays per calendar year
  
**Travel Required:** Limited
  
  

**As a Control Systems Engineer, you will:**  

* Design, configure and program HVAC building automation and control systems (direct digital controls) and create sequence of operations. Creates flow diagrams, sequence of operations, bill of materials, network layouts and electrical schematics as required
* Develop and test software programs to operate the system
* Support technicians by ensuring the quality, timeliness and efficiency of designs
* Commission and troubleshoot building control system
* Coordinate drawings and equipment schedules to include in detailed information and submittal packages that communicate design and operation to customers, consultants, field installation team and subcontractors
* May help support the pre\-sales engineering process; cost estimating \& sales support, performing pre\-design site survey, designing control system shop drawing submittals, generating product literature submittals
* Coordinate factory\-mounting processes to meet factory and project schedule
* Help load and commission system\-level and network\-level controllers
* Validate complete system functionality
* Provide field change information to the project team for as\-built drawings (Visio/CAD) and software
* Keep management, contractors, and customer informed of job progress and issues
* Provide site\-specific training for owner/operator on the total building control system


**Required Qualifications:**  

* Proficiency and experience working with Direct Digital Control (DDC) systems, preferably with programming, configuration, visualization, and integration. 5\+ years experience preferred
* Demonstrated knowledge of control theory, automatic temperature controls, building automation systems and other building subsystems
* Experience working with design packages and submittals
* Advanced computer skills, particularly with computer\-related drafting tools. AutoCad and/or Visio experience preferred
* Must be able to obtain and maintain required security clearances (background/character, criminal history, employment, and credit checks)


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Integration experience with low voltage building sub\-systems using various industry protocols (i.e. LON, BACnet, Modbus, etc.)
* Working with Metasys or Tridium Niagara Direct Digital Control (DDC) system
* Proficiency with SMP, SCT, and/or CCT programming
* Proficiency creating SCT databases, custom programs, schedules, trends, alarms, and programming modules
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience working with AutoCad and/or Visio


**Preferred Education:**  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related field, a vocational school four year program certificate, or an Associate’s Degree in Electronics, Mechanical Systems, Computer Technology, HVAC/R, or a similar field

**At Johnson Controls (NYSE:** JCI), we are One Team working collaboratively to create purposeful solutions that make a difference in the world. We are a Fortune 500 company with more than 100,000 employees worldwide offering the world's largest portfolio of building technology products, solutions and services. As a member of our Federal Systems team, your work matters. We value and recognize your contributions and want to help you succeed. We invest in our employees, provide opportunities for growth and advancement, and foster a culture of inclusion and respect.
  
  

To learn more about who we are and what we do, please check out our Take a Journey video.
  
  

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. ---------------


At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.  

We are seeking capable, talented, and motivated team\-contributors at our Northrop Grumman Rolling Meadows site. Our products range from advanced sensing technologies to state\-of\-the\-art targeting and tracking systems that are deployed in Electro\-Optical Infrared (EOIR) and Radio Frequency Electronic Warfare (RFEW) systems. These systems are designed, developed, built, integrated, and tested by the capable folks at our company to protect the lives of US and Allied warfighters in present and future conflicts. Enjoy a culture where your voice is valued and start contributing to our team of passionate professionals providing real\-life solutions to our world’s biggest challenges. We take pride in creating purposeful work and allowing our employees to grow and achieve their goals every day by Defining Possible. With our competitive pay and comprehensive benefits, we have the right opportunities to fit your life and launch your career today. If you are interested in being considered for inclusion on this team, we invite you to apply.

  

The **Engineering Program Manager (EPM)** is responsible for leading end\-to\-end engineering execution across the full program lifecycle. The EPM ensures the integrated engineering team delivers on cost, schedule, and technical performance. This role works in close partnership with the Program Manager and Chief Engineer to drive program success and meet commitments. EPMs are essential to strengthening how we execute—bringing consistency, rigor, and visibility across all engineering efforts on a program.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Lead engineering execution across the entire program lifecycle (capture through delivery)
* Drive cost, schedule, and technical performance with disciplined execution
* Integrate across all engineering functions and partner organizations (GSC, MFG, MA) to ensure cohesive program alignment
* Enable data\-informed decisions using program metrics and performance indicators
* Ensure adherence and appropriate rigor to all engineering processes
* Partner with Program Managers and Chief Engineers to align technical scope, staffing, and execution plans
* Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks and issues early
* Drive milestone reviews (e.g., SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) with clear entry/exit criteria and readiness

 **This position will be full\-time, on\-site at our Rolling Meadows, IL location.**

 **This position is contingent upon funding/contract award, special access program, and acquiring and maintaining the necessary U.S. Government security clearance per customers' requirements prior to start.**

 **Basic Qualifications:**

  

* BS degree in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, Physics or other STEM field with 12\+ years of related experience, MS degree in STEM field with 10\+ years of related experience, or PhD in STEM field with 8\+ years of related experience

With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


Picture this real\-world scenario: It’s August 2026, and tensions are at an all\-time high in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has implemented new transit rules and established a 2,000\-kilometer zone of control enforced by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), demanding all vessels use designated lanes and coordinate with their Persian Gulf Strait Authority. A U.S. Navy Destroyer (USS Reliant) is navigating the narrow 21\-mile\-wide channel to project power and protect commercial shipping. An F\-16 pilot (Viper 1\) is providing top\-cover surveillance overhead.


Viper 1 monitors three Iranian fast\-attack craft accelerating at high speed toward the USS Reliant in a "swarm" formation. Simultaneously, Viper 1 notices that the USS Reliant is broadcasting a message that is being heavily distorted. Viper 1 switches to a secure, frequency\-hopping, tactical waveform. “Reliant, this is Viper 1, hostile swarm approaching 2\-0\-0 degrees, 5 miles out, requesting permission to engage." "Viper 1, this is Reliant, cleared to engage. We are activating close\-in weapons systems."


Because the message was secure and encrypted, Iranian electronic warfare units could not interpret or spoof the directive. Because the link was reliable, it bypassed the intense local jamming. The F\-16 acts as a fast\-reaction force using Collins tactical radios, allowing the destroyer to make crucial defensive maneuvers, securing the vessel and preventing a wider conflict.


The Tactical Communications \& Applications Solutions (TCAS) Software/Cyber department within the Mission Systems Resilient Connectivity Products (RCP) portfolio has the LOS (Line\-of\-Sight) / BLOS (Beyond LOS) waveform software team which specializes in developing flexible and secure military communication solutions. Our technologies provide our warfighters with the ability to communicate effectively, enabling them to accomplish their missions and return home safely.


We are seeking a service\-oriented and challenge\-driven Sr Software Engineering Manager with the leadership and technical skills to manage the engineering development and project execution of critical LOS and BLOS waveforms that will enable our warfighters to have tactical advantages in theater. This involves oversight of software engineering activities which design, develop, enhance, integrate, test, and maintain embedded waveform software applications.


At Collins Aerospace, you will work on cutting edge technology and contribute to programs that save lives and enable the freedoms we enjoy.


This position requires onsite presence in Cedar Rapids, IA.

**What You Will Do**

* Manage daily activities and contribute to the technical oversight of software engineers, project engineers, and support organizations to develop, integrate, and test embedded software in an Agile development environment for software\-defined radio architectures
* Manage project scope, schedule, and budget for software engineering activities using Earned Value Management System (EVMS) performance measurement; manage project risks/issues and elevate to upper management when appropriate
* Demonstrate predictable program execution and continuous improvement
* Oversee and participate in the development of engineering bids and proposals
* Create and implement strategic workforce and staffing plans to ensure the team meets its business objectives and maintains high\-performance standards, including recruiting/hiring, as well as actively addressing employee performance and career development actions
* Ensure compliance with Collins Aerospace development processes and standard work requirements
* Collaborate across programs and engineering teams to identify efficiencies, share resources, and support the development of best practices, necessitating an ability to clearly communicate objectives and status to audiences with varying degrees of understanding of the products and technology
* Develop and nurture internal and external networks, ensuring alignment and transparency with stakeholders, forging relationships with peers across RCP Engineering, Value Stream Leadership, and government customers

* US citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
* Experience leading cross\-functional technical teams in software development/integration/test with FPGA and Crypto Module integration
* Working knowledge of embedded software development and the use of C\+\+
* A proven ability to guide and lead software development processes
* Experience with cost account management

jobs.title: Embedded Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Aquilo**

Aquilo Sports LLC develops therapeutic medical devices for sports recovery and home healthcare. Our current development program is supported by a National Institutes of Health (NIH) SBIR Phase II award. We work closely with engineers, clinicians, researchers, and manufacturing partners to bring products from concept through clinical evaluation and commercialization. As a small, hands\-on company, we offer the chance to contribute directly to both our products and our growth.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Embedded Firmware Engineer to develop the firmware for our Lower\-Extremity Heat Therapy (LEHT), a new medical device now in commercial development. You will be our in\-house firmware owner, carrying the code from early requirements through implementation, hardware integration, testing, and release.

You will work alongside a retained external engineering firm responsible for the system's industrial design, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering. You will have a high degree of day\-to\-day autonomy in our Louisville office, with direct access to senior external engineers for architecture decisions, difficult firmware problems, and hardware integration. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands\-on development, takes initiative, and knows when to ask for input.

**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain embedded firmware for temperature regulation, pneumatic compression, sensors, user interfaces, and device communications.
* Contribute to software requirements, architecture, and documented firmware designs, with review from senior external engineers.
* Collaborate with external engineers on hardware interfaces, board bring\-up, debugging, and system integration.
* Implement treatment sequences, operating states, alarms, fault detection, and safe shutdown behavior.
* Develop and execute unit and integration tests, including abnormal operating conditions and failure recovery.
* Maintain source control, issue tracking, reproducible builds, and controlled firmware releases.
* Prepare software documentation and maintain traceability between requirements, implementation, and testing.
* Support prototype builds, verification activities, and investigation of issues found during device evaluation.
* Communicate progress, technical risks, and decisions clearly to the founders and engineering partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Approximately 2–5 years of embedded firmware development experience.
* Strong programming skills in C and/or C\+\+ for microcontrollers.
* Experience developing and debugging firmware on physical hardware, including interrupts, state machines, and common peripherals (I²C, SPI, UART, ADCs, PWM).
* Experience integrating sensors or actuators.
* Ability to read schematics and use hardware debuggers, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers.
* Disciplined habits with version control, structured testing, and technical documentation.
* Ability to organize your own work, troubleshoot systematically, and collaborate with external engineers.
* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Firmware experience on medical devices or other products with safety\-critical functions.
* Familiarity with medical\-device software practices, including IEC 62304, requirements traceability, and software risk management.
* Substantial involvement in an embedded product from early development through testing and release.
* Experience with temperature or pressure control, pumps, valves, and related sensors.
* Experience with RTOS development, Bluetooth Low Energy, displays, or device data logging.
* Experience building scripts or tools for automated testing and data analysis.
* Effective use of AI\-assisted development tools, with the ability to independently review, test, and explain generated code.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Annual salary: $72,000–$84,000
* Health and dental insurance: Coverage available.
* Paid vacation: Three weeks annually.
* Hybrid flexibility: Remote work when tasks allow, with regular onsite work in Louisville for prototype development, hardware integration, and testing.
* Professional development: Direct access to senior external engineers for technical guidance and collaboration.
* Travel: Occasional travel to work with engineering and development partners.

**Why Join Aquilo?**

* Build something with a clear purpose. Your work goes into a medical device intended to support home treatment and improve patients' quality of life.
* Gain full\-lifecycle medical device experience early in your career. Work across firmware, electronics integration, verification, and clinical\-development support, with senior engineers to learn from.
* Work directly with the founders. Have a real voice in product decisions, development priorities, and how we build our engineering capability.
* Grow with the company. Take on greater technical responsibility as our products and internal team develop.

**Work Authorization**

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Aquilo is unable to sponsor employment visas now or in the future for this position.

**How to Apply**
