jobs.title: Software Engineer III
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

There's nothing more exciting than being at the center of a rapidly growing field in technology and applying your skillsets to drive innovation and modernize the world's most complex and mission\-critical systems.


As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Corporate Technology, Employee Platforms team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted, market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.




Job responsibilities

* Build and operate container platforms using Docker and Kubernetes, including deployments, scaling, and lifecycle management.
* Develop and maintain Linux\-based CI/CD pipelines (build, test, package, deploy), improving reliability, security, and speed.
* Manage artifact lifecycle and dependency workflows using Artifactory (publishing, promotion, retention, access controls).
* Provision and manage infrastructure using Terraform and infrastructure\-as\-code best practices (versioning, reviews, drift detection).
* Support MySQL and Kafka components in production environments, including basic configuration, performance troubleshooting, and operational monitoring (as applicable to the role).
* Implement and support infrastructure management activities (capacity planning, patching strategy, configuration management, standardization).
* Enhance observability and telemetry: logging, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerting, and incident response using tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, and Grafana.
* Configure and support load balancers and traffic management patterns (routing, health checks, TLS termination, failover).
* Contribute to sustained resiliency and disaster recovery readiness (RTO/RPO understanding, runbooks, testing, failure exercises).
* Drive automation across operational workflows (environment provisioning, deployment, validation, remediation, reporting).
* Collaborate with application teams, security, and infrastructure partners to improve platform stability and delivery practices.

  

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities

* 5 years of experience in a DevOps / Platform / SRE / Infrastructure Engineering role.
* Strong experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes (core concepts, workloads, configs/secrets, troubleshooting).
* Experience with Artifactory (repository management and artifact promotion practices).
* Solid Linux fundamentals (system troubleshooting, processes, networking basics, scripting).
* Proven delivery of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps or similar) with automated testing and deployment.
* Hands\-on infrastructure provisioning with Terraform (modules, state, remote backends, environments).
* Working experience with MySQL (operations, backup/restore concepts, troubleshooting, monitoring).
* Working experience with Kafka (topics/partitions, producers/consumers, operational monitoring/troubleshooting).
* Experience with observability/telemetry tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana (logs/metrics/traces; alert tuning).
* Understanding of load balancing concepts and operational support in production environments.
* Practical experience supporting high availability, sustained operations, and DR/resiliency planning and testing.


Preferred qualifications
* Experience with service mesh, ingress controllers, or Kubernetes policy controls.
* Familiarity with secrets management and secure supply chain practices (SBOM, signing, scanning).
* Experience operating in regulated environments with change/release controls.
* Exposure to incident management, root cause analysis, and post\-incident improvements.
* Experience working with the SecuriThings device management platform.
* Relevant certifications in Kubernetes or Docker (e.g., CKA/CKAD/CKS or Docker certifications).

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.


We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting\-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer Specialist.


The expected annual salary range for this role is $122000 \- $179000 a year.


Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.  



* *This Hybrid role must work on\-site 3 days weekly at our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation assistance is available for a qualified candidate currently residing in the US.*

*Additionally, if needed H1B visa transfer sponsorship assistance for a qualified candidate currently residing and employed on a H1B in the USA.*

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division is currently seeking a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. This position will be a hybrid office/remote role as long as you live within 50 miles of our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only.**  

  



Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division designs, manufactures, and services Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, batteries, and electronic\-based products to ensure power reliability in the most demanding applications. Our employees deliver mission\-critical solutions to our customers’ most challenging energy management requirements.


Making what matters work at Eaton takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention and discovery become reality, each and every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours.  



  

**Why Eaton?**

* Be a key member of a world\-class organization that creates market leading 3\-phase products.
* Opportunities for career advancement through a defined technical track as well as broader Eaton career opportunities in various business functions. Raleigh is an Engineering Hub with roles in: Service, Manufacturing/Assembly, New Product Development, and Product Management.
* Work in a modern hybrid collaborative environment. Eaton is committed to fostering a successful work/life balance.
* Competitive salary and benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, tuition reimbursement, paid holidays, vacation, paid parental leave.

  

**Position Overview:**

As a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer you will support our product development and design of our high\-power three\-phase UPS’s. This role also supports products in our Energy Storage and next generation AI load\-smoothing product lines. The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team.


You will be responsible for conceptualizing, developing and designing advanced real\-time DSP algorithms for advanced power conversion applications in the power quality industry.
  

The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team. If you have a passion for design of power electronics\-centric controls design and development, this role is for you.


**In this role you will:**
--------------------------

  

* Successfully launch critical power infrastructure products that meet customer requirements and Eaton safety, quality, reliability, cost and schedule commitments.
* Leverage your skill and experience by giving guidance and leadership to other technical project team members.
* Work with global product development teams to solve problems related to performance, functionality, safety, reliability, quality and component availability.
* Develop mathematical models and algorithms for advanced DSP controls of electronic power conversion products.
* Develop simulations using MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment and verify control designs through simulations.
* Develop converter control algorithms and drive their validation across simulations and HIL testbeds.
* Evaluate competing controls architectures and designs to select the best suited for the application.
* Apply controls theory to design controllers to achieve target product performance.
* Validate designs using Real time simulation systems such as OPAL\-RT.
* Participate as team member in new product development projects (uninterruptible power systems, energy storage and advanced technology products) while meeting schedule, cost and product performance goals. Interface closely with cross\-functional team members.
* Lead product development using new technologies based on POCs from Eaton COEs and ERLs.
* Analyze, design and assist in testing/troubleshooting control system software used in uninterruptible power systems and other power quality products.
* Apply best engineering practices and decision making for advanced technical problem solving.
* Foster an environment that promotes Eaton’s goals, philosophies, and encourages continuous improvement.

  

When we embrace the different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds that make each of us unique, we — as individuals and as a company — are stronger.


**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required (Basic) Qualifications:**  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited institution with minimum 8 years work industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* MS in Electrical or related Engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 5 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* PhD in Electrical or related engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 2 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer**
============================

**Regular Position, Full Time**  

**Bronx, NY \| Irving, TX \| Sacramento, CA**


If you are a forward\-thinking engineering professional interested in embedded systems, software development, and solving complex technical challenges, then keep reading! We are searching for an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to join our Engineering team at Vantage Elevation.


You’ll play a hands\-on role in the design, development, testing, and continuous improvement of embedded software for elevator control systems, helping deliver quality, safety, and reliability across our products.

**About Us**
------------


Vantage Elevation, LLC is an independent, industry\-leading manufacturer of elevator components and systems with a long history of innovation and reliability.


Founded in 1899, Vantage employs over 1,000 people across manufacturing sites and offices in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Through its family of brands, GAL Manufacturing, GAL Canada, Hollister\-Whitney, Elevator Controls, Courion, Bore\-Max, Thames Valley Controls, and Vertical Dimensions, Vantage supports nearly every electro\-mechanical device used in modern elevators.


Vantage’s mission is to safely connect people and communities by providing reliable elevator solutions. We support our teams, work closely with our customers, and hold ourselves accountable for quality, safety, and integrity in everything we do.

**Requirements**
----------------


We are searching for a candidate with:

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in real\-time embedded software engineering
* Strong experience with C and C\+\+ programming
* Experience with embedded real\-time operating systems
* Strong embedded firmware development and troubleshooting skills
* Familiarity with revision control systems such as Git
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Self\-motivated with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision
* Experience leading small projects and mentoring team members

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Elevator industry experience and knowledge of elevator control systems
* Experience with low\-level device drivers
* Experience with scripting tools such as Bash, PowerShell, Python, or Make/Cygwin
* Experience with C\#, PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
* Ability to develop creative and strategic solutions to complex technical challenges

**Duties and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------


A typical day may include:

* Designing, developing, modifying, and maintaining embedded software using C and C\+\+
* Troubleshooting and debugging software and electronic hardware systems
* Collaborating with Field Service, Manufacturing, and Engineering teams to resolve technical issues
* Working closely with electrical and mechanical engineering teams throughout product development
* Performing functional testing of software updates and enhancements
* Documenting software functionality and system behavior
* Mentoring junior engineers and providing technical guidance
* Supporting the development and continuous improvement of coding standards, engineering best practices, and design processes
* Participating in on\-site testing and troubleshooting as needed
* Performing additional duties and special projects as assigned

**Benefits of Working With Us**
-------------------------------

* **The anticipated base salary range for this position is $143,000–$170,000 annually. Placement within the range will be based on the candidate’s relevant experience, demonstrated capabilities, qualifications, and geographic location.**
* Paid Time Off and sick time
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* 401(k) with Company Match and Non\-Elective Contributions
* Tuition Reimbursement opportunities
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Plum Benefits and additional employee discount programs
* Opportunities for professional growth and development

**Position Details**
--------------------

* **Full Time**
* **Schedule:** Generally Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:30 PM local time
* **Location:** This position may be based at Vantage Elevation's Bronx, NY; Irving, TX; or Sacramento, CA location.
* Office\-based engineering environment with frequent cross\-functional collaboration
* Occasional overtime may be required to meet project deadlines
* Occasional travel for on\-site testing and troubleshooting

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Connectivity/Wireless
jobs.description:
At Meta, we're building innovative products that make it easier for people to connect with each other and enjoy immersive experiences. Our team of experienced engineers is developing and shipping products at the intersection of hardware, software, and content, pushing the future of computing platforms and redefining the way people work, play, and connect. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to design, develop, and optimize embedded firmware systems for our AR, VR, and wearable devices, working on low\-level systems software, device drivers, and connectivity protocols such as Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, and Core Android networking. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to solve complex problems and drive innovation in areas such as computer vision, machine learning, and graphics, helping to shape the future of technology and create new experiences for augmented reality, virtual reality, and social/family products.  

  

  

### **Embedded Software Engineer, Connectivity/Wireless Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement software components at all layers of the system, including kernel, synchronization primitives, resource allocators, memory management, security, I/O systems, persistence, etc
* Develop drivers and services that operate efficiently in constrained environments and deliver large volumes of data with low\-latency and high\-bandwidth
* Lead hardware bring up, peripheral drivers and communication, silicon integration, and power and performance management and optimization efforts
* Debug complex, system\-level, multi\-component issues that span multiple layers from kernel to application
* Profile performance problems and drive optimizations across the entire software stack
* Integrate software components from multiple partner teams into a unified product code base and drive their continued development
* Analyze, design, develop, and debug firmware for various devices, including novel sensing and imaging systems, haptic devices, and audio prototypes
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to solve issues and create new features in the connectivity space, including wireless software stacks (Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, Cellular, UWB, etc.)
* Enhance complex systems with wireless interfaces and provide support to QA, manufacturing, and other software teams

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 7\+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4\+ years of experience
* 3\+ years embedded software development experience in industry settings
* Experience in large\-scale C/C\+\+ code base
* Experience defining and driving technical work streams and providing technical leadership for software engineering teams

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience in embedded software development for consumer electronic products
* Experience in implementing Bluetooth Host Stack features, profiles, audio, Bluetooth/Wi\-Fi/Cellular coex, etc
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with Cellular connectivity stack on widely available platform like Android
* Experience in a field which uses Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, Cellular, HDMI, Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) or related technology
* Experience in implementing or integrating Wi\-Fi, preferably on a widely available platform like Android or iOS, or a system which employs the Linux Wi\-Fi Protected Access supplicant
* Experience with Java, Python, or Android
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  

  

  

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Wright Electric**

Wright Electric builds power systems behind the future of aerospace and defense — from 30 kW expeditionary generators to multi\-megawatt airborne propulsion. Our work spans electric motors, next\-generation batteries, power electronics, and complete power systems like DenseGen and Dynamo, all engineered for a step\-change in power and energy density. Since 2016, we've earned the trust of some of the most demanding customers in the world, including AFSOC, the USMC, PACAF, USTRANSCOM, NASA, ARPA\-E, the FAA, and U.S. Air Force programs. It's genuinely cutting\-edge work.

We also move fast. Wright is an all\-hands, high\-ownership environment where the pace is quick and the problems are hard, and the people who thrive here are the ones who dig in and drive their work to the finish. At the same time, we know sustained great work depends on rest: we respect our team's personal time and protect the boundaries that keep people sharp, healthy, and here for the long haul.

**The Role**

Wright Electric is looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer with 10\+ years of experience to join our growing R\&D team. This is a hands\-on, senior role: you'll rapidly prototype power\-electronic and control systems for motor and generator applications, take on the most complex design challenges, and mentor engineers across the team. You'll help set the technical bar for how we build, and own your work from concept through validated hardware.

The engineers who thrive here are pragmatic, deeply technical, and generous with their knowledge. You'll be a go\-to problem\-solver on power electronics and a multiplier for the engineers around you, working across disciplines to move designs from concept to working hardware.

**What You'll Do**

* Rapidly prototype power\-electronic and control systems for motor and generator applications.
* Lead the design of complex power\-electronics systems from concept through test.
* Mentor and develop engineers across the team, raising the technical bar.
* Support testing and test\-plan development for prototypes and products.
* Identify and source the components needed to realize a design.
* Collaborate across departments to move designs from concept to working hardware.
* Own your tasks from concept through completion.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (or a related field) plus 10 years of professional experience
* OR Masters of Science in Electrical Engineering (or a related field) plus 5 years of professional electrical engineering experience.
* OR PhD in Electrical Engineering (or a related field)
* Experience with power electronics systems.
* Experience with prototype and product development.
* Experience supporting testing and test\-plan development.
* Strong mentoring abilities.
* Ability to work with and engage team members across departments.
* Capable of owning tasks from beginning to end.

*Preferred*

* Experience with motors and drives.
* Experience with control system design.
* Experience with generators and micro\-grids.
* Experience with embedded firmware development.
* Experience with programming in C, Python, or Matlab

**We Encourage You to Apply**

Wright Electric is committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive workplace. Research shows that women and members of other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed qualification. If you're excited about this position but your experience doesn't line up perfectly with everything above, we encourage you to apply anyway — you may be exactly who we're looking for.

\-\-

*Wright Electric is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This position may involve access to technology and data controlled under U.S. export laws (ITAR/EAR); applicants may be required to meet applicable U.S.\-person or export\-authorization requirements consistent with law.*

\-\-

*Wright Electric maintains a drug\-free workplace. Certain positions may be subject to drug screening consistent with our federal contract obligations and applicable law.*

Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Application Question(s):

* Number of years of experience
* Desired Salary Range

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are building Kernel to power instant, simple payments across healthcare.

Healthcare providers spend enormous amounts of time navigating insurance portals, practice\-management systems, phone calls, claims, denials, payments, and reconciliation just to get paid for care they have already delivered.

**We think much of this work can and should be done by machines.**

Kernel is an always\-on system that operates across the software healthcare practices already use. Our agents navigate practice\-management systems and payer portals, call insurance companies, verify coverage, submit and recover claims, reconcile payments, and increasingly handle the entire path from care delivered to money collected.

We are starting with dental practices and building toward a much larger goal: making healthcare payments simple.

**The role**

We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join the founding team in New York.

You will work directly with the founders and own major pieces of Kernel from idea to production. This is not a narrowly scoped engineering role. You might spend one week building an agent that operates legacy healthcare software, the next improving our verification infrastructure across thousands of sessions, and the next shipping a new payments product directly to clinics. **We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join the founding team and help us push these systems toward true autonomy.**

**What you'll build**

You will work directly with the founders on some of the hardest technical problems at Kernel.

This may include:

* Building computer\-use and browser agents that reliably operate legacy healthcare software
* Training and improving models for healthcare\-specific actions and reasoning
* Building post\-training pipelines using SFT, reinforcement learning, synthetic data, and production traces
* Designing rigorous evals for long\-horizon agent behavior
* Improving reliability across workflows that may require hundreds of actions and multiple external systems
* Building model\-routing, inference, context, memory, and tool\-use infrastructure
* Turning millions of real\-world agent interactions into training data
* Building voice agents that communicate with insurance companies
* Working with multimodal models across screens, documents, faxes, forms, and structured data
* Reducing inference cost and latency while increasing task success
* Building the product and infrastructure necessary to deploy these systems across thousands of healthcare practices

**Who we're looking for**

We care much more about what you can build than where you went to school or how many years you have worked.

You may be a strong fit if you:

* You are an exceptional programmer
* You have unusually high technical ambition
* You learn new systems very quickly
* You have built serious projects outside of assigned work
* You enjoy debugging problems where there is no Stack Overflow answer
* You are comfortable moving between ML, infrastructure, product, and systems work
* You want ownership rather than narrowly scoped tickets
* You care about both speed and engineering quality
* You want to work intensely with a small team in person in New York
* You enjoy making things

We are open to exceptional new graduates and early\-career engineers.

We are also open to candidates from traditional ML, systems, infrastructure, robotics, compilers, distributed systems, or other technically demanding backgrounds if they can demonstrate exceptional ability.

**How we work**

Milo is a small engineering team in Manhattan. Engineers here do not sit several layers away from the problem.

You might talk to a customer in the morning, inspect an agent failure, modify the runtime, run an experiment, and deploy the fix that afternoon.

We expect engineers to own problems end to end.

There are very few meetings, very little bureaucracy, and a very high bar for what we build.

**Why Milo**

AI is becoming capable of doing work, not just generating text. Healthcare is one of the largest industries in the world, but much of its financial infrastructure still depends on people manually moving information between fragmented systems.

We think that changes over the next decade.

Our goal is to build the autonomous infrastructure that gets healthcare providers paid.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years solving, we'd like to meet you.

**Application**

Please include:

**1\. The most technically ambitious thing you have built.**  
Tell us what you personally built and include a link if possible.

**2\. Your experience with modern ML systems.**  
This could include agents, model training, post\-training, reinforcement learning, evals, inference, multimodal models, or ML infrastructure.

**3\. A difficult technical problem you encountered.**  
What was breaking, how did you diagnose it, and what did you change?

**4\. Why Milo?**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Happy hour
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Snacks provided
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

After more than 40 years of business growth and industry change, Grassi has redefined what it means to be an advisor and accountant to today's businesses and individuals. Nationally ranked as one of the largest and fastest\-growing accounting firms in the nation, Grassi is a leading provider of advisory, tax, and accounting services across key sectors including construction, architecture and engineering, not\-for\-profit, healthcare, manufacturing and distribution, financial services, real estate, and more. Several publications have ranked us among the top accounting firms to work for, highlighting our strength in work\-life balance, culture, and wellness categories.



With over 550 employees and eleven offices spanning the New York Metropolitan Area, Long Island, the Northeast, Florida, New England, Denver and an international presence in Italy, we are strategically positioned to serve clients locally and globally. In 2023, Grassi became an employee\-owned company by implementing an ESOP, establishing our independence and empowering our people to drive the firm's future success. The ESOP ensures that equity partners and all Grassi U.S. employees have the exclusive opportunity to own the firm's stock, making them integral to the company's future.


**Job Summary**



We are currently seeking a **Senior Systems Engineer** to join our team in either our **Park Ridge, NJ** or **Jericho, NY** office location**.** This is a **fully onsite** position, five days per week in the office.This role offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic and growing firm.


**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**


* Serve as the final service desk escalation point for complex incidents involving Microsoft 365, identity services, secure remote access, endpoint protection, virtual desktop platforms, profile management, printers, security alerts, and firm applications.
* Lead root cause analysis for recurring, high\-impact, or deadline\-sensitive issues and implement durable corrective actions.
* Support technical delivery for endpoint, application, Microsoft 365, secure access, identity, infrastructure, security improvement, and modernization initiatives.
* Create and maintain configuration standards, operational runbooks, recovery procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor Level 1 and Level 2 personnel, improve escalation quality, and provide practical knowledge transfer.
* Coordinate with vendors, consultants, application owners, security resources, business stakeholders, and IT leadership.
* Identify technical debt, availability risks, capacity constraints, configuration weaknesses, and opportunities for automation or standardization.
* Participate in after\-hours maintenance and critical incident response when business needs require it.


**Technical Responsibilities**

* Cloud, Virtual Desktop, Microsoft 365, and Identity
	+ Administer and troubleshoot cloud services, including virtual machines, storage, networking, remote connectivity, monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and related services.
	+ Provide advanced support for virtual desktop environments and user profiles, including access, application delivery, printing, performance, capacity, and user experience.
	+ Administer Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, Teams Phone, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Outlook, Microsoft 365 Apps, Copilot, licensing, mailboxes, groups, and permissions.
	+ Support identity and access management, including users, groups, enterprise applications, access policies, sign\-in issues, and access troubleshooting.
	+ Assess technical dependencies and business risk before changes and develop implementation, validation, and rollback plans.
* Access, Networking, and Endpoint Support
	+ Support secure remote access, DNS, network connectivity, and secure\-access platforms.
	+ Troubleshoot TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi\-Fi, latency, endpoint connectivity, application access, and other network\-related issues.
	+ Provide advanced support for Windows devices, endpoint performance, imaging, deployment, printers, scanners, application delivery, endpoint management, and remote\-support tools.
	+ Support email security, endpoint protection, managed detection and response, identity security, password management, phishing investigations, suspicious sign\-ins, malware alerts, and potential account compromise.
	+ Use PowerShell and approved automation tools for diagnostics, troubleshooting, and process improvement.
* Compliance, Data Protection, and Business Applications
	+ Apply least\-privilege principles, verify identity before sensitive access changes, and protect confidential client, tax, employee, and firm information.
	+ Maintain awareness of applicable security and compliance requirements, including IRS Publication 4557, the FTC Safeguards Rule, GLBA, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and HIPAA when applicable.
	+ Support security assessments, audit requests, remediation activities, recovery exercises, and technical control documentation.
	+ Support integrations, secure access, application availability and performance, upgrades, and vendor escalations across the firm's application environment.
* Accounting, Tax, Audit, and Firm Applications
	+ Maintain technical knowledge of applications supporting accounting, tax, audit, advisory, document management, workflow, portals, payroll, practice management, electronic signature, PDF, scanning, printing, and remote\-work processes.
	+ Support applications including CCH Axcess, CCH Engagement, CCH Workstream, CCH Workflow, Wolters Kluwer applications, Thomson Reuters applications, Inflo, SafeSend, K\-1x, SurePrep, QuickBooks, QuickBooks Online, ShareFile, Adobe Acrobat, Adobe Sign, Star Practice Management, CFS Payroll, and related tools and dependencies.
	+ Understand the urgency of tax and audit deadlines, partner and client\-impacting issues, secure access, engagement file availability, and business continuity. C

jobs.title: New Product Development – Refrigeration Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Carrier**


Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world\-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**Job Requirements**


The New Product Development (NPD) – Refrigeration Systems Engineer will play a key role in product support and strategic development: supporting HVAC cooling and heat pump equipment development, developing qualification plans for systems and components, secure product requirement compliance and agency certification.

  

Based onsite in Syracuse, NY, this position operates on a Monday through Friday day shift schedule.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Product cost productivity (Sch B) for Light Commercial and Commercial products
* Support the development of strategic customer options across multiple product lines
* Provide engineering support for field quality issues reported, offering effective solutions to improve product quality with a competitive cost in a timely manner.
* Provide factory support regarding product engineering and design fabricated in commercial manufacturing plants under our operative system Cx.
* Support product ETL/UL audits through plants and maintain accuracy agency files.
* Maintain the accuracy of engineering information, update and manage the master Bill of Materials (BOM), drawings, and engineering specifications.
* Develop and coordinate engineering documents and release.
* Provide daily direction to supporting Designers \& Technicians.
* Prepare presentations for Qualification Review Boards including demonstrating the use of Quality System deployment tools.
* Collaborate with team members from Marketing, Design Engineering, and Manufacturing Engineering.
* Document process improvements as part of standard engineering work.
* Identification of reliable and cost\-effective purchased components required for new product development projects

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Engineering field with 2\+ years of experience working with specification, design, development, and manufacture of products in an engineering environment, **\-or\-** Master’s degree in an Engineering field with 1\+ years of experience working with specification, design, development, and manufacture of products in an engineering environment.
* 1\+ years of experience working with refrigeration design, heat transfer, fan systems, structural analysis and/or electronic control systems.
* Able and willing to travel up to 10% of the year domestically and to Mexico to support field sites and travel to manufacturing facilities.
* Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Systems Engineering.
* Experience or familiarity with various HVAC applications or similar industry.
* Hands\-on experience working in an Engineering design environment.
* Demonstrated system design thinking skills and creative new product design skills.
* Project management and interpersonal skills and the ability to work within an engineering design team
* Experience in system control development
* Experience with vapor\-compression refrigeration or power generation systems including related components: heat exchangers and compression technologies.
* Experience integrating and verifying \& validating performance of complex systems
* Knowledge of CSA/ANSI and UL Standards such as: AHRI, ASHRAE, DOE, EPA, NEC, UL/CSA, etc.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing fabrication and assembly methods.
* Demonstrated experience in continual process improvement.
* Experience with model\-based design techniques.
* Ability to work with geographically dispersed teams and a diverse cultural environment.
* Ability to professionally engage with cross\-functional and cross\-regional teams to understand and translate product requirements into control system requirements.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts across technical and non\-technical organizations.
* Ability for developing continuous improvement projects to influence and drive change.
* Excellent Follow\-up and follow\-through skills.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail, while managing multiple priorities.

**Pay Range**


The annual salary for this position is between $64,500\.00 \- $129,500\.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.**Other Compensation**


This position may be entitled to short\-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.**Benefits**


Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short\-term and long\-term disability
* **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment**
* **Tax\-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care

jobs.title: Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer Specialist
jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer Specialist.


The expected annual salary range for this role is $122000 \- $179000 a year.


Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.  



* *This Hybrid role must work on\-site 3 days weekly at our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation assistance is available for a qualified candidate currently residing in the US.*

*Additionally, if needed H1B visa transfer sponsorship assistance for a qualified candidate currently residing and employed on a H1B in the USA.*

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division is currently seeking a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. This position will be a hybrid office/remote role as long as you live within 50 miles of our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only.**  

  



Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division designs, manufactures, and services Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, batteries, and electronic\-based products to ensure power reliability in the most demanding applications. Our employees deliver mission\-critical solutions to our customers’ most challenging energy management requirements.


Making what matters work at Eaton takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention and discovery become reality, each and every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours.  



  

**Why Eaton?**

* Be a key member of a world\-class organization that creates market leading 3\-phase products.
* Opportunities for career advancement through a defined technical track as well as broader Eaton career opportunities in various business functions. Raleigh is an Engineering Hub with roles in: Service, Manufacturing/Assembly, New Product Development, and Product Management.
* Work in a modern hybrid collaborative environment. Eaton is committed to fostering a successful work/life balance.
* Competitive salary and benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, tuition reimbursement, paid holidays, vacation, paid parental leave.

  

**Position Overview:**

As a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer you will support our product development and design of our high\-power three\-phase UPS’s. This role also supports products in our Energy Storage and next generation AI load\-smoothing product lines. The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team.


You will be responsible for conceptualizing, developing and designing advanced real\-time DSP algorithms for advanced power conversion applications in the power quality industry.
  

The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team. If you have a passion for design of power electronics\-centric controls design and development, this role is for you.


**In this role you will:**
--------------------------

  

* Successfully launch critical power infrastructure products that meet customer requirements and Eaton safety, quality, reliability, cost and schedule commitments.
* Leverage your skill and experience by giving guidance and leadership to other technical project team members.
* Work with global product development teams to solve problems related to performance, functionality, safety, reliability, quality and component availability.
* Develop mathematical models and algorithms for advanced DSP controls of electronic power conversion products.
* Develop simulations using MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment and verify control designs through simulations.
* Develop converter control algorithms and drive their validation across simulations and HIL testbeds.
* Evaluate competing controls architectures and designs to select the best suited for the application.
* Apply controls theory to design controllers to achieve target product performance.
* Validate designs using Real time simulation systems such as OPAL\-RT.
* Participate as team member in new product development projects (uninterruptible power systems, energy storage and advanced technology products) while meeting schedule, cost and product performance goals. Interface closely with cross\-functional team members.
* Lead product development using new technologies based on POCs from Eaton COEs and ERLs.
* Analyze, design and assist in testing/troubleshooting control system software used in uninterruptible power systems and other power quality products.
* Apply best engineering practices and decision making for advanced technical problem solving.
* Foster an environment that promotes Eaton’s goals, philosophies, and encourages continuous improvement.

  

When we embrace the different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds that make each of us unique, we — as individuals and as a company — are stronger.


**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required (Basic) Qualifications:**  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited institution with minimum 8 years work industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* MS in Electrical or related Engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 5 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* PhD in Electrical or related engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 2 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products.
*\*I

jobs.title: Entry Level Software Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

The BAE Systems GXP Software Team, based in Durham NC near Research Triangle Park, is seeking highly motivated entry level software engineers to join our team. We are looking for candidates that will enjoy developing unique, cutting\-edge solutions that help people make sense of exquisite imagery, video, and other sophisticated remote sensor data. We value those who are curious to explore the "what", "when", "how", and "why" of world events using advanced technologies. We encourage attitudes towards problem solving driven by persistence, innovation, teamwork and a willingness to meet challenges head on.
  

  

Our team develops state\-of\-the art software for sensor\-data processing, analysis, storage, and visualization for challenging problems in the areas of video analytics, image processing, and other temporal data sources. We utilize the most advanced techniques for data science, machine learning, computer vision, statistical analysis, and cloud computing to discover hidden patterns in big data. We develop end\-to\-end applications that process data for desktop, web, embedded platforms, and large scale cloud computing environments. We believe collaboration is key, as such, you will be paired with a mentor to facilitate a smooth onboarding process as you become familiar with our products and the technologies we employ.
  

  

Our commercial software products include:
* GXP InMotion Server \- ingests and streams real\-time data feeds, providing recording and analytics capabilities
* GXP InMotion Desktop \- video and image analysis application
* Track Analytics Software Suite (TASS) \- a suite of algorithms for analyzing geospatial data
* MOVINT Database \- a geospatial big\-data store with RESTful web service interfaces
* GXP InMotion Web / MOVINT\- a browser\-based front end for visualizing and analyzing geospatial data

You can read more about our software and solutions here:
  

InMotion Desktop and Server \- https://www.geospatialexploitationproducts.com/content/gxpinmotion/
  

MOVINT Solutions \- https://www.geospatialexploitationproducts.com/content/movint/
  

  

As a member of our software group, you will contribute to a highly\-motivated small team responsible for software development and data analysis for client\-driven programs, and the integration of these technologies into core BAE Systems products and customer platforms. The ideal candidate enjoys learning in a challenging technical environment; collaborating on multiple teams and projects; and can apply their technical skill and innovation towards solving real\-world problems.
  

  

Because this role involves a combination of collaborative/in\-person and independent work, it will take the form of a hybrid work format, with time split between working onsite and remotely.  

  

  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science
* Must be eligible for a US TS/SCI security clearance
* Knowledge and experience Python, Java, C\+\+, or JavaScript (any)
* Understanding of object\-oriented programming concepts
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, debugging and test skills
* Familiarity with both Linux and Windows operating systems
* U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED. Candidates selected for some positions will be subjected to a government security investigation and will need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.
  

  

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Course work one or more: Algorithms, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Architecture, Computer Graphics, Computer Networking, Data Science, Database Systems, Machine Learning, Operating Systems, UI/UX Design, Cloud technologies (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes)
* Familiarity with software development/engineering, including requirements analysis, software development, installation, integration, evaluation, enhancement, maintenance, testing, and problem diagnosis/resolution.
  

  

  

**Pay Information**
  

Full\-Time Salary Range: $52395 \- $89107
  

  

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.
  

  

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well\-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.

BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. jobs.title: Staff Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Staff Hardware Engineer at 219, you will play a crucial role in helping companies develop products that push the boundaries of possibility and challenge the status quo.

About 219 Design219 Design is a dynamic and innovative company specializing in product development. For over 20 years, we’ve been helping companies invent products that change the world. Our clients are leaders in industries that include medical devices, surgical robotics, industrial automation, consumer electronics, merchandising, transportation, and more. Join our dedicated team and be part of our mission to develop groundbreaking technology that positively impacts the world.Description**Your Role**

* Take responsibility for system design, schematic capture, and PCB layout on a variety of projects, ranging from rapid proof\-of\-concept prototypes to complex medical devices.
* Architect, design, implement, and validate custom analog and digital electronics.
* Design power electronics, including battery management and low\-power design.
* Design circuits supporting various wired and wireless communication protocols (USB, RS\-232, Ethernet, I2C, SPI, CAN, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), WiFi, cellular, etc).
* Manage vendors for prototype PCB fabrication and assembly.
* Conduct hands\-on prototyping, board bring\-up, and hardware debugging.
* Collaborate closely with clients and interdisciplinary colleagues (mechanical and firmware engineering).
* Participate in design reviews, seeking and providing technical feedback to and from peers.
* Manage individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables independently or as part of a small team.
* Share your skills and knowledge with the team by participating in and presenting at weekly discussions.

**Qualifications**

* BS or MS in computer engineering, electrical engineering or a related field.
* 6\+ years of professional experience.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Proficient in the use of Altium
* Proficient in the use of standard test equipment: oscilloscope, logic analyzer, etc.
* Must be able to work regularly out of one of our offices in the Bay Area or Raleigh, North Carolina.
* Authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

**Bonus Points**

* Production experience
* Experience with medical devices
* Experience with automation and robotics
* Experience in any/all: firmware development, software development, mechanical design, scripting

**Benefits**

Changing jobs is a big deal! We know you need to weigh compensation, job satisfaction, and company culture, so we wanted to share some of the things we think make 219 Design unique and a great place to work:

* We are a certified Great Place to Work®!
* Health/dental/vision insurance
* 401(k) \+ company match

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT KRAKEN KINETICS**


Kraken Kinetics designs and manufactures advanced kinetic solutions that enable modern warfighting capabilities for the United States Armed Forces and its allies. We specialize in mission\-tailored warheads and firing systems for unmanned and autonomous weapon platforms, delivering production\-ready solutions at speed to address urgent national security challenges.


Our team brings decades of specialized Department of War experience across the full lifecycle of kinetic system development—from concept and design through testing, manufacturing, and operational deployment. Built on a foundation of work that helped lead the DoW into the era of kinetic drones, Kraken Kinetics combines commercial agility with deep technical expertise to deliver **DEFINITIVE LETHALITY**when it matters most.

**Position Summary**


Kraken Kinetics is seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineer to support the development and maturation of advanced defense products within a small, fast\-moving engineering organization.


This is a hands\-on execution role. The Senior Systems Engineer will work directly across mechanical, electrical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and program functions to translate customer and operational needs into clear system requirements, interfaces, verification strategies, and technical baselines. The role will remain closely involved in day\-to\-day engineering execution and product development rather than operating primarily in a strategic or advisory capacity.


In addition to direct systems engineering work, this position will provide technical mentorship to less\-experienced systems engineering personnel and help strengthen Kraken’s systems engineering practices as the organization grows. This includes establishing practical requirements structures, traceability approaches, review practices, verification methods, and technical documentation that improve engineering clarity without adding unnecessary process burden.


A key near\-term responsibility will be helping implement and mature Jama Connect as Kraken’s requirements management platform. The Senior Systems Engineer will help establish effective project structures, requirements hierarchies, traceability relationships, review workflows, verification linkages, templates, and basic administration practices that support ongoing engineering execution.

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Develop, capture, decompose, allocate, and maintain system\-level requirements derived from customer needs, operational use cases, internal product objectives, statements of work, applicable standards, and engineering constraints.
* Work with mechanical, electrical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and program personnel to ensure requirements are clear, testable, technically appropriate, and actionable.
* Develop and maintain requirements traceability, verification matrices, interface control documentation, system architecture artifacts, and related technical baselines.
* Support system architecture development, interface definition, trade studies, technical risk assessment, and system\-level engineering decisions.
* Identify requirement gaps, conflicts, assumptions, dependencies, and technical risks early and work with stakeholders to drive resolution.
* Coordinate with test and verification personnel to define verification methods, acceptance criteria, test coverage, and traceability between requirements and objective evidence.
* Support design reviews, test readiness reviews, production readiness reviews, failure investigations, and other technical reviews.
* Support development of compliance matrices, verification evidence, customer\-facing technical documentation, and other controlled engineering artifacts.
* Help maintain alignment between requirements, system architecture, detailed engineering development, verification, and configuration\-controlled product baselines.
* Provide technical mentorship to less\-experienced systems engineering personnel, including guidance on requirements development, traceability, interface definition, verification planning, and system\-level problem solving.
* Help mature practical systems engineering processes, templates, review practices, and documentation standards appropriate for Kraken’s size, products, and stage of growth.
* Support the implementation and ongoing maturation of Jama Connect as Kraken’s requirements management platform.
* Develop and maintain Jama Connect project structures, requirements hierarchies, traceability relationships, verification linkages, review workflows, baselines, and reusable templates.
* Support basic Jama Connect configuration and administration, including project organization, permissions, relationship rules, and governance practices as needed.
* Help establish consistent engineering practices for using Jama Connect across product development efforts.
* Provide guidance and training to engineering personnel on effective requirements development and use of the requirements management environment.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline.
* 5\+ years of relevant engineering experience, including meaningful hands\-on experience performing systems engineering activities on complex products or systems.
* Demonstrated experience developing, decomposing, allocating, and managing technical requirements.
* Working knowledge of requirements traceability, interface management, verification planning, technical baselines, and engineering review processes.
* Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines, including some combination of mechanical, electrical, firmware/software, test, manufacturing, and program functions.
* Experience applying systems engineering practices in a defense, aerospace, high\-reliability, safety\-critical, or similarly structured engineering environment.
* Ability

Prysmian is the world leader in the energy and telecom cable systems industry. Each year, the company manufactures thousands of miles of underground and submarine cables and systems for power transmission and distribution, as well as medium low voltage cables for the construction and infrastructure sectors. We also produce a comprehensive range of optical fibers, copper cables and connectivity for voice, video and data transmission for the telecommunication sector. We are 30,000 employees, across 50\+ countries. Everyone at Prysmian has the potential to make their mark; because whatever you do, wherever you are based, you will be part of a company that is helping transform the world around us.


**Make Your Mark at Prysmian \- Join Us**



The **Controls Engineer** is responsible for the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of all plant automation, control systems, and SCADA infrastructure. This role provides expert support for PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, data systems, and machine troubleshooting, while also driving process improvements and supporting new equipment integration.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Automation \& Controls**


* Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and maintain PLC programs (primarily Allen\-Bradley Studio 5000\).
* Develop and maintain HMI applications using modern high‑performance HMI standards (ISA‑101 preferred).
* Support VFD setup, tuning, communication, and diagnostics.
* Ensure controls logic is robust, well\-structured, and compliant with internal standards (UDTs, AOIs, modular code).
* Maintain accurate documentation including PLC backups, wiring schematics for production lines, network drawings, and change logs.
* Participate in root cause investigations and implement long\-term corrective actions through controls improvements.


**SCADA, Data \& Networking**


* Lead the development and deployment of the plant\-wide SCADA system, including system architecture, dashboard design, historian integration, and reliable data acquisition.
* Develop and maintain data models, tag naming conventions, and controls standards so information is organized consistently across machines, departments, and systems.
* Build and support the data pathways that translate machine behavior into clear, actionable information for operators, supervisors, and engineers — through well‑designed dashboards, trend views, reports, and visual tools that help teams understand performance, variation, and process behavior.
* Configure and support communication interfaces, including PLC\-to\-SCADA links, OPC UA, networked devices, and historian structures.
* Contribute to the design and upkeep of industrial network architecture, including Ethernet/IP topologies, managed switches, and segmentation practices aligned with plant needs.
* Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve system reliability, data clarity, and the speed at which information reaches the people who need it.
* Act as the primary technical resource for SCADA\- and data\-related decisions, ensuring system changes are documented and implemented in a controlled, maintainable manner.


**Project Engineering**


* Lead and support automation upgrades, controls retrofits, and new equipment installations.
* Write engineering specifications for controls requirements on new equipment.
* Review vendor control designs for compliance with plant standards.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, and integration planning.
* Support capital project justification and cost\-benefit analysis.


**Operations \& Maintenance Support**


* Serve as the technical escalation point for controls\-related downtime and operational issues.
* Partner with Maintenance to build troubleshooting capability and improve equipment reliability.
* Develop standard work, troubleshooting guides, and training materials for operators and technicians.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across safety, quality, uptime, throughput, and scrap.


**Safety, Compliance \& Standards**


* Ensure all control systems comply with electrical safety practices and applicable standards.
* Support arc\-flash documentation, safe work policies, and energy isolation procedures.
* Contribute to plant\-wide controls standards, cybersecurity practices, and change management processes.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or related discipline.
* 3\+ years of hands‑on controls engineering experience in manufacturing.
* Proficiency with Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix \& CompactLogix, Studio 5000, Ethernet/IP.
* Experience developing and troubleshooting HMI software/hardware (FactoryTalk View, InTouch, Red Lion, Ignition, or similar).
* Strong understanding of industrial networks, IP addressing, managed switches, VLANs, and communication protocols.
* Experience with VFDs (setup, tuning, integration).
* Ability to read, create, and interpret electrical schematics, P\&IDs, and machine documentation.
* Strong problem‑solving, analytical, and root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to work effectively on the plant floor and support production needs.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Backend Systems Engineer, Industrial IoT Platforms
jobs.description:
**Backend Systems Engineer, Industrial IoT Platforms**
======================================================

**Location:** Grandview Heights, OH

**Your week, at a glance**
--------------------------


On Monday morning, you sync with robotics and controls engineers to map new machine telemetry into ForgeNest’s Universal Operating System. By midweek, you’ve shipped a secure API that streams production data to a new dashboard and tuned a time‑critical data pipeline so operators get live insights on equipment status. Friday, you monitor system health in a live manufacturing cell, push a performance fix, and jump into a quick TypeScript/React tweak to ship a complete feature end‑to‑end.

**The impact you’ll have**
--------------------------

* Design and build reliable backend services and APIs that power ForgeNest’s next‑generation manufacturing platform.
* Model and manage machine, production, and operational data across SQL/NoSQL stores and durable pipelines.
* Integrate services with ForgeNest’s Universal Operating System, machine controllers, sensors, and third‑party tools.
* Deliver secure, scalable RESTful and event‑driven interfaces consumed by web apps and internal systems.
* Develop the backend logic and data services behind real‑time dashboards and visualization tools for operators and engineers.
* Collaborate closely with software, manufacturing, robotics, controls, and company leadership on architecture and requirements.
* Set patterns for service design, data architecture, and development standards that scale with our platform.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve performance and reliability in both dev and live manufacturing environments.
* Prototype new capabilities quickly based on feedback from customers, operators, and internal teams.
* Contribute to UI components when needed using JavaScript/TypeScript and React (or similar) to fully deliver features.

**Who thrives here**
--------------------

* A backend‑first engineer who’s comfortable touching the front end to finish a feature.
* Someone who enjoys translating physical processes into clean, dependable services and data systems.
* A strong communicator across software, manufacturing, robotics, and leadership.
* A builder motivated by resilient infrastructure powering real‑world systems.

**Experience we’re looking for**
--------------------------------

* Professional experience creating backend services, APIs, or distributed systems.
* Proficiency in one or more: Node.js, Python, Go, or Java.
* Hands‑on work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases and thoughtful data modeling.
* Building and integrating RESTful or event‑driven APIs.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and a UI framework such as React.
* Strong understanding of application architecture, service design, and state/data management.
* Experience with real‑time or data‑intensive systems (dashboards, telemetry, operational apps).
* Excellent debugging and problem‑solving across the stack.
* Collaborative experience within a software development team.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Ownership from concept through production.
* Comfort operating in a fast‑moving startup.
* Curiosity about manufacturing, robotics, industrial automation, and physical systems.
* Systems design instincts with a focus on reliability, scalability, and data integrity.
* Ability to communicate complex technical ideas simply.
* Willingness to pick up front‑end work when it helps the team.
* Bonus: experience with manufacturing software, industrial automation, robotics, machine interfaces, or real‑time systems.
* Bonus: message queues, streaming data, or time‑series databases.
* Valued: interest in AI‑enabled software for smarter manufacturing.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

* Rapid understanding of ForgeNest’s technology, backend architecture, and user workflows.
* Ownership of major backend systems that improve reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Establishing backend architecture and development standards that scale with our customers.
* APIs and services that make building robust interfaces straightforward.
* Becoming a trusted technical contributor as the platform and team grow.

**Why ForgeNest**
-----------------

If you want to work on cutting\-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a SME Systems Engineer specializing in aircraft sub\-system integration, airworthiness, and electronic warfare, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.


**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**


The Fighters and Advanced Aircraft Directorate, Special Programs Division develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

* Be a Subject Matter Expert in electronic warfare and systems engineering supporting classified programs utilizing DoD, USAF and common engineering/scientific principles, and procedures.
* Translate operational user requirements into contract system requirements documents.
* Apply systems engineering expertise for modification improvements, hardware/software development, configuration management, data rights, and quality assurance.
* Provide technical and programmatic feedback, develop and present technical briefings, and develop engineering strategies/analyses and technical program documents.

* Develop system\-of\-systems architectures and digital transformation strategies for programs.
* Implement aircraft airworthiness, risk management, and obsolescence tracking processes.
* Evaluate Contractor proposed design changes and solutions, perform systems analyses and technological/trade\-off study assessments, and oversee the correction of deficiencies.
* Support all phases of subsystem component and system\-level integration and testing: develop and review test plans/procedures, test activities oversight, and test result analysis.
* Assess contractor product capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans.
* Develop request for proposal (RFP) technical documents and conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals to include design feasibility and system compatibility.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* An active TOP\-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Masters Degree in an Engineering discipline with a minimum of 20 years relevant experience with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 5 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:


* In\-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition engineering and test support
* Electronic warfare engineering experience
* Expertise in airworthiness, avionics and other aircraft systems and host platform integration
* Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) certification in Systems Planning, Research, Development and Engineering
