### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you want to work on cutting\-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a Senior Anti\-Tamper Engineer specializing in systems engineering and instruction, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division, DoD Anti\-Tamper (AT) Executive Agent Field Program Office (FPO) (AFLCMC/WAG\-AT) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.


WAG\-AT conducts studies to identify new capabilities; matures laboratory technologies to be weapon system ready; and develops, tests, and rapidly fields new AT capabilities/products all which provide insight and foundational AT technology to seed DoD weapon system development programs. These are focused on reducing developmental risk and associated cost and schedule growth, ultimately ensuring AT architectures are developed, supporting protection of US warfighters against loss of life caused by technological exploitation of US weapons systems.


* Apply DoD systems engineering process, policy, and procedures in the acquisition, manufacturing, fielding, and sustainment, modernization and disposal of new, existing and future weapons systems and capabilities, with specific experience in weapon system Program Protection planning and anti\-tamper methods
* Assess integrated circuitry, industry standard processors, and memory chips and determine methodologies for reverse engineering electronic systems and integrated circuitry
* Support ATEA FPO Education and Outreach Lead by developing engineering curriculum modules
* Work with Government and industry partners to develop and update training materials
* Instruct ATEA FPO sponsored educational courses in a classified environment by educating the Anti\-Tamper community using various instructional aids, videos, customized courses, and briefings
* Provide engineering support for technology and product acquisitions to include long\-term planning, request for proposal (RFP) development, and technical oversight of ongoing projects
* Review and analyze proposals for design feasibility and system compatibility
* Assess acquired capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* For program protection, identify technologies and evaluate system/subsystem design functions and improvements to protect Critical Program Information (CPI)
* Evaluate system test plans and participate in conduct of system, subsystem, \& component testing
* Conduct engineering performance, supportability, schedule, and risk assessments and scheduling trade off studies
* Provide specialized support for the Export Integrated Capability Team (ICT) initiatives and enterprise policy modernization; author ad\-hoc technical documentation to ensure continuous compliance and mission support

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* An active TOP\-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 8 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

Additional desired experience and skills:


* Experience with Program Protection planning and implementation in weapon system programs
* Experience evaluating current fielded weapons systems to determine anti\-tamper and reverse engineering susceptibility based on vendor design
* Experience working with industry to assess tamper resistance of current weapons systems within the acquisition development cycle
* Instructor and curriculum development experience

jobs.description:
**About REEcycle**

REEcycle is an American rare earth elements (REE) recycling company focused on recovering rare earths from end\-of\-life NdFeB magnets to bolster U.S. supply chain resilience and reduce dependence on foreign sources of critical minerals. Backed by U.S. Department of War funding, we are establishing production at our facility in Duncan, Oklahoma.

**About the Role**

As we scale toward commercial deployment, we are seeking a Senior Automation Engineer to lead the team and optimize our proprietary systems. A key focus will be on the deployment, testing, and further build out of our Drive Disassembly Machine (DDM), a critical component to REEcycle’s future success. This system efficiently extracts magnets from hard disk drives, creating economically viable feedstocks for our processes.

We are looking for an energetic self\-starter who thrives in dynamic environments, brings inventive and solutions\-oriented thinking, and is ready to play a key role in building the future of U.S. rare earth independence.

If you're excited by the opportunity to lead engineering efforts at a high\-impact company with significant room for career advancement, we’d love to speak with you about our Senior Engineer position.

This is a full\-time, on\-site (not remote) position in Duncan, OK.

**Key Responsibilities**

Lead engineering team on scaling a Mechatronic System

* Lead and manage project and team across all aspects from R\&D to commercial scale implementation.
* Develop deep working knowledge of the company’s proprietary machinery, which integrates hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical assemblies, and PLC\-based control systems.
* Serve as the primary internal engineering point of contact, being a thought leader and systems\-level problem\-solver across all technical aspects of the process and system.

Systems Integration and Troubleshooting

* Understand how the various mechanical and electrical sub\-systems interact, including solenoid valves, pneumatic actuators, linear guides, hydraulic pumps and cylinders, sensors, and control logic.

Deployment and Field Learning

* Support and monitor deployments, ensuring field performance aligns with expectations.

Early Manufacturing Strategy and Vendor Engagement

* Collaborate with operations and supply chain teams to plan for small\-batch production, including component sourcing, assembly workflows, and QA/QC processes.
* Help qualify external manufacturers and assess production feasibility and cost\-efficiency.

Operate as a Technical Leader in a Lean Organization

* Navigate ambiguity and operate autonomously as the primary in\-house engineer, supported by technical advisors and outside collaborators.
* Balance strategic systems thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves when needed, bridging business goals and technical execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, or Manufacturing disciplines).
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in engineering, product development, or manufacturing environments.
* 2\+ years of engineering leadership experience, managing teams and driving project execution.
* Proven ability to lead end\-to\-end equipment manufacturing projects, including planning, budgeting, scheduling, and vendor coordination.
* Strong proficiency in CAD platforms, specifically SolidWorks.
* In\-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes, industrial materials, design for manufacturability, and supply chain logistics.

* Experience taking custom/prototype industrial machinery from concept to commercialization.

* Comfort working in agile or fast\-moving hardware development environments.
* Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to bridge technical and business functions.
* Ability to grow and lead the procurement and development teams, with experience reporting directly to senior management and the C\-Suite.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary commensurate with experience with annual incentive opportunity.
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus a 401(k)\-retirement plan with company match.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer (Perception)
jobs.description:
**About Treeswift:**


In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.


We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.


Since our first pilot with a utility in June 2024, we've grown fast, now working with three of the five largest utilities in the US. To date, our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.


To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission\-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.


We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.


Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

**About the role**


As a senior robotics engineer you will drive outcomes across perception, mapping, sensor fusion and calibration that directly contribute to the expansion of our business. As our business grows these needs will change; first priorities for this role will include:

* **Improving the quality and consistency of our product in an increasing breadth of operating conditions.** For example, you will lead SLAM development including incorporating new sensor evolutions and exploring innovative approaches to improving performance in GPS degraded environments.
* **Accelerating our time to delivery by leveling up our sensor fusion and calibration.** This includes fusing multi\-user, multi\-session point cloud maps and automating alignment of LiDAR and imagery data to produce consistent large\-scale scenes.
* **Power scalability and reliability** by eliminating the need for extrinsic measurements on our vehicle sensors in the field and improving our ability to catch and correct potential data quality issues at their source.
* **This role will be hybrid, with 2\-3 days in office,** based out of our New York, Philadelphia, or San Francisco offices.

**Experience / Skills**

* 5\-10 years of experience in perception for robotics
* Comfortable in a fast\-pace and high\-ownership environment. You’re excited to collaborate, but also comfortable developing your own opinions.
* Proficient in C\+\+ and Python
* Extensive experience developing SLAM solutions, ideally involving ground\-based LiDAR
* Experience with extrinsic and intrinsic sensor calibration, including automated data\-driven calibration
* Prior experience with ultra\-wide angle cameras is a nice\-to\-have

**What We Value**

* **Mission first.** We value team members who are focused on working towards the best outcomes for the customer and the business.
* **Curiosity.** We are constantly learning – from each other and from our customers.. We aren’t afraid to learn we were wrong in the process and adapt our approach accordingly.
* **Owners mindset.** If you see an opportunity for improvement, run with it. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere, no matter your role.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity package
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents
* Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents
* Flexible, unlimited paid time off
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Free OneMedical membership
* Commuter benefits
* Snacks, goodies, and team lunches provided twice a week to keep you fueled and connected with your colleagues.

**Salary**


The estimated salary range for this position is $160,000 \- $210,000 USD. Total compensation for this position is determined by skills, qualifications, relevant work experience, location, and other factors. This salary estimate excludes the value of any potential bonuses; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.


Treeswift is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.


If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is seeking experienced **Electrical Engineers** to join the Autonomous Maritime Systems Test Center (AMSTC) team in Newport, RI. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and testing of advanced unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) systems for critical military programs. This role supports both internal R\&D efforts and external stakeholders, with a focus on system integration, product documentation, and troubleshooting pre and post\-test sea testing. This position requires the ability to work in a controlled and compliance\-driven environment while supporting mission\-critical capabilities.  

Serco supports the Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC), including support for the design, acquisition, testing and sustainment of naval undersea warfare systems. * Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot, test, and refine electrical systems.

* Active DoD Secret Security Clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline.
* 5 years of professional experience in electrical/electronic design.

* Strong understanding of integrated circuits, power systems, FPGAs, and microcontrollers.

jobs.title: Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer Specialist
jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer Specialist.


The expected annual salary range for this role is $122000 \- $179000 a year.


Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.  



* *This Hybrid role must work on\-site 3 days weekly at our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation assistance is available for a qualified candidate currently residing in the US.*

*Additionally, if needed H1B visa transfer sponsorship assistance for a qualified candidate currently residing and employed on a H1B in the USA.*

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division is currently seeking a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. This position will be a hybrid office/remote role as long as you live within 50 miles of our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only.**  

  



Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division designs, manufactures, and services Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, batteries, and electronic\-based products to ensure power reliability in the most demanding applications. Our employees deliver mission\-critical solutions to our customers’ most challenging energy management requirements.


Making what matters work at Eaton takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention and discovery become reality, each and every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours.  



  

**Why Eaton?**

* Be a key member of a world\-class organization that creates market leading 3\-phase products.
* Opportunities for career advancement through a defined technical track as well as broader Eaton career opportunities in various business functions. Raleigh is an Engineering Hub with roles in: Service, Manufacturing/Assembly, New Product Development, and Product Management.
* Work in a modern hybrid collaborative environment. Eaton is committed to fostering a successful work/life balance.
* Competitive salary and benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, tuition reimbursement, paid holidays, vacation, paid parental leave.

  

**Position Overview:**

As a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer you will support our product development and design of our high\-power three\-phase UPS’s. This role also supports products in our Energy Storage and next generation AI load\-smoothing product lines. The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team.


You will be responsible for conceptualizing, developing and designing advanced real\-time DSP algorithms for advanced power conversion applications in the power quality industry.
  

The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team. If you have a passion for design of power electronics\-centric controls design and development, this role is for you.


**In this role you will:**
--------------------------

  

* Successfully launch critical power infrastructure products that meet customer requirements and Eaton safety, quality, reliability, cost and schedule commitments.
* Leverage your skill and experience by giving guidance and leadership to other technical project team members.
* Work with global product development teams to solve problems related to performance, functionality, safety, reliability, quality and component availability.
* Develop mathematical models and algorithms for advanced DSP controls of electronic power conversion products.
* Develop simulations using MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment and verify control designs through simulations.
* Develop converter control algorithms and drive their validation across simulations and HIL testbeds.
* Evaluate competing controls architectures and designs to select the best suited for the application.
* Apply controls theory to design controllers to achieve target product performance.
* Validate designs using Real time simulation systems such as OPAL\-RT.
* Participate as team member in new product development projects (uninterruptible power systems, energy storage and advanced technology products) while meeting schedule, cost and product performance goals. Interface closely with cross\-functional team members.
* Lead product development using new technologies based on POCs from Eaton COEs and ERLs.
* Analyze, design and assist in testing/troubleshooting control system software used in uninterruptible power systems and other power quality products.
* Apply best engineering practices and decision making for advanced technical problem solving.
* Foster an environment that promotes Eaton’s goals, philosophies, and encourages continuous improvement.

  

When we embrace the different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds that make each of us unique, we — as individuals and as a company — are stronger.


**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required (Basic) Qualifications:**  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited institution with minimum 8 years work industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* MS in Electrical or related Engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 5 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* PhD in Electrical or related engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 2 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products.

jobs.description:
### **Embedded Software Engineer – Job Description**

**Job Title:** Software Engineer  

**Department:** Engineering  

**Reports To:** Program Manager and Engineering Director  

**FLSA Status:** Exempt / Full\-time

**Security Clearance required**

**Salary Range:** $90,000 \- $125,000 Annually (depending on experience)

**ROLE**


We are seeking a skilled **Embedded Software Engineer** to design, develop, and integrate software for embedded systems. This role covers the full development lifecycle with a strong emphasis on testing and validation to ensure functionality and reliability. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and the ability to present and explain software solutions to internal teams and customers.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Perform full lifecycle development for embedded systems, including implementation, unit testing, and integration.
* Review customer requirements, translate them into specifications, and produce technical documentation, designs, and operational concepts.
* Collaborate closely with hardware engineers to ensure seamless integration of software with electronic components and boards.
* Develop and execute test plans and procedures; perform debugging, troubleshooting, and ensure compliance with functional specifications.
* Conduct design and code reviews, resolve defects, and adhere to established development processes, configuration management, and release practices.
* Work under technical leadership while demonstrating initiative and self\-direction.
* Design and implement software for real\-time operating systems (RTOS) with strict timing constraints.
* Develop low\-level device drivers and support component\-level integration.
* Support automated build and test pipelines for embedded software.
* Present and explain software designs and solutions to internal teams and customers.
**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Strong proficiency in C programming for embedded Linux or RTOS environments.
* Experience integrating software with custom processor\-based circuit card assemblies.
* Working knowledge of higher\-level programming languages, including C\+\+ and Python.
* Experience in requirements development and management.
* Familiarity with formal verification procedures.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment on projects with many requirements.
**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Bare\-metal, register\-level configuration/setup software
* Device driver development for UARTs, I²C, SPI, and similar interfaces.
* Experience with Yocto or Buildroot embedded Linux build environments.
* Experience with toolchains such as JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket (Git), and Jenkins.
* Knowledge of Requirements frameworks, especially DOORS, Jama and Excel.
* Experience with testing equipment, instrumentation, and data acquisition tools.
* Knowledge of messaging protocols within the OSI 7‑layer stack.
* Working knowledge of C\+\+, Python and C\#.
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience.
* US Person required; ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret clearance.
* Position located in Melbourne, FL and Greenville, SC

The Electrical Design Engineer will play a pivotal role in designing, analyzing, and optimizing the products within the gas power portfolio. This role involves working across various stages of the product lifecycle, from initial design to field issue resolution. The engineer will ensure technical excellence, safety, and performance of electrical components and systems through advanced analysis, innovative design, and continuous improvement.

===================

* Design and analyze electrical components throughout the gas power product portfolio.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.

2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  

3\. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  

4\. 401(k) Plan

jobs.title: Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer Specialist
jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer Specialist.


The expected annual salary range for this role is $122000 \- $179000 a year.


Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.  



* *This Hybrid role must work on\-site 3 days weekly at our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation assistance is available for a qualified candidate currently residing in the US.*

*Additionally, if needed H1B visa transfer sponsorship assistance for a qualified candidate currently residing and employed on a H1B in the USA.*

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

**Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division is currently seeking a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. This position will be a hybrid office/remote role as long as you live within 50 miles of our Raleigh, NC facility. Relocation benefits will be provided within the United States only.**  

  



Eaton’s Electrical Critical Power Solutions Division designs, manufactures, and services Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, batteries, and electronic\-based products to ensure power reliability in the most demanding applications. Our employees deliver mission\-critical solutions to our customers’ most challenging energy management requirements.


Making what matters work at Eaton takes the passion of every employee around the world. We create an environment where creativity, invention and discovery become reality, each and every day. It’s where bold, bright professionals like you can reach your full potential—and where you can help us reach ours.  



  

**Why Eaton?**

* Be a key member of a world\-class organization that creates market leading 3\-phase products.
* Opportunities for career advancement through a defined technical track as well as broader Eaton career opportunities in various business functions. Raleigh is an Engineering Hub with roles in: Service, Manufacturing/Assembly, New Product Development, and Product Management.
* Work in a modern hybrid collaborative environment. Eaton is committed to fostering a successful work/life balance.
* Competitive salary and benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, tuition reimbursement, paid holidays, vacation, paid parental leave.

  

**Position Overview:**

As a Specialist Digital Controls and Embedded Software Engineer you will support our product development and design of our high\-power three\-phase UPS’s. This role also supports products in our Energy Storage and next generation AI load\-smoothing product lines. The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team.


You will be responsible for conceptualizing, developing and designing advanced real\-time DSP algorithms for advanced power conversion applications in the power quality industry.
  

The role includes all aspects of product design life cycle from concept to production as part of a global, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary team. If you have a passion for design of power electronics\-centric controls design and development, this role is for you.


**In this role you will:**
--------------------------

  

* Successfully launch critical power infrastructure products that meet customer requirements and Eaton safety, quality, reliability, cost and schedule commitments.
* Leverage your skill and experience by giving guidance and leadership to other technical project team members.
* Work with global product development teams to solve problems related to performance, functionality, safety, reliability, quality and component availability.
* Develop mathematical models and algorithms for advanced DSP controls of electronic power conversion products.
* Develop simulations using MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment and verify control designs through simulations.
* Develop converter control algorithms and drive their validation across simulations and HIL testbeds.
* Evaluate competing controls architectures and designs to select the best suited for the application.
* Apply controls theory to design controllers to achieve target product performance.
* Validate designs using Real time simulation systems such as OPAL\-RT.
* Participate as team member in new product development projects (uninterruptible power systems, energy storage and advanced technology products) while meeting schedule, cost and product performance goals. Interface closely with cross\-functional team members.
* Lead product development using new technologies based on POCs from Eaton COEs and ERLs.
* Analyze, design and assist in testing/troubleshooting control system software used in uninterruptible power systems and other power quality products.
* Apply best engineering practices and decision making for advanced technical problem solving.
* Foster an environment that promotes Eaton’s goals, philosophies, and encourages continuous improvement.

  

When we embrace the different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds that make each of us unique, we — as individuals and as a company — are stronger.


**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Required (Basic) Qualifications:**  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering from an accredited institution with minimum 8 years work industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* MS in Electrical or related Engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 5 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products OR
* PhD in Electrical or related engineering degree from an accredited institution with minimum 2 years of industry work experience in real\-time digital controls and algorithms for power electronics or industrial products.
*\*I

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer / Remote USA (PTX91526)
jobs.description:
**Company Summary**


RealManage is a leading national community association management company serving homeowners' associations (HOAs), condominium associations, cooperatives, luxury high\-rises, municipal utility districts, master\-planned communities, and nationally recognized developer and builder clients. RealManage is proud to be recognized on the **Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies** and ranked among the top firms in the community management industry. We combine experienced people, innovative technology, and proven practices to help communities thrive.


At RealManage, **The RM Way is our service identity** \- something we live every day. It provides a shared definition of what great looks like, a common language for coaching and recognition, and a standard every associate can own. It guides how we serve our clients, how we serve each other, and how we grow.


Our commitment to an exceptional associate experience is reflected in RealManage being **Great Place to Work® Certified™**. We believe exceptional client experiences start with our associates, and we foster a workplace where people are supported, encouraged to grow, and empowered to deliver outstanding service.


Join RealManage and be part of a values\-based organization where The RM Way shapes how we serve, work, grow, coach, and recognize one another every day \- while making the communities we manage stronger because RealManage is there.

**Our Guiding Values**


RealManage is a values\-based company with the following values as our guiding principles:

* **Integrity:** we always do the right thing.
* **Respect:** for our customers, employees and company; mutual respect is the cornerstone for every RealManage relationship.
* **Selflessness:** more than teamwork; we are part of something special and much larger than any of us.
* **Personal Relationships:** we are a professional services company; people do business with people they like.
* **Always Improving:** never satisfied, always learning, and always growing. At RealManage, we are always getting better.




RealManage runs the technology that powers how thousands of communities are governed, funded, and cared for. Now we're modernizing that platform into something new: an event\-driven, agentic operating system that can run autonomous, agentic processes across the business. We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help lead that transformation from the front, not the sidelines.


This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain the status quo or wait for a rigid playbook. It's for an engineer who is genuinely excited about what AI makes possible right now and someone who is opinionated about *how* software should be built today, rooted in strong principles, and restless enough to keep questioning their own assumptions.


You'll build *with* AI and you'll build *into* AI. You'll orchestrate coding agents as core infrastructure to ship faster and better, and you'll architect the event\-driven systems and autonomous agentic processes that will define the next decade of our platform. Both matter. Equally.

* **Must be located in the US and be authorized to work in the US.**
* **We are unable to provide sponsorship**

**How We Build**

*The principles that define how this team operates. If they make you lean in, keep reading.*

* AI\-native, top to bottom. Everyone here builds and ships with AI, from prototype to production. You wield coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor as primary tooling, not a novelty. If a task can be delegated to an agent and verified faster than you can hand\-type it, that's the job. Leverage is the point.
* Agents in the product, not just the process. We're evolving the platform into an agentic OS. Event\-driven systems and autonomous processes that reason, decide, and act on behalf of the communities we serve. You'll help architect them from first principles, safely and at scale.

* **Own the outcome, end to end.** You design it, build it, ship it, and run it. Accountability is a feature, not a bug. When you own the whole loop, you build better.

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is redefining accelerated computing and powering the next era of artificial intelligence. Our data\-center platforms bring together GPUs, CPUs, networking, systems, and software to solve some of the world’s most exciting computing problems. We are looking for a Senior System Software Engineer to join NVIDIA’s Datacenter Performance and Power Management Software team. You will be responsible for architecting production software for datacenter power management controllers. Your work will also cover cluster\- level dynamic provisioning and power\-management control system technologies for next\-generation data\-centers.

  

You will work at the intersection of hardware architecture, embedded firmware, device drivers, operating systems, and AI workloads. Your responsibilities will span the entire product lifecycle—from initial architectural design and pre\-silicon validation through silicon bring\-up, productization, and deployment in extensive data\-center infrastructures. This is an outstanding chance to influence how next\-generation NVIDIA GPUs provide top\-tier performance, energy efficiency, and reliability.

 **What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Architect, build, implement, and debug data center power and performance\-management software, with particular emphasis on end\-to\-end power management at racks and data halls.
* Develop real\-time controllers, policies, and mechanisms that dynamically optimize performance, power, thermals, and energy efficiency under demanding data\-center workloads.
* Drive features across the full product lifecycle: requirements, architecture, implementation, pre\-silicon validation, silicon bring\-up, productization, and production support.
* Collaborate with GPU architects and hardware designers to define hardware\-software interfaces and influence the power\-management capabilities of next\-generation processors.
* Analyze complex interactions among workloads, clocks, voltages, power limits, thermals, telemetry, and system\-level policies.
* Lead the investigation and resolution of complex power, performance, stability, and reliability issues spanning firmware, drivers, hardware, and platform software.
* Develop validation strategies and automation for functional correctness, transition latency, performance\-per\-watt, and robustness across operating conditions.
* Build clear architecture, interface, and compose specifications for new power\-management features.
* Partner with geographically distributed architecture, ASIC, firmware, driver, validation, platform, and data\-center systems teams.

 **What We Need to See:**

* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent experience.
* At least 12\+ years of extensive industry experience crafting system software, embedded firmware, device drivers, or other hardware\-related production software.
* Strong programming skills in C, including experience developing, debugging, and maintaining complex low\-level software.
* Deep understanding of operating\-system fundamentals, device\-driver architecture, embedded or real\-time software, concurrency, interrupt handling, and hardware programming.
* Experience interpreting hardware specifications and developing software interfaces for registers, telemetry, interrupts, and control mechanisms.
* Strong understanding of computer architecture and hardware\-software interactions.
* Proven ability to independently debug complex problems across multiple software and hardware layers.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across organizational and geographic boundaries.

 **Ways to Stand Out From the Crowd:**

* Background with architecting, designing, or implementing datacenter provisioning, monitoring, and managing power at a CSP/NCP.
* Hands\-on experience with GPU, CPU, accelerator, or SoC power and performance management.
* Background with crafting or implementing P\-state selection, DVFS, clock\-control, voltage\-control, power\-capping, thermal\-management, throttling, or workload\-aware control policies.
* Experience developing real\-time feedback controllers, including reasoning about stability, responsiveness, hysteresis, latency, and noisy telemetry.
* Understanding of electrical and platform considerations such as voltage\-frequency relationships, transient power, thermal limits, power delivery, and system\-level power budgets.


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 224,000 USD \- 356,500 USD for Level 5, and 272,000 USD \- 431,250 USD for Level 6\.

jobs.description:
**Description**


Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.


Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

**About The Role:**


We are seeking a Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join our high\-performance engineering organization as a full\-time, hands\-on individual contributor. In this role, you will be embedded within a cross\-functional team owning critical segments of our consumer ecosystem.


Our engineering organization is structured so that each domain team owns its vertical stack end\-to\-end—from backend microservices and APIs through frontend and DevOps. We are looking for an engineer with genuine depth across all layers of the stack who can move seamlessly between backend logic and rich frontend experiences, contributing independently within their first few weeks.


Beyond technical skills, we want someone who is innovative, proactive, and self\-driven—an engineer who actively seeks out better tools, raises quality standards, and delivers without waiting for direction. We place a premium on self\-learners who challenge the status quo, take genuine pride in the reliability of what they ship, and comfortably navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment.


Potential Teams you will get to work on:


1\. New Constructions

* The Focus: Powering the leading builder listing platform in the US, empowering a diverse range of consumers to discover and customize their dream homes.
* What You’ll Work On: Building hyper\-customized web experiences for vibrant new communities, optimizing high\-velocity frontends for substantial traffic and search engine optimization (SEO), enhancing backend services, modernizing infrastructure, expanding automated test suites, and engineering automated developer toolchains for instantaneous cloud service provisioning.


2\. Mortgage \& Financial Services

* The Focus: Building the digital future of home financing by creating seamless, secure, and transparent financial tools for buyers and lenders.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Product Delivery: Design, build, and maintain high\-traffic features and partner integrations across the full vertical stack (backend, APIs, frontend, infrastructure, databases).

* Operational Ownership: Take full accountability for the operational quality, observability, and reliability of your services—including setting SLOs, monitoring, alerting, and incident response readiness.
* Data \& Security: Ensure data integrity, secure engineering practices, and compliance\-aware design when handling sensitive consumer, financial, and high\-volume marketplace data.
* Modern Workflow Innovation: Leverage and champion the adoption of AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Windsurf, Portkey, Gemini) to optimize development workflows.
* Leadership \& Collaboration: Drive project delivery with strong personal ownership—managing scope, timelines, and cross\-functional dependencies. Communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders to build trust quickly.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Experience: Bring 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and scaling distributed systems and high\-traffic, consumer\-facing products.
* True Full\-Stack Capability: Demonstrate proven depth across backend services, RESTful/GraphQL APIs, modern frontend frameworks (React or equivalent), and cloud/DevOps.
* Backend Expertise: Utilize your strong experience with Node.js and microservice architectures.
* Domain Background: Leverage your experience building search, marketplace, listing\-based, or financial services products (e.g., loan application flows, rate calculators, lender/partner API integrations).
* Operational Rigor: Take direct ownership of production infrastructure, including observability, SLOs, and incident management.
* Execution: Apply strong project management skills to independently drive features from scoping through delivery in an agile, matrixed environment.

jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Lead Electrical Engineer serves as a technical leader responsible for the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of advanced electronic systems for downhole drilling and measurement technologies. This position leads electrical engineering efforts across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and survivability in harsh high\-pressure/high\-temperature (HPHT) downhole environments.

The role provides technical leadership throughout the product lifecycle, from concept development and system architecture through qualification, commercialization, and field support. The successful candidate will collaborate with global engineering teams, customers, suppliers, and operational groups to develop innovative technologies that enhance company capabilities, improve reliability, and drive profitability.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITES:**

* Lead the design, development, validation, commercialization, and sustaining support of electrical and electronic systems for downhole drilling, measurement, and control technologies.
* Develop system architectures, design specifications, requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
* Own PCB and electronic hardware development from concept through production release, including schematic capture, component selection, layout review, testing, troubleshooting, and manufacturability considerations.
* Design and qualify electronic systems capable of reliable operation in harsh downhole environments including high\-pressure, high\-temperature (HPHT), shock, and vibration conditions.
* Lead technical decision\-making and provide engineering guidance throughout all phases of product development while collaborating with mechanical, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams.
* Develop and execute verification, qualification, environmental, and reliability test programs to ensure product performance, durability, and commercialization readiness.
* Lead root cause failure investigations, reliability improvement initiatives, corrective actions, and continuous improvement efforts to enhance product performance and field reliability.
* Manage multiple concurrent domestic and international engineering projects, ensuring technical, schedule, and budget objectives are achieved.
* Support field trials, product launches, customer demonstrations, and operational deployments while providing technical support to customers, sales, manufacturing, and field operations personnel.
* Identify, evaluate, and implement new technologies, products, and intellectual property opportunities that support strategic growth objectives and expand the company's technology portfolio.
* Collaborate with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and strategic partners to ensure component availability, product quality, manufacturability, and long\-term supportability.
* Serve as a technical liaison between global engineering teams, customers, and stakeholders while effectively communicating project status, technical risks, and development plans.
* Contribute to technology roadmaps, project planning, resource allocation, budget forecasting, and strategic business initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and development support to engineers and technicians while promoting a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with applicable company policies, engineering standards, quality systems, and regulatory requirements.

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS****:**

· Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline

· Minimum 7\-10 years of experience in electrical engineering, R\&D, or product development

· Experience designing and validating electrical systems

· Hands\-on experience with board\-level design and ruggedization, bring\-up, and debugging

· Valid driver’s license

· Valid passport and the ability to travel both domestically (frequently) and internationally (occasionally)

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS (PREFERRED)****:**

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering or related discipline
* Experience with
* embedded electronics and microcontroller\-based systems.
* high\-temperature electronic component selection and qualification.
* power management, battery systems, and low\-power electronics.
* EMC/EMI design and testing
* (PLM) systems and engineering change processes
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, CAN, RS\-485, Ethernet, and telemetry systems.
* Experience with design for manufacturability (DFM), design for assembly (DFA), and design for testability (DFT).

For MWD/LWD specifically:

* Experience with downhole telemetry systems including mud pulse, electromagnetic, wired drill pipe, or rotary steerable technologies.
* Understanding of drilling dynamics, shock, vibration, and downhole environmental effects on electronics.

Join us to lead transformative projects that shape the future of electrical engineering! We value innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence—if you’re ready to make an impact in a fast\-paced environment dedicated to engineering advancement, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year

* Do you currently reside in the greater Houston area?

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Associate- Level 1
jobs.description:
**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------



Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control (MFC) is seeking a motivated entry\-level Electrical Engineer to join our hardware engineering team. MFC is a recognized designer, developer, and manufacturer of precision engagement aerospace and defense systems for the U.S. and allied militaries. This role is ideal for a recent graduate or early\-career professional looking to develop hands\-on electrical engineering skills in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.  

  

**What You Will Be Doing**  

  

The Associate Electrical Engineer will support the design, development, integration, and test of electrical hardware across a variety of defense programs. Responsibilities may include:  

  

* Assisting production and development teams with resolving technical challenges, incorporating engineering changes, updating drawings and assembly parts lists, and developing new designs or tools

  

* Supporting circuit card assembly (CCA) design, including schematic capture, PCB layout, and design documentation

  

* Performing circuit simulation and analysis using tools such as LTspice, PSpice, Simulink, NI Multisim, or MATLAB

  

* Utilizing test equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, function generators, signal generators, network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and logic analyzers) to support hardware bring\-up and troubleshooting

  

* Supporting hardware operations and providing assistance to engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operations teams

  

* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to support design integration and interface resolution

  

* Developing and maintaining technical documentation, including test procedures, design reports, and engineering change documentation

  

This position offers the opportunity to work alongside experienced electrical engineering professionals and gain exposure to cutting\-edge defense technology. Strong career growth and advancement opportunities are available.  

  

Candidates may be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.  

At Lockheed Martin we keep people safe and solve the world's most complex challenges. Our people are some of the greatest minds in the industry and truly make Lockheed Martin a great place to work. With our employees as our priority, we provide career opportunities designed to propel development and boost agility. Our flexible schedules, competitive pay, and comprehensive benefits enable our employees to live a healthy, fulfilling life at and outside of work. This is a place for engineers, scientists, and problem\-solvers who are ready to engage deeply, think critically, and build with purpose. You will not just launch a career. You will be part of something bigger. This is where the best are built. Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


- Bachelor Degree degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related STEM field from an accredited university.
  

  

- Experience with schematic capture and/ or PCB layout tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Eagle, KiCad, Mentor Graphics, Cadence, etc.)
  

  

- Experience with simulation tools (LTspice, PSpice, Simulink, NI Multisim, MATLAB, etc.)
  

  

- Familiarity with test equipment (This may include oscilloscope, multimeter, function generator, signal generator, network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, logic analyzer, etc.)
  

  

- Must be a US Citizen; must be able to obtain/maintain a DoD Secret clearance
**Desired Skills**

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  


### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large\-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety\-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands\-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands\-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.


#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Collaborates with other engineers to develop accurate, efficient equipment and instrumentation in accordance with safety and usability standards and client expectations.
* Collaborates with other electrical engineers to execute the safe arming and initiation of rocket motors under test.
* Designs PCBA and electrical system components with hands on testing and rework as necessary
* Creates detailed schematics and simulated models to test designs; optimizes designs for performance, reliability, and cost.
* Oversees the implementation of new measuring devices and control systems, ensuring devices are correctly installed and properly tested.
* Acts as project engineer for design, prototype fabrication, and manufacturing development.
* Develops required cable drawings to interface to various low\- and high\-voltage systems
* Drafts and presents formal technical documents, reports, and testing results to manager for approval.
* Provides training related to devices to employees and/or customers.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Proven experience in safety\-critical hardware design, incorporating multi\-fault tolerance, arm/fire inhibits, safe bleed\-down circuits, and inadvertent initiation mitigation.
* Experience in high\-voltage PCB layout and circuit design for motor initiation, including capacitor charging/discharge circuits, high peak\-current switching, and creepage/clearance management
* Experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors employed to collect data on system performance.
* NI Labview or NI DAQmx experience or familiar with other COTS data acquisition systems
* Thorough understanding of signal conditioning for data acquisition, i.e. analog circuit design
* Intimate knowledge of the analog to digital conversion process, i.e. digital circuit design
* Understand Computer controlled data acquisition and able to develop computer applications for data collection.
* Able to select the correct sensors and design the placement of them to acquire the needed solid rocket motor performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and proficient with computer\-aided design software.
* Ability to write and understand Python
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Advanced degree in engineering
* Experience with circuit simulation tools (spice)
* Experience using EDA tools such as Altium/Or CAD
* Familiar with real\-time computer architectures and their OS's

jobs.title: Robotics Systems Engineer II, Tech Deployment
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Engineer II, a candidate will typically own multiple simultaneous deployments of a single technology across multiple sites or oversee multi\-technology deployments within a single site; delivering within documented standards. This role requires a balance of experience both in working with high\-complexity industrial technologies, with complex, multi\-dependency project management. The ideal candidate is proactive and takes independent initiative in improving system performance and handling end\-to\-end deployment. In parallel to the execution, candidates will be responsible for driving continuous improvement ideas into both the deployment cycle time (safety, quality and productivity), and will be responsible for sharing engineering design improvements feedback to the hardware engineering and product teams, to simplify the installation. This role will require the ability to build relationships and capture and synthesize the voice of the customer.
  

You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
  

  

* You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go\-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
* You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
* You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
* You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources
* You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
* You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
* You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
* You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
* You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results

  

A day in the life  

In this role you will be focused on execution of end\-to\-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, construction teams, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure a safe, on time, high quality product is delivered to the internal customer. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day\-to\-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve deployment execution first pass yield. You will work with senior engineers and your manager to develop technical depth and begin building strategic thinking skills for future growth.
  

  

Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full\-time employees include:
  

  

1\. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  

2\. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
  

3\. Paid Time Off (PTO)
  

4\. 401(k) Plan

* You read and write sequences of operations.

**Integration \& Test Leadership**

The mission of Electronic Power Design, Inc. is to craft quality electrical equipment for our clients and uphold a standard of excellence in the engineering, design and manufacturing process. We strive to improve the quality of life of our employees by creating a work environment conducive to personal development, success and fulfillment. We are driven by our vision of being the preferred manufacturer, electrical systems integrator and worldwide service company by providing our clients with value\-added solutions that power their lives.


**About Us**



At Electronic Power Design, Inc. (EPD), we don't just build electrical equipment—we power industries and change lives. Our mission is to deliver top\-quality electrical solutions while fostering an environment where employees thrive. We believe in innovation, collaboration, and empowering our people to reach their full potential.


**The Opportunity**



EPD is seeking a motivated and technically skilled **Field Services Engineer** to join our growing Field Services team. This role is responsible for installing, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintaining, and supporting electrical power distribution systems at customer locations throughout the United States and internationally.



This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, traveling to customer sites, and working directly with customers to ensure reliable operation of mission\-critical electrical equipment.


**What You'll Do**


**Field Engineering \& Technical Support**


* Install, commission, test, troubleshoot, repair, and maintain electrical power distribution systems.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, protective relays, breakers, and automation systems.
* Analyze system performance and recommend corrective actions to improve reliability and minimize downtime.
* Read and interpret electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.


**Customer Service \& Project Support**


* Serve as a professional representative of EPD at customer locations.
* Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project updates with customers and project stakeholders.
* Provide customer training and operational guidance as needed.
* Build strong customer relationships through exceptional service and professionalism.


**Safety \& Compliance**


* Follow OSHA, NFPA 70E, customer site requirements, and EPD safety policies.
* Utilize proper PPE and safe electrical work practices.
* Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas while promoting a culture of safety.


**Documentation \& Continuous Improvement**


* Complete service reports, commissioning documentation, startup records, and technical reports.
* Document troubleshooting activities and recommended corrective actions.
* Participate in technical training, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support manufacturing and engineering teams when not assigned to field service projects.


**What You Bring**


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering discipline.
* 0–2 years of engineering experience; internships and co\-op experience welcomed.
* Knowledge of electrical power systems and industrial controls.
* Ability to read electrical schematics, technical drawings, and engineering documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
* Willingness to travel up to 80% domestically and internationally.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with electrical commissioning, startup, or field service.
* Familiarity with switchboards, motor control centers, generators, PLCs, VFDs, and protective relays.
* Knowledge of OSHA regulations, NFPA 70E, and electrical safety practices.
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, renewable energy, utilities, or power generation.
* First Aid/CPR certification.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.


**Physical Requirements**


* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the workday.
* Ability to safely lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to lift bulky or awkward materials with or without assistance.
* Ability to work in varying indoor and outdoor environments, including heat and cold.
* Ability to travel extensively and work safely at customer facilities.


**Why Join EPD?**


**Work on Critical Infrastructure**



Support projects that power industrial facilities, manufacturing plants, energy operations, and critical infrastructure.


**Accelerate Your Engineering Career**



Gain hands\-on experience with complex electrical systems while developing valuable field engineering expertise.


**Travel \& Professional Growth**



Work in diverse environments and gain exposure to advanced electrical technologies and customer applications.


**Collaborative Culture**



Join a team that values safety, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement.


**Competitive Compensation \& Benefits**



EPD offers competitive compensation, professional development opportunities, travel experience, and a comprehensive employee benefits package.


**Ready to Power the Future?**



If you're an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, working directly with customers, and making a measurable impact in the field, we encourage you to apply and become part of the EPD Field Services team. Add job description when creating a specific template.

jobs.description:
**Department:** Technology
  
  

Our Company Promise
  
  

We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Creativity and innovation are encouraged for improving the effectiveness of Southwest Airlines. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.
  
  

**Job Description:**  

The Senior Software Engineer will join a growing team responsible for Ground Operations' Workforce Strategy \& Planning applications, including the development of a modern, internally built platform that will replace the current long\-term workforce planning solution. In this role, you'll help design, build, test, release, and support workforce optimization products that drive staffing, planning, and operational decision\-making across Ground Operations. The platform's capabilities will play a critical role in helping Southwest optimize resources, improve operational reliability, and enhance the experience for both Employees and Customers. Team members have a unique opportunity to shape a strategic product from the ground up and directly influence how Southwest plans and manages its Ground Operations workforce for years to come. You'll leverage AI\-enabled tools and modern engineering practices to solve complex technical challenges and deliver reliable, high\-quality solutions that support operational success.
  
  

The Senior Software Engineer role also includes mentoring fellow Engineers, providing technical leadership, and driving the delivery of scalable, maintainable solutions.
  
  

Additional Details
  
  

This role allows for voluntary remote work for the majority of your working time within the Dallas\-Fort Worth area, with occasional on\-site presence at our Corporate Campus for training, meetings, and business needs. This role may also require limited travel for business purposes.
  
U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.
  
  

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.
