jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The Sr. Software Engineer is a technical leader within the Software Development \& Infrastructure team, responsible for the architecture, design, and delivery of complex features across RMS (HomeAdvantage's proprietary platform), life administration systems, websites, workflows, and automated processes. This position owns full\-lifecycle development from systems design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.


  
About Us
Austin, Texas\-based Keller Williams Realty, LLC is the world's largest real estate franchise by agent count with a global network of offices and affiliated agents. The franchise is No. 1 in units and sales volume in the U.S. Since 1983, the company has cultivated an agent\-centric, technology\-driven, and education\-based culture that rewards affiliated agents. If you're ready to join an award\-winning team that champions bold innovation, puts people and service at the heart of business, and empowers you to make a real impact, then Keller Williams is where you belong.
  

**Our latest recognition:*** 2026 \& 2025 Best Places to Work (Glassdoor)
* 2026 \& 2025 Best Place for Working ParentsÂ® (Best Place for Working ParentsÂ®)
* 2025 America's Most Admired Workplaces (Newsweek)
* 2025 Top Franchises for Women (Franchise Business Review)
* 2025 Best\-Led Companies (Glassdoor)

  
The Impact You'll Make
* Designs, develops, and maintains full\-stack web applications using C\#, ASP.NET, and .NET Core on the back end and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., Angular, Blazor) on the front end
* Works with a SQL Server database and contributes to database design and optimization
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams including UI/UX designers, product managers, and other developers to implement new features and enhance existing ones
* Develops RESTful APIs and integrates third\-party services
* Optimizes application performance and troubleshoots scalability issues
* Writes clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices in software development, including testing, debugging, and version control (Git)
* Participates in code reviews and contributes to technical discussions
* Ensures that the front\-end applications are user\-friendly, responsive, and optimized for performance across various devices and browsers
* Participates in all phases of development from definition and design through implementation, debugging, testing, and deployment of features across multiple subsystems within a large\-scale, web\-based, customer\-facing application
* Documents and demonstrates solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments, and clear code
* Investigates, analyzes, and makes recommendations to management regarding technology improvements, upgrades, and modifications
* Performs other duties as assigned

  
The Experience You'll Need

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree. Four (4\) years of relevant education and work experience may be substituted for degree
* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience as a Full Stack Developer
* Experience with modern front\-end development frameworks like Angular and Blazor
* Experience in Responsive Web Design
* Experience in Google Maps API
* Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript
* Experience working with databases, including writing queries and optimizing database performance (e.g., SQL Server)
* Knowledge of RESTful APIs and experience building or consuming APIs
* Proficiency in C\#, ASP.NET, .NET Core, and related frameworks
* Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently or in a team environment
* Polished and professional demeanor
* Strong interpersonal skills and extremely resourceful

**Preferred Requirements**

* Experience with DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, etc
* Familiarity with Unit Testing frameworks (e.g., NUnit)
* Familiarity with cloud services such as Azure or AWS
* Experience with microservices architecture
* Knowledge of mobile development is an added advantage
* Experience with Real Estate, CRM, Marketing Automation, Google Analytics

**Knowledge**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook

**Skills**

* Strong verbal, written, interpersonal, listening, and presentation communication skills
* Strong solution and service\-oriented skills, with an emphasis on collaboration, problem solving, follow\-through, and responsiveness
* Strong relationship building skills, with a proactive and service\-oriented approach to working with team members
* Strong project management, time management, and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple priorities

Electrical Engineering Manager
\_\_


ABB is seeking a Senior Lead Electrical Engineer to serve as the technical authority for Protection \& Controls and Power System Studies within our Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX. In this role, you will lead the technical direction of complex projects, define protection philosophies, drive engineering standards, mentor a growing team of engineers, and develop a well\-rounded understanding of modern power infrastructure up to 69kV.


Our group delivers substation design, protection and controls engineering, power system studies, and power management systems across medium and high voltage infrastructure. This is an opportunity to shape how we approach critical power system challenges, collaborate across disciplines, and leave a lasting impact on modern energy infrastructure

  

The work model for the role is: Hybrid (\#LI\-Hybrid)  

  

This role contributes to the Automation Energy Industries division in Houston, TX.  

  

Responsibilities:

* Serve as subject matter expert by leading Protection \& Controls engineering across multiple projects — including the definition of protection philosophies, relay selection, settings development, configuration, coordination, and review of single line diagrams — while providing technical oversight and standards to the engineering team.
* Perform and review power system studies ranging from standard analyses (short circuit, load flow, protective device coordination, arc flash) to advanced studies (dynamic stability, harmonics, transient analysis, grounding, motor starting, frequency response, voltage stability, and generator synchronization).
* Investigate and analyze power system disturbances, equipment failures, and protective relay operations at customer facilities.
* Review engineering deliverables to ensure technical accuracy, consistency, and compliance with industry standards, project specifications, and internal engineering practices.
* Mentor team members on protection and control best practices, building technical capability within the group.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders to support project execution and technical decision\-making.

* Support the design and implementation of power management systems (PMS) *(scope varies based on experience).*

  



**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university and Professional Engineer (PE) license.
* 15\+ years of experience in power systems engineering, with significant depth in Protection \& Controls for medium and high voltage systems.
* Expert\-level knowledge of protection principles, relay coordination, protection scheme design, and proven ability to independently perform relay configuration and settings development (e.g., SEL, GE, Siemens, ABB, or similar platforms).
* Ability to lead and execute power system studies independently — from standard analyses (SC, LF, PC, AF) through advanced studies (dynamic stability, harmonics, transient analysis, grounding, motor starting, and voltage stability).
* Expert\-level proficiency with at least one major power system analysis software (e.g., ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, PSCAD, or similar).
* Strong understanding of relevant industry standards and codes (IEEE, NFPA, NEC, ANSI, IEC, or equivalent).

jobs.title: Controls Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


The Controls Software Engineer owns controls software end\-to\-end with general direction. This role designs, develops, validates, integrates, and supports PLC, HMI/SCADA, networking, services, and related controls software for scientific and industrial systems. The engineer makes day\-to\-day technical decisions within assigned scope, applies user experience and safety best practices, troubleshoots hardware and software interfaces, and contributes to controls standards and team knowledge. This is a full\-time, onsite position at Nusano's facilities in West Valley City, Utah.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the design, development, testing, integration, and qualification of assigned controls software workstreams for medium\-complexity distributed systems, including systems with approximately 200 to 500 I/O points.
* Create new PLC software and modify existing PLC software in accordance with software design specifications, functional requirements, and controls engineering standards.
* Design, maintain, and improve HMI/SCADA applications using industrial user experience, operator interface, alarm\-management, and safety best practices.
* Partner with operations, physicists, engineers, and technical specialists to integrate hardware and software systems and support scientific and industrial equipment connected to the PLC environment.
* Integrate PLC software with Server based control systems, such as EPICS or similar SCADA control system frameworks.
* Troubleshoot and debug PLCs, industrial networks, communication interfaces, instrumentation, controls hardware, and software during development, commissioning, and operations.
* Apply networking fundamentals and industrial communication protocols such as EtherCAT, Modbus, and RS\-232/485 to controls system design and troubleshooting.
* Participate in hazard analyses and design reviews, identify software\-related safety risks, and implement appropriate controls safeguards.
* Develop software design documentation, test plans, operator and training materials, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge\-base content.
* Mentor Associate engineers on controls software tools, coding practices, and troubleshooting methods, and communicate risks or blockers early with clear technical context.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.
* Professional experience developing controls software in an industrial, manufacturing, scientific, or comparable technical environment.
* Proficiency with IEC 61131\-3 controls languages, including Structured Text and/or Ladder Logic.
* Experience creating or maintaining HMI/SCADA software and applying industrial UI/UX best practices.
* Ability to interpret electrical schematics, one\-line diagrams, and P\&ID drawings.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, industrial communication protocols, and distributed controls architecture.
* Experience troubleshooting PLCs, network devices, instrumentation, hardware/software interfaces, and controls systems.
* Working knowledge of source control and code\-branch management, preferably Git.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical decisions and collaborate across functions.

**Preferred Experience:**

* EPICS, Beckhoff controls, or other large\-scale distributed control systems.
* Working in an R\&D, commissioning, accelerator, or safety\-controlled environment.
* One or more high\-level programming languages, such as C\+\+, Java, C\#, or Python.
* Linux operating systems and object\-oriented programming practices.
* Test\-driven development, automated testing, or comparable software quality practices.
* Troubleshooting complex controls systems that combine PLC, instrumentation, networking, and scientific equipment.

**Physical Requirements / Work Environment:**

* Work to be conducted in an office environment, laboratories, engineering, R\&D, and/or production environment.
* Must be comfortable working within radiation environments.
* Work in this environment may involve exposure to hazardous materials and conditions, including high voltage, strong magnetic fields, chemicals, cryogenic substances, and radiological sources. These hazards require specialized training, strict adherence to safety procedures, and the use of appropriate personal protective equipment.
* Must be able to sit or stand for extended periods and frequently use a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other tools requiring manual dexterity.
* Ability to travel less than 10% of the time for commissioning, vendor visits, training, or other project needs.

**About Nusano**


Nusano is a privately held physics company working to stabilize supply chains, advance American national security, and enable once\-in\-a\-generation innovations in fields ranging from healthcare to nuclear energy.  

  

Nusano is commercializing platform technologies for radioisotope production, stable isotope enrichment, and advanced separation techniques. Together, these proprietary systems and methods are poised to supply the fight against cancer and help fuel the nuclear renaissance.  

  

Our team of innovators — bring curiosity, ingenuity, and heart to solving some of the world’s hardest problems.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Embedded Systems & Vulnerability Research)
jobs.description:
“From Silicon to Systems” – We are an elite, multi\-disciplinary team, bringing together the brightest minds from physics, computer science, electrical engineering, and mathematics to develop unique embedded security solutions for government and industrial customers. Battelle has been trusted by government clients to solve some of the world’s hardest security problems. We work in small agile teams to push the bounds of computing technology. Our high\-powered labs include specialized software and hardware, so our engineers have everything they need to invent new Cyber solutions.  

  

As a Software Engineer, you will spend your day designing, coding, and testing software. Our projects are non\-standard, highly customized, and will push you to new levels as a software developer. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of the software development life cycle with a focus on innovation and supporting cutting\-edge R\&D efforts.

**Job Summary**
---------------



Battelle is seeking Software Engineers at multiple career levels to support the design, development, analysis, and security assessment of embedded systems. These roles combine software engineering, low\-level system development, reverse engineering, vulnerability research, and secure software practices across mission\-critical environments.


The ideal candidate possesses strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ and Python, experience developing or analyzing embedded systems, and an interest in identifying and understanding software vulnerabilities. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Strategic Defense
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



The Strategic Defense team at Anduril is at the forefront of incubating and maturing AI\-native offerings for the integrated air and missile defense domain. We're the architects of mission autonomy and resilient mesh architectures, delivering scalable software solutions that meet some of the most urgent national security needs. By working hand\-in\-hand with elite teams in AI, Edge Hardware, Space Solutions, Networking, and Test Engineering we craft cutting\-edge, end\-to\-end systems that redefine mission success for major strategic capabilities.


**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As a Software Engineer, you will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way. Your efforts will ensure that Anduril products seamlessly work together to achieve a variety of critical outcomes. Above all, Mission Software Engineers are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset—executing in an *expedient*, *scalable*, and *pragmatic* way while keeping the mission top\-of\-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes correctly, on\-time, and with high quality.  

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own the software solutions that are deployed to customers.
* Write code to improve products and scale the mission capability to more customers.
* Collaborate across multiple teams to plan, build, and test complex functionality.
* Create and analyze metrics that are leveraged for debugging and monitoring.
* Triage issues, root cause failures, and coordinate next\-steps.
* Partner with end\-users to turn needs into features while balancing user experience with engineering constraints.
* Travel up to 50% of the time to build, test, and deploy capabilities in the real world.


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Must be willing to travel up to 50% to Asia Pacific
* Fluent Mandarin language skills
* Strong engineering background from industry or school, ideally in areas/fields such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics
* Experience working with a variety of programming languages such as Go, Rust, or Python
* Experience working with frontend frameworks such as React or Angular
* Experience building software solutions involving significant amounts of data processing and analysis
* Ability to quickly understand and navigate complex systems and established code bases
* A desire to work on critical software that has a real\-world impact


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* 4\+ years of professional industry experience working
* Developing software/hardware for safety critical functionality
* Distributed communication networks and message standards


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
	+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
	+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.co

jobs.title: Senior RF Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
HawkEye 360 is seeking a Sr. RF Electrical Engineer on the Space Team. The Space Team's mission is to design, build, and test small commercial satellites that provide revolutionary RF geospatial analytics.



You will perform RF and electrical design of our space platforms with a primary focus on our RF payloads. This includes RF front ends, integrating Software Defined Radios (SDR's) and antenna systems. You'll define and execute RF performance tests to verify mission requirements while also developing analog, digital, and power electronics across our satellite platforms. This role requires strong RF and Electrical Engineering expertise working cross functionally with the mechanical, software, payload, and systems engineering teams.


**Your main responsibilities will be:**


* Design and develop RF payload architectures and Software Defined Radio systems for space\-based RF collection missions.
* Design and optimize RF front ends, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, and signal conditioning circuitry.
* Perform electrical and RF simulations at a board and system level to validate the performance of different sub\-systems.
* Perform RF link budget analysis, interference modeling, and sensitivity trade studies to meet mission performance requirements.
* Support payload architecture decisions through mission\-driven trade studies at PDR/CDR milestones.
* Define and scope RF performance test plans to verify key specifications including sensitivity, dynamic range, spurious emissions, linearity, and signal quality.
* Develop test procedures and automation scripts to characterize SDR and RF front\-end performance.
* Execute EMI/EMC compliance testing and develop mitigation strategies for flight hardware.
* Design digital, analog, and power electronics for satellite flight hardware. Create and review schematics, block diagrams, PCB layouts, and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).
* Work closely with PCB Contract Manufacturers (CMs) to ensure quality control and timely delivery of flight hardware.
* Support spacecraft integration and testing efforts, including the design of Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE), flatsats for functional testing, and satellite flight hardware testing.
* Perform first article hardware unit testing, including reception inspection, burn\-in testing, thermal validation, and hardware checkouts.


**Your skills and qualifications:**  

**Essential education and experience:**


* Bachelor's degree in RF/Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Expert understanding of software\-defined radio architectures, RF front\-ends, and space\-based RF systems.
* 7\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and testing RF electronics, including SDRs, mixers, filters, amplifiers, and receiver chains.
* Experience s using lab equipment such as Spectrum Analyzers, Network Analyzers, Signal Generators, Noise Figure Analyzers, and RF test chambers.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Understanding of power electronics, high\-speed digital design, and RF fundamentals (impedance matching, S\-parameters, noise figure, linearity, etc.).
* Expertise in PCB design and layout (Altium or similar) with attention to RF design considerations (controlled impedance, grounding, shielding).
* Hands\-on flight hardware experience (satellite integration, RF lab testing, prototyping, troubleshooting).
* Experience handling ESD\-sensitive components and operating in cleanroom environments.


**Desirable:**


* Experience working in the smallsat or space industry with RF payloads or communication systems.
* Experience with version control (git) and continuous integration workflows.
* Proficiency with Python, C\+\+, MATLAB, or other coding languages for RF analysis and test automation.
* Experience with RF simulation tools (ADS, CST, HFSS, or similar).
* Familiarity with CAD (NX, SolidWorks, etc.) to support electro\-mechanical integration.
* Experience with EMI/EMC testing
* Experience using collaboration tools such as JIRA, Confluence, etc.

**Company Overview:**



HawkEye 360 is equipping defense, intelligence, and national security leaders with mission\-critical signals intelligence to enable faster, better decision making. By detecting, geolocating, and characterizing radio frequency emissions worldwide, HawkEye 360 delivers trusted domain awareness and early warning indicators to the US Government and allied partners. Our space\-based collection, proprietary signal processing, and AI\-powered analytics transform knowledge of RF spectrum into a strategic advantage. Proven by operational mission success, HawkEye 360 is redefining how signals intelligence strengthens national and global security.


*HawkEye 360 is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.*

**About Decision Technologies, Inc.**


Decision Technologies was founded to help bridge the gap between Department of Defense and Federal Government acquisition programs and technology to help our customers optimize their decision\-making process. Over the years, our areas of expertise have expanded to include Systems Engineering, Program Management, In\-Service Engineering, Equipment Repair, Research and Development, Test and Evaluation, and Intelligence and Counterintelligence Support. Our growth and success have positioned us as a premier engineering and intelligence services provider contributing to our nation's defense.


Our company culture cultivates talented problem\-solvers on focused on performance with industry\-leading teamwork and responsiveness. We have established a reputation for offering superior services and solutions, proven integrity and innovation, employee engagement and development, and customer collaboration.


Bring your expertise and knowledge to our team!

  

Bring the big picture together at the core of naval air and missile defense. As a Junior Combat Systems Engineer supporting the Navy’s Terminal Defense Systems program office, you will be the connective tissue between complex radars, guided missiles, automated launchers, and warship command\-and\-control architectures.

  

We are seeking a qualified **Junior Combat Systems Engineer** in **Arlington, VA**. This position is not eligible for hybrid or remote work situations. This is a 100% on\-site, in\-office position.

 **Position Description:**


Instead of focusing on just one isolated component, you will look across entire multi\-element combat weapon suites (such as Aegis and the Ship Self Defense System) to analyze requirements, map out digital architectures, define critical system interfaces, and verify performance through modeling, simulation, and live fleet testing. Working alongside senior systems architects and test directors, you will apply modern engineering methodologies to ensure diverse defensive technologies operate together seamlessly in high\-stress, real\-world operational environments.

 **YOU MUST BE ELIGIBLE FOR A DOD SECRET CLEARANCE**

 **Responsibilities and Duties:**

* + **Combat System Architecture \& Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE):** Build and maintain digital system\-of\-systems models using SysML and tools like Cameo/MagicDraw. Map operational requirements down to functional behaviors and software/hardware components, creating integrated digital architectures that demonstrate how terminal defense systems communicate across shipboard combat networks.
	+ **Interface Definition \& Data Flow Modeling:** Support the development, review, and integration of system\-to\-system interfaces and Interface Control Documents (ICDs). Define message protocols, track handoffs, latency bounds, and data structures linking weapons, search radars, and shipboard Command and Control (C2\) baselines.
	+ **System Requirements Analysis \& Traceability:** Analyze and decompose top\-level warfighter needs and threat baselines into clear, testable system and subsystem performance requirements using tools like DOORS. Track requirements traceability across the entire systems development lifecycle to evaluate readiness and identify functional gaps.
	+ **Fire Control Loop \& Engagement Integration:** Analyze end\-to\-end fire control loops from initial target detection, tracking, and combat system designation, to launcher positioning, missile fly\-out, and terminal intercept. Review firing policies, weapon scheduling rules, and battle management logic to eliminate response latency and maximize overall probability of kill ().
	+ **Modeling \& Simulation (M\&S) Studies:** Run and evaluate digital system\-level simulations using MATLAB, Python, or specialized defense simulation frameworks. Analyze multi\-target engagement runs, sensor fusion performance, and system behavior under complex raid scenarios to inform tactical baselines and engineering trade studies.
	+ **Test \& Evaluation (T\&E) and Live Range Support:** Participate in end\-to\-end test planning, execution, and data analysis for land\-based integration test sites and live\-fire at\-sea missile events. Evaluate test scenarios, verify requirement compliance against objective test data, and review post\-test system telemetry to validate digital models against real hardware performance.
	+ **Technical Reviews \& Engineering Change Assessments:** Review OEM Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs), System Engineering Technical Review (SETR) milestone packages, and Technical Data Packages (TDPs). Evaluate how proposed hardware, software, or sensor changes impact overall combat system behavior, backwards compatibility, and fleet interoperability.

* Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical/STEM discipline (recent college graduates are encouraged to apply

 **Desired Qualifications:**

* Systems \& Digital Toolkit: Academic coursework or hands\-on project experience with systems modeling concepts (SysML/MBSE, Cameo, MagicDraw), requirements tools (DOORS), or programming/analysis software (MATLAB, Python, Simulink).
* Analytical Mindset: A strong interest in big\-picture system integration, network data flows, interface definition, and seeing how individual hardware and software components interact to accomplish complex missions.

Description:  



**Position Overview:**


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Electrical Design Engineer II to join our engineering team in Roanoke, Virginia. This role is essential to support the Commercial, Manufacturing, and Field Service teams with electrical designs for fixed and mobile equipment used in the civil explosives industry. The initial focus of the position is low\-voltage DC circuit design, control panel layouts, and electrical CAD modeling and drafting on both new and legacy systems. As the role matures, scope will expand to include AC power distribution for fixed plant equipment and light PLC/HMI programming. The successful candidate will follow designs through the entire lifecycle \- working with the Commercial team on concept designs and specifications, Manufacturing on production and sustaining activities, and Field Service to provide comprehensive end\-user support. This position is ideal for an engineer with 2\-5 years of experience who is ready to take ownership of electrical systems on complex mobile and fixed equipment.


Requirements:  



**Key Responsibilities:**

*Electrical Design and Engineering:*

* Design 12/24 VDC electrical systems for mobile equipment, including load analysis, wire and fuse/breaker sizing, circuit protection, relay logic, grounding, and connector and harness selection
* Develop control panel and enclosure layouts \- component placement, terminal blocks, DIN rail, wire duct, labeling, and thermal/environmental considerations \- following UL 508A and NFPA 79 practices
* Prepare electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, panel layout drawings, and electrical bills of materials (BOMs) in SkyCAD and Solid Edge within the Teamcenter PLM environment
* Model electrical components, enclosures, and harness routings in 3D and coordinate with Mechanical Design to integrate electrical hardware into vehicle and plant assemblies
* Reverse\-engineer, document, and update legacy electrical systems, migrating older schematics and panel drawings into current CAD and drawing standards
* Apply Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles to panel builds and harness assemblies to reduce build time, wiring errors, and cost

*AC Power and Controls (growing scope):*

* Progressively take on AC power distribution design for fixed plant equipment (120/240/480 VAC, single\- and three\-phase), including motor control, starters, VFDs, transformers, disconnects, and grounding in compliance with NEC (NFPA 70\)
* Support light PLC/HMI programming, I/O configuration, and logic changes on new and existing control systems using IEC 61131\-3 languages (ladder, function block, structured text) in CODESYS, under the guidance of the Senior Control System Engineer
* Interpret and troubleshoot CAN bus / SAE J1939 networks, sensors, and electronic controllers used on mobile equipment

*Component Selection and Cost Estimation:*

* Specify electrical components \- relays, contactors, connectors, cabling, sensors, solenoids, enclosures \- based on electrical requirements, operating environment (vibration, temperature, moisture, hazardous location considerations), availability, and cost
* Develop accurate cost estimates for concept electrical designs to support project planning and budgeting

*Testing and Validation:*

* Generate test plans to qualify and validate new electrical designs, including panel point\-to\-point checkout, continuity and insulation checks, and functional testing
* Apply electrical aptitude and troubleshooting skills under pressure, both on the shop floor and in field environments, using multimeters, clamp meters, oscilloscopes, and diagnostic tools

*Documentation and Collaboration:*

* Compile design review reports, wiring instructions, and electrical documentation for manuals and service literature as necessary
* Work collaboratively with Commercial, Manufacturing, and Field Service teams throughout the product lifecycle, supporting production with build instructions and resolving wiring and panel issues
* Travel domestically and internationally (less than 5%) to support product development and Field Service needs

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering Technology
* 2\-5 years of relevant experience in an engineering/manufacturing environment
* Demonstrated experience designing low\-voltage DC circuits and electrical control panels
* Ability to read, create, and maintain electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, harness drawings, and panel layout drawings
* Working knowledge of wire sizing, circuit protection, grounding, and voltage drop calculations
* Familiarity with applicable electrical codes and standards (NEC/NFPA 70, NFPA 79, UL 508A)
* Familiarity with relays, contactors, sensors, solenoids, actuators, and other electromechanical devices used on industrial or mobile equipment
* Competency in a current electrical CAD package and a 3D mechanical CAD package
* Strong electrical aptitude and ability to troubleshoot under pressure, both on the shop floor and in the field
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Excellent administrative, interpersonal, and communication skills
* Ability to work as an individual contributor with a team\-oriented mindset

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with off\-highway or heavy equipment electrical systems (12/24 VDC, SAE J1939/CAN bus, sealed connectors and harnesses)
* Proficiency in SkyCAD and Solid Edge within a Teamcenter PLM environment
* Experience with AC industrial power design \- motor control, VFDs, and 480 VAC three\-phase distribution
* Exposure to PLC/HMI programming in IEC 61131\-3 languages (CODESYS preferred; Allen\-Bradley or Siemens acceptable)
* Understanding of hazardous location electrical requirements (NEC Articles 500\-505\) and intrinsically safe circuit principles
* Experience with electro\-hydraulic proportional valve control and mobile electronic controllers

jobs.description:
**SteerBridge is a modern technology company delivering innovative, mission‑focused solutions to the U.S. Government and private sector.** Leveraging deep expertise in federal acquisition, digital transformation, and emerging technologies, we deliver agile, commercial‑grade capabilities that accelerate operational effectiveness and drive measurable mission success.
At the core of SteerBridge is our people—especially the veterans whose leadership, problem‑solving mindset, and commitment to excellence elevate every project we support. **Position Overview**



The Electrical Engineer (CM\-EE) will serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) providing professional electrical engineering and technical consulting support to the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Office of Construction \& Facilities Management (CFM), and Veterans Health Administration (VHA). The position supports VA design, construction, maintenance, facilities, and programmatic initiatives and may require simultaneous support of multiple projects throughout the VA portfolio.



The Electrical Engineer will provide specialized expertise associated with electrical power distribution systems for healthcare facilities, telecommunications, signal systems, electronic safety systems, and electrical security systems. The engineer will support projects through planning, design development, construction, commissioning, system acceptance, and project closeout.



This is a remote position with periodic travel to VA medical centers, healthcare campuses, construction sites, and other project locations when field investigations, inspections, assessments, meetings, or other onsite activities are required.



Travel: Travel to Department of Veterans Affairs project sites as required.



Client: U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs \- Office of Construction \& Facilities Management (CFM) / Veterans Health Administration (VHA)

The Electrical Engineer will provide engineering subject matter expertise supporting VA design, construction, maintenance, and facilities programs across assigned projects. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:



Electrical Engineering Technical Support



* Review electrical engineering design packages, drawings, specifications, calculations, studies, and technical submissions for compliance with applicable codes, standards, VA requirements, and project criteria.



* Evaluate designs for conformance with the National Electrical Code (NEC), applicable NFPA standards, VA Design Guides, VA criteria, and federal healthcare facility requirements.



* Review and evaluate electrical systems associated with normal and emergency power distribution, electrical panels and distribution equipment, generators and emergency/standby power systems, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems, lighting, grounding and bonding, electrical life\-safety infrastructure, telecommunications and communications infrastructure, signal systems, and electronic safety and electrical security systems.



* Perform or review technical engineering analyses, including electrical load studies, short\-circuit analyses, arc\-flash assessments, equipment sizing, system capacity evaluations, and electrical infrastructure condition and deficiency evaluations.



* Analyze electrical system deficiencies and associated operational, safety, capacity, reliability, and compliance risks.



* Develop recommendations for corrective actions, system upgrades, replacement strategies, and risk mitigation.



Design Review and Construction Support



* Review design submissions for constructability, technical accuracy, completeness, interdisciplinary coordination, code compliance, and adherence to VA design criteria.

* Evaluate contractor submissions for technical accuracy and consistency with approved design intent, contract requirements, and applicable electrical standards.

Markon is seeking a Junior Software Engineer to support an Intelligence Community client in McLean, Virginia. This position will design, develop, integrate, test, deploy, and maintain mission\-focused software applications across Sponsor networks and cloud environments. * Provide application bug fixes, enhancements, and Graphical User Interface (GUI) improvements to meet operational requirements.
* Develop and deploy software applications across Sponsor environments, including cloud\-based environments.
* Design and develop Representational State Transfer (REST) APIs.
* Integrate externally developed code into core software libraries.
* Install and configure application software.
* Evaluate third\-party vendors and software partners.
* Maintain the design and architecture of software libraries, including module APIs, code organization, and compliance with established coding standards.
* Emphasize modularity, reusable code, clean interfaces between subsystems, and overall design integrity.
* Coordinate with configuration management personnel to integrate externally developed software into core software libraries.
* Develop a wide range of software for deployment on Sponsor networks.
* Develop and support software libraries involving technologies such as audio/video, image\-processing algorithms, operating systems and file systems, and device drivers.
* Assist the Sponsor in developing standards, methods, and procedures for determining product quality, release readiness, and software acceptance.
* Conduct testing throughout all levels of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Perform regression testing and adhere to established testing procedures.
* Support Agile software development practices throughout the full application lifecycle.
* Track and manage software issues using tools such as JIRA.
* Provide metrics on software availability and reliability during monthly status reviews.

**Required:*** An Active TS/SCI with a FS Polygraph is required to be considered.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or another related scientific or technical discipline.
* Minimum of 2 years of software engineering experience within the last 5 years.
* Demonstrated experience with at least 3 of the following technologies:

	+ Visual Basic.
	+ Java.
	+ JavaScript.

	+ SQL.
	+ XML.
	+ Python.
	+ HTML.
	+ LDAP certificates.
	+ Apache.

* Demonstrated experience with software issue\-tracking tools such as JIRA.

* Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining applications within AWS/Sponsor cloud computing environments.

	+ Compliance scanning.
	+ Test\-driven development.

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start\-up, with the scale and customer focus of the world's leading enterprise software company. At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. This role is part of the Lunar Permanence business unit, which develops Blue Origin’s Blue Moon landers and related products. To further Blue Origin's mission of millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth, we are building sustainable infrastructure for our transport of crew and cargo from Earth to the lunar surface.
Blue Origin's Lunar RF Systems group is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer. Built with modern Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA), microcontrollers, and advanced System\-on\-Chip (SoC) devices, our products host embedded software that configures, controls, performs preprocessing, and enhances the operation of our hardware components.


We are looking for an experienced embedded software engineer that will be responsible for designing, implementing and verifying embedded software for mission\-critical spaceflight systems working directly with our hardware engineers. **Job Description:**

Are you a hands\-on engineer who loves bringing microcontrollers to life, tracing circuit boards, and making things fly? If you’ve spent your degree, capstones, or weekend projects tinkering with STM32s, ESP32s, or Arduinos—digging into logic analyzers and troubleshooting hardware\-software interfaces— **Airbus** has the ideal runway for your career.


We are seeking an enthusiastic **Entry\-Level Embedded Software Engineer** to join our Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) team. In this role, you won't just write abstract code behind a desk—you will be on the bench and in the lab, working directly on the hardware/software boundary of our next\-generation autonomous aircraft and ground equipment. From writing C/C\+\+ firmware and configuring low\-level communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN) to bench testing with oscilloscopes and supporting hardware bring\-up, your work will directly power physical, flying systems.  



  

**Meet the Team:**

The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most advanced small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take\-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea.  



  

**Your Working Environment:**

Nestled in the heart of the stunning Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game\-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Pacific Northwest has to offer!  



  

**How We Care for You:**

* **Financial Rewards:** Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
* **Work/Life Balance:** Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
* **Health \& Welfare:** Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high\-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
* **Individual Development:** Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000\+ e\-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

**Your Challenges:**

  

**Primary Responsibilities: 100%**

* As an early career engineer, you will:
* Write, test, and debug embedded firmware (C/C\+\+) for microcontroller\-based systems used on aircraft and ground equipment.
* Assist in bringing up new hardware boards — bench testing, debugging with oscilloscopes/logic analyzers, and verifying sensor/peripheral integration.
* Support integration of embedded devices with communication interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, RF modules).
* Assist in troubleshooting field\-reported hardware/firmware issues, working with senior engineers to isolate root causes.
* Write and maintain technical documentation for firmware modules, hardware interfaces, and test procedures.
* Support unit and integration testing of embedded systems, including building simple test fixtures/scripts.
Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers during hardware/firmware co\-design.  
* 

  

**Additional Responsibilities:**

Other duties as assigned by the manager  

* 

  

  

**Qualified Experience and Training:**

**Education:**

Required


* Possess a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Must have at least six (6\) months experience/internships/coursework programming microcontrollers (e.g., Arduino, STM32, ESP32, or similar) in C/C\+\+.
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and willingness to debug down to the hardware/firmware boundary.
* Demonstrated hands\-on project experience (school, club, or personal) building or programming physical devices.
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded/microcontroller programming.
* Understanding of basic digital communication protocols (UART, SPI, I2C).
* Ability to read and interpret basic circuit schematics.
Basic understanding of digital and analog electronics fundamentals.  
* 

  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Relevant coursework or project experience in embedded systems, digital logic, or robotics.
* Relevant Coursework: Digital and Analog Circuits, Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, etc.
* 1 year of experience (internships, co\-ops, capstone projects, or personal/club projects count).

**About WSDOT**


The Washington State Department of Transportation (WSDOT) is a multimodal agency with a global reputation for excellence. Our dedicated workforce plans, designs, builds, and operates an integrated transportation system that safely and efficiently moves people and goods throughout the state. In addition to maintaining over 20,000 lane miles of state highway and 4,100 bridges, WSDOT leads an award\-winning Active Transportation Plan, manages the world's longest floating bridge, and operates the largest ferry system in the nation!


Washington State Ferries (WSF) is an essential part of Washington's transportation network. Every year, we carry nearly 20 million passengers across Puget Sound and the San Juan Islands on more than 400 sailings a day. Our dedicated teams with over 2,100 people work together to serve our communities and shape the future of ferry travel.

  

  

**The Opportunity**

This is an opportunity to make a lasting impact on Washington's transportation system while advancing WSF's mission of providing safe, sustainable, and reliable ferry service.

jobs.description:
At Meta, we're building innovative products that make it easier for people to connect with each other and enjoy immersive experiences. Our team of experienced engineers is developing and shipping products at the intersection of hardware, software, and content, pushing the future of computing platforms and redefining the way people work, play, and connect. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to design, develop, and optimize embedded firmware systems for our AR, VR, and wearable devices, working on low\-level systems software, device drivers, and connectivity protocols such as Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, and Core Android networking. You'll collaborate with cross\-functional teams to solve complex problems and drive innovation in areas such as computer vision, machine learning, and graphics, helping to shape the future of technology and create new experiences for augmented reality, virtual reality, and social/family products.  

  

  

### **Embedded Software Engineer, Firmware Responsibilities:**

* Lead hardware bring\-up, peripheral drivers and communication, silicon integration, and power and performance management and optimization efforts

* Profile performance problems and drive optimizations across the entire software stack
* Analyze, design, develop, and debug firmware for a wide variety of devices, including novel sensing and imaging systems, haptic devices, and audio prototypes
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including silicon architects, hardware designers, OS team, and algorithm and model development teams
* Understand and implement power\-management, boot loaders, scheduling, inter\-processor communication, computer vision, and firmware/system interfaces on RTOS and/or bare\-metal environments
* Design, develop, and architect models and infrastructure building blocks of Virtual Platforms, integrating internal models and vendor IP models

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 5\+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 2\+ years of experience
* 3\+ years embedded software development experience in industry settings
* Experience in large\-scale C/C\+\+ code base
* Demonstrated experience working across disciplines to drive optimal solutions

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands\-on coding experience with peripherals such as UART, SPI, CSI\-2, i2c, GPIO, USB

* Experience with lab instrumentation such as oscilloscopes, logic/protocol analyzers for debugging embedded systems at HW level
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with compression, camera and video pipelines, or encoding technologies such as H.264
* Experience with embedded microcontrollers, DSP, CPU, and GPU architectures
* Experience with time synchronization methods at protocol and electrical levels
* e.g. PTP, NTP, IRIG\-B, LTC/SMPTE

You will gain comprehensive understanding of our server firmware stack and analyze it in both current and future contexts. Using your systems knowledge, you will architect solutions to complex multi\-factor problems, including firmware deployment strategies that minimize customer impact and optimize operational efficiency across millions of servers supporting diverse workloads from traditional compute to advanced machine learning applications.

From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.  

  

Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in space\-based systems design.

---------------


Join Amazon's Robotics (AR) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) organization to deploy industrial robotics and automation technologies across North America's fulfillment network. In AR TD, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across the North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in A develop.
  

  

As a Systems Engineer in AR TD, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro\-mechanical and network systems, large scale installations, and system troubleshooting. You will work with cross\-functional partners across the Amazon Fulfillment Technology \& Robotics engineering, safety, product strategy, software, supply chain, third\-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on\-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon\-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go\-live of each project. Project durations vary from a few days to several months each. This is a travel\-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
  

  

\*\*Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.
  

  

Key job responsibilities

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
  

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
  

  

Platform Engineering builds what the rest of IREN builds on. We own data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, and product engineering, the systems that turn a fleet of data centers and GPU clusters into a platform our customers and our own teams can move quickly on. Much of it is being built now, for the first time, so there is no legacy stack to maintain and no established playbook to follow.
  

  

We are hiring senior software engineers across Platform Engineering. This is an individual contributor role. Seniority here is measured by the scope of what you own and by how much better the engineers around you get, not by how many people report to you. At this level you own the design of whole systems, including the parts that cross team boundaries and the parts you will not build yourself.
  

  

The part of the role we weight most heavily is what you do for the engineers around you. We expect you to raise the standard of the people you work with, through design review and code review that teach rather than correct, through pairing, and through handing hard problems to engineers who are ready to stretch. We look for evidence of this during the interview, and we continue to assess it after you join.
  

  

Because Platform Engineering builds for other teams, the boundaries matter as much as the internals. You will own the interfaces between your systems and everyone else's, negotiate what those contracts guarantee, and manage versioning and compatibility when something has to change. That work is as much communication as design, so we expect you to write clearly and to be comfortable in a room where people disagree. We also expect depth: senior engineers here are the person the company asks about a particular domain, whether that is data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering. Engineers at every level at IREN stay hands on, senior ones included.
  
* 6 or more years of professional software engineering experience, including several years operating in production what you built.
* A record of owning system level design rather than components alone. You have been the person accountable for how a whole system fits together.
* Deep experience with distributed systems, including failure modes you have personally debugged rather than only read about.
* Demonstrated coaching. Be ready to name engineers who grew because of how you worked with them, and to say what actually changed.
* Experience owning APIs that other teams depend on, including versioning and breaking change migrations.
* Excellent communication, particularly in writing. You can write a design document another team can act on without a meeting.
* Depth in at least one domain relevant to this team: data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.
* Experience leading delivery across more than one team, without formal authority over the people involved.
* Strong fundamentals, and the judgement to recognize when the simple answer is the right one.

Nice to have:
  

* Experience as a formal tech lead, or in a staff level role.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, and infrastructure as code (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Kubernetes; Terraform).
* Experience with high volume data pipelines, streaming systems, or telemetry and time series data.
* Experience putting machine learning or LLM systems into production.
* Experience working close to physical infrastructure, where the software must account for hardware that fails.

  
* Own system design from end to end: the problem statement, architecture, interfaces, data model, and rollout, including the parts other engineers will build.
* Coach and develop the engineers around you. Give review that teaches, pair on hard problems, and hand over work that stretches people rather than keeping it because you would finish it faster.
* Own the API contracts between your systems and other teams: negotiate what they guarantee, version them, and manage the migration when they change.
* Set technical direction for your area, and write it down so other teams can build against it without needing a meeting first.
* Break large, ambiguous problems into work that a team can sequence, estimate, and deliver.
* Lead delivery across team boundaries, including the coordination and follow up that this actually requires.
* Stay hands on. Write and review code, and carry the pager for what you own.
* Own operations for your systems: monitoring, on\-call, incident response, and the follow up that stops the same incident recurring.
* Be the person the company can ask about your domain, and make what you know available to others rather than holding it.
* Raise the standard through the systems around the code: CI/CD, observability, testing practice, and documentation.

  
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long\-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well\-being, and long\-term success.
  

Compensation
  

* The expected base salary for this role USD $152,000 – $228,000/annum.

* Work with engineering managers and product on planning and sequencing, including what the organisation should stop doing.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

  


### **ABOUT THE TEAM**


*The Anduril Rocket Motor Systems (RMS) team is on a mission to build next generation solid rocket motors for a safer, more connected world. To achieve our vision of becoming a large\-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers' capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.*  

  

**ABOUT THE JOB**  

  

As the Electrical Engineer, you will specify, design, develop and install devices used to collect data on solid rocket motor burn performance. Additionally, you will design custom electronic solutions—including PCBs, firmware, and FPGA code—needed to manufacture and test solid rocket motors, which will include working with integrated safety\-critical designs. This position also requires the ability to configure data collection systems and develop software applications used to collect the data. It is expected that you may oversee technicians during the instrumentation installation and during rocket motor testing/development. The right person for this role has direct, hands\-on experience with the design, development, and installation of sensors used to collect a variety of metrics related to testing of solid rocket motors. If you are a hands\-on leader, have an entrepreneurial spirit, and enjoy being the point person for collecting valuable performance data, then this role is for you. You will assist in the testing solid rocket motors which will include working with integrated safety designs used to initiate the motor.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic\-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

The Future Forward organization is Intuitive’s advanced concepts group. We explore emerging technologies, prototype next\-generation solutions, and build software experiences that shape the future of robotic\-assisted surgery.


If you're ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you'll find your purpose here.

**Primary Function of Position:**


As a Vision Software Staff Engineer, you will act as the technical lead for the software and embedded architecture definition of the real\-time, high\-definition video processing, imaging, and intra\-body illumination systems at the heart of a new generation surgical robotic platform.


You will drive the deep integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi\-processor embedded architectures, bringing sound engineering judgment to the trade\-offs between hardware, software, and algorithms, and procedure\-specific product requirements.


Critical to the success of this role is experience diagnosing and debugging complex vision systems end\-to\-end – from sensor and optics through the video pipeline to software – driving root cause investigations and collaborating with hardware and algorithms teams to resolve difficult, multi\-disciplinary issues. Familiarity with working in a regulated industry and with design controls for medical devices is a plus.


The successful candidate must excel at evaluating design trade\-offs through detailed technical deep dives, proof\-of\-concept development, and rapid iteration, translating rough requirements into robust, well\-reasoned embedded software architectures.


A strong sense of shared responsibility and shared reward is required, as is the ability to make the work fun and interesting. Supporting you will be a development and management team that knows and cares about what you are doing and wants you to succeed.


**Essential Job Duties**


* Lead the definition of hardware, software, and algorithms architecture for the real\-time video processing engine, image sensors, and intra\-body illumination systems of a new generation surgical robotic platform, from concept through implementation.
* Drive the integration of cameras, image sensors, and vision processing pipelines into complex, multi\-processor embedded architectures, ensuring robust interfaces between hardware, FPGA/ISP, and software components.
* Evaluate multiple design trade\-offs for the embedded vision software architecture through detailed technical deep dives, proof\-of\-concept development, and rapid iteration.
* Lead bring\-up and integration of new, high\-performance cameras and image sensors, and the integration and evaluation of advanced camera pipeline video processing algorithms.
* Diagnose and debug vision system issues end\-to\-end – sensor, optics, video pipeline, and software – leading root cause investigations in close collaboration with hardware, algorithms, and systems engineering teams.
* Drive development and enhancement of the color and power control functions for intra\-operative illumination.
* Lead formal risk analyses for vision and illumination subsystems; identify additional hardware requirements and develop software mitigations to minimize potential failures.
* Design and develop offline simulation environments and hardware/software diagnostic tools that accelerate development, debug, and test.
* Perform and guide detailed design, development, documentation, and verification of embedded vision software and supervisory state machines, in compliance with regulatory requirements and Intuitive's internal guidelines.
* Contribute broadly across the video and vision software stack, including extension of current processing frameworks to new hardware platforms.
* Apply high\-level and specialized imaging/vision expertise to deliver innovations and problem\-solving approaches that can be leveraged across multiple products.
* Mentor and guide engineers across the vision team.

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
* A minimum of 12 years of experience developing and supporting embedded systems, with significant focus on video, imaging, or vision systems (or 8 years with a Master's degree, or 5 years with a PhD).

**Senior** **Electrical Engineer – Development \& Test**  

  

**Broadata Communications, Inc. (BCI) – Torrance, CA**  

*On\-site*  

  

**Company Overview**  

**Broadata Communications, Inc. (BCI)** is a privately held California\-based corporation. BCI is a leading and innovative company specializing in the development of market\-driven products for the transmission of digital multimedia (video, audio, and data) over fiber. Our clients are world leaders in their industries, spanning entertainment, broadcast, medical, professional audio/video, house of worship, education, government, military, and transportation sectors. We are ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 certified, with a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and continuous improvement.  

  

**Job Summary**  

We are looking for a talented and motivated **Senior Electrical Engineer – Development \& Test** to play a key role in the development, validation, troubleshooting, and production readiness of our Pro AV products.  

This position serves as the technical bridge between our electrical test and validation team and our automated test development team. The ideal candidate will have a strong electrical engineering foundation, hands\-on board bring\-up experience, and the ability to troubleshoot complex hardware and automated test system issues.  

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail\-driven engineer who enjoys hands\-on hardware development, electrical debugging, and cross\-functional problem solving. This critical role is based in Torrance, CA and offers a fast\-paced, high\-impact work environment with opportunities for professional growth and leadership within BCI. Veterans welcome!  

This is a hands\-on position. This is NOT a remote or hybrid position.  

  

**Key Responsibilities*** Work with a team of hands\-on engineers and participate in hardware development, design review, testing, troubleshooting, verification, and documentation of new video system designs.
* Perform board bring\-up activities including visual inspection, power rail validation, processor initialization, memory verification, and interface testing.
* Execute design verification and validation (V\&V) testing for new products and prototypes.
* Perform electrical troubleshooting and root cause analysis using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, protocol analyzers, and other lab equipment.
* Investigate and diagnose product failures occurring during development, production testing, and field returns.
* Support the development and deployment of automated test systems used in engineering validation and manufacturing.
* Debug automated test system failures and determine whether issues originate from hardware, test configurations, fixtures, automation scripts, or product firmware.
* Collaborate with software, firmware, FPGA, and mechanical engineering teams during product development and qualification.
* Work closely with overseas software developers responsible for automated test scripts and provide technical guidance on hardware\-related test issues.
* Assist in the development and improvement of test fixtures, test procedures, and manufacturing test strategies.
* Create detailed engineering documentation including test procedures, validation plans, failure analysis reports, and test results.
* Participate in internal design reviews and provide feedback on electrical design robustness, manufacturability, and testability.
* Collaborate with Production, Marketing, and Sales for product requirements, product releases, technical support, and testing activities.
* Work on problems with defined scope, schedule, and expectations.
* Other responsibilities as assigned.


Job responsibilities within our organization are dynamic. This may not be a complete list of duties. Other responsibilities and duties may be assigned by your supervisor or upper management.  

  

**Education \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in electronics development, hardware validation, board bring\-up, and electrical troubleshooting.
* Experience performing board bring\-up on embedded hardware platforms.
* Experience with electrical verification and validation (V\&V) testing.
* Experience debugging analog, digital, and mixed\-signal electronic circuits.
* Experience using test and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, spectrum analyzers, and power analyzers.
* Understanding of automated test systems and the interaction between hardware, software, instrumentation, fixtures, and test scripts.
* Experience troubleshooting automated test equipment and identifying root causes of test failures.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics, datasheets, and PCB layouts.
* Experience with common embedded communication protocols including I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet, and USB.
* Experience with Python scripting or debugging Python\-based automated test scripts is preferred.
* Experience with FPGA development or FPGA troubleshooting is a plus.
* Experience working within ISO\-regulated development environments is preferred.
* Experience writing engineering test reports, validation reports, and technical documentation is preferred.

**Skills \& Abilities*** Strong hands\-on electrical debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to lead technical investigations and drive issues to resolution.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively across multiple engineering disciplines.
* Comfortable serving as a liaison between hardware engineers, test engineers, and software developers.
* Proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities while adapting to changing business needs.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional engineering environment.
